34.s: i̱yaṃ te̍ ya̱jñiyā̍ ta̱nūrapo̍ muñcā̱mi na pra̱jām am̐ho̱muca̱ḥ svāhā̍kṛtāḥ pṛthi̱vīmāvi̍śata pṛthi̱vyā saṃbha̍va
34.d: इ̱यं ते̍ य̱ज्ञिया̍ त̱नूरपो̍ मुञ्चा̱मि न प्र̱जाम् अम्̐हो̱मुच̱ः स्वाहा̍कृताः पृथि̱वीमावि̍शत पृथि̱व्या संभ̍व
34.m: This is your sacrificial body; I release the waters, not the offspring. / Delivering from distress, offered with svāhā, enter the earth! Unite with the earth!

34.s: agne̱ tvam̐ su jā̍gṛhi va̱yam̐ su ma̍ndiṣīmahi | rakṣā̍ ṇo apra̍yucchan prabu̱dhe na̱ḥ puna̍skṛdhi
34.d: अग्ने̱ त्वम्̐ सु जा̍गृहि व̱यम्̐ सु म̍न्दिषीमहि । रक्षा̍ णो अप्र̍युच्छन् प्रबु̱धे न̱ः पुन̍स्कृधि
34.m: O Agni, keep good watch! May we rejoice well! / Guard us without being heedless; make us ready to awake again!

34.s: puna̱rmana̱ḥ puna̱rāyu̱rma āgā̱t puna̍ścakṣu̱ḥ puna̱ḥ śrotra̱ṃ ma āgā̍t puna̍ḥ prā̱ṇaḥ puna̍rā̱tmā ma āgā̍t | vai̱śvā̱na̱ro ada̍bdhastanū̱pā a̱gnirmā̍ pātu duri̱tāda̍va̱dyāt
34.d: पुन̱र्मन̱ः पुन̱रायु̱र्म आगा̱त् पुन̍श्चक्षु̱ः पुन̱ः श्रोत्र̱ं म आगा̍त् पुन̍ः प्रा̱णः पुन̍रा̱त्मा म आगा̍त् । वै̱श्वा̱न̱रो अद̍ब्धस्तनू̱पा अ̱ग्निर्मा̍ पातु दुरि̱ताद̍व̱द्यात्
34.m: Back has come mind, back has come lifespan, back has come sight, back has come hearing to me; / back has come in-breath, back has come the Self to me. May Agni Vaiśvānara, undeceived protector of the body, protect me from mishap, from reproach.

34.s: tvama̍gne vrata̱pā a̍si de̱va ā martye̍ṣvā | tvaṃ ya̱jñeṣvīḍya̍ḥ
34.d: त्वम̍ग्ने व्रत̱पा अ̍सि दे̱व आ मर्त्ये̍ष्वा । त्वं य̱ज्ञेष्वीड्य̍ः
34.m: O Agni, you are the guardian of the vow among the gods and among mortals; / you are worthy of praise at the sacrifices.

34.s: rāsveya̍tsomā̱ bhūyo̍ bhara | de̱vo na̍ḥ savi̱tā vaso̍rdā̱tā vasva̍dāt
34.d: रास्वेय̍त्सोमा̱ भूयो̍ भर । दे̱वो न̍ः सवि̱ता वसो̍र्दा̱ता वस्व̍दात्
34.m: Give so much, O Soma; bring more! / The god Savitṛ, giver of wealth, has given wealth.

35.s: (5) e̱ṣā te̍ śukra ta̱nūre̱tadvarca̱stayā̱ saṃbha̍va̱ bhrāja̍ṃ gaccha | jū̱rasi̍ dhṛ̱tā mana̍sā ju̱ṣṭā viṣṇa̍ve
35.d: (5) ए̱षा ते̍ शुक्र त̱नूरे̱तद्वर्च̱स्तया̱ संभ̍व̱ भ्राज̍ं गच्छ । जू̱रसि̍ धृ̱ता मन̍सा जु̱ष्टा विष्ण̍वे
35.m: This is your body, O bright one; this is your luster; unite with it, enter into radiance! / You are speed, held by mind, pleasing to Viṣṇu.

35.s: tasyā̍ste satyasavasaḥ prasu̱ve ta̱nūya̱ntrama̍śīya̱ svāhā̍ ca̱ndramā̍si śu̱krama̍sya̱mṛta̍masi vaiśvade̱vama̍si
35.d: तस्या̍स्ते सत्यसवसः प्रसु̱वे त̱नूय̱न्त्रम̍शीय̱ स्वाहा̍ च̱न्द्रमा̍सि शु̱क्रम̍स्य̱मृत̍मसि वैश्वदे̱वम̍सि
35.m: Under the impulse of you, whose impulse is truth, may I attain the restrainer of the body: svāhā! / You are gold; you are bright; you are immortal; you belong to All-Gods.

35.s: ci̱dasi̍ ma̱nāsi̱ dhīra̍si̱ dakṣi̍ṇāsi kṣa̱triyā̍si ya̱jñiyā̍syadi̍tirasyubhayataḥ śī̱rṣṇī sā na̱ḥ suprā̍cī supra̍tīcī bhava
35.d: चि̱दसि̍ म̱नासि̱ धीर̍सि̱ दक्षि̍णासि क्ष̱त्रिया̍सि य̱ज्ञिया̍स्यदि̍तिरस्युभयतः शी̱र्ष्णी सा न̱ः सुप्रा̍ची सुप्र̍तीची भव
35.m: You are thought; you are mind; you are insight; you are the sacrificial gift; you belong to princely power; you are worthy of sacrifice; you are Aditi, facing both ways. / Be very favorable going forward, very favorable returning to us!

35.s: mi̱trastvā̍ pa̱di ba̍dhnītāṃ pū̱ṣādhva̍naspātvindrāyādhya̍kṣāya anu̍ tvā mā̱tā ma̍nyatā̱manu̍ pi̱tānu̱ bhrātā̱ saga̱rbhyo'nu̱ sakhā̱ sayū̍thyaḥ
35.d: मि̱त्रस्त्वा̍ प̱दि ब̍ध्नीतां पू̱षाध्व̍नस्पात्विन्द्रायाध्य̍क्षाय अनु̍ त्वा मा̱ता म̍न्यता̱मनु̍ पि̱तानु̱ भ्राता̱ सग̱र्भ्योऽनु̱ सखा̱ सयू̍थ्यः
35.m:
May Mitra bind you by the foot; may Pūṣan protect the paths for Indra, the overseer.
May your mother consent to you, your father, your brother from the same womb, and your companion from the same herd.

35.s: sā de̍vi de̱vamacche̱hīndrā̍ya̱ soma̍m | ru̱drastvā̱ varta̍yatu sva̱sti some̱sakhā̱ puna̱rehi̍
35.d: सा दे̍वि दे̱वमच्छे̱हीन्द्रा̍य̱ सोम̍म् । रु̱द्रस्त्वा̱ वर्त̍यतु स्व̱स्ति सोमे̱सखा̱ पुन̱रेहि̍
35.m:
O goddess, go to the god, to Indra, as Soma.
May Rudra turn you back; come again in safety, companion of Soma.

36.s: (6) vasvya̍syadi̍tirasyādi̱tyāsi̍ ru̱drāsi̍ ca̱ndrāsi̍ | bṛha̱spati̍ṣṭvā su̱mne ra̍mṇātu ru̱dro vasu̍bhirācake
36.d: (6) वस्व्य̍स्यदि̍तिरस्यादि̱त्यासि̍ रु̱द्रासि̍ च̱न्द्रासि̍ । बृह̱स्पति̍ष्ट्वा सु̱म्ने र̍म्णातु रु̱द्रो वसु̍भिराचके
36.m:
You are a Vasu woman, you are Aditi, you are an Āditya woman, you are a Rudra woman, you are bright.
May Bṛhaspati delight you in benevolence; Rudra has associated himself with the Vasus.

36.s: adi̍tyāstvā mū̱rdhannāji̍gharmi devaya̱jane̍ pṛthi̱vyāḥ | iḍā̍yāspa̱dama̍si ghṛ̱tava̱t svāhā̍
36.d: अदि̍त्यास्त्वा मू̱र्धन्नाजि̍घर्मि देवय̱जने̍ पृथि̱व्याः । इडा̍यास्प̱दम̍सि घृ̱तव̱त् स्वाहा̍
36.m:
On Aditi's head I sprinkle you, on the place of divine worship of the earth.
You are the footstep of Iḷā, full of ghee, svāhā.

36.s: a̱sme ra̍masvā̱sme te̱ bandhu̍ḥ | tve rā̱yo a̱sme rāya̍ḥ
36.d: अ̱स्मे र̍मस्वा̱स्मे ते̱ बन्धु̍ः । त्वे रा̱यो अ̱स्मे राय̍ः
36.m:
Rest with us; with us is your kin.
In you are riches, with us are riches.

36.s: mā va̱yam̐ rā̱yaspoṣe̍ṇa̱ viyau̍ṣma̱ toto̍ rā̱yaḥ | sama̍khye de̱vyā dhi̱yā saṃ dakṣi̍ṇayo̱ruca̍kṣasā mā ma̱ āyu̱ḥ pramo̍ṣī̱rmo a̱haṃ tava̍ vī̱rānvi̍deya̱ tava̍ devi sa̱ṃdṛśi̍
36.d: मा व̱यम्̐ रा̱यस्पोषे̍ण̱ वियौ̍ष्म̱ तोतो̍ रा̱यः । सम̍ख्ये दे̱व्या धि̱या सं दक्षि̍णयो̱रुच̍क्षसा मा म̱ आयु̱ः प्रमो̍षी̱र्मो अ̱हं तव̍ वी̱रान्वि̍देय̱ तव̍ देवि स̱ंदृशि̍
36.m:
May we not be parted from the thriving of riches, [coming] from you, riches.
I have looked on you with divine vision, with the wide-seeing dakṣiṇā.
Do not rob my life, nor may I find heroes [lacking] of you, O goddess, in your sight.

37.s: (7) e̱ṣa te̍ gāya̱tro bhā̱ga iti̍ me somā̍ya brūtāde̱ṣa te̱ traiṣṭu̍bho bhā̱ga iti̍ me̱ somā̍ya brūtāt e̱ṣa te̱ jāga̍to bhā̱ga iti̍ me̱ somā̍ya brūtācchandomā̱nānā̱m̐ sāmrā̍jyaṃ gaccha̱tādi̍ti me̱ somā̍ya brūtāt
37.d: (7) ए̱ष ते̍ गाय̱त्रो भा̱ग इति̍ मे सोमा̍य ब्रूतादे̱ष ते̱ त्रैष्टु̍भो भा̱ग इति̍ मे̱ सोमा̍य ब्रूतात् ए̱ष ते̱ जाग̍तो भा̱ग इति̍ मे̱ सोमा̍य ब्रूताच्छन्दोमा̱नाना̱म्̐ साम्रा̍ज्यं गच्छ̱तादि̍ति मे̱ सोमा̍य ब्रूतात्
37.m:
“This is your portion in the gāyatrī metre,” say for me to Soma; “This is your portion in the triṣṭubh metre,” say for me to Soma;
“This is your portion in the jagatī metre,” say for me to Soma; “Attain the sovereignty of the chandomas,” say for me to Soma.

You belong to us; pure is your cup.
May the inspectors inspect you.

37.s: a̱bhi tyaṃ de̱vam̐ sa̍vi̱tāra̍moṇyo̍ḥ ka̱vikra̍tu̱marcā̍mi sa̱tyasa̍vam̐ ra̱tnadhā̱ma̱bhi pri̱yaṃ ma̱tiṃ ka̱vim ū̱rdhvā yasyā̱mati̱rbhā adi̍dyuta̱tsavī̍mani̱ hira̍ṇyapāṇiramimīta sukratu̍ḥ kṛ̱pā sva̍ḥ
37.d: अ̱भि त्यं दे̱वम्̐ स̍वि̱तार̍मोण्यो̍ः क̱विक्र̍तु̱मर्चा̍मि स̱त्यस̍वम्̐ र̱त्नधा̱म̱भि प्रि̱यं म̱तिं क̱विम् ऊ̱र्ध्वा यस्या̱मति̱र्भा अदि̍द्युत̱त्सवी̍मनि̱ हिर̍ण्यपाणिरमिमीत सुक्रतु̍ः कृ̱पा स्व̍ः
37.m:
Towards that divine Savitṛ, poet of poetic insight, of true impulse, who establishes treasures, towards the beloved, the wise poet, I sing;
Whose upward radiance shone forth in his impelling, the golden-handed one of good mental power has measured out heaven through his beauty.

For offspring [I take] you; may offspring breathe along after you.
Breathe along after offspring.

38.s: (8) śu̱kraṃ tvā̍ śu̱kreṇa̍ krīṇāmi ca̱ndraṃ ca̱ndreṇā̱mṛta̍ma̱mṛte̍na | sa̱gme te̱ gora̱sme te̍ ca̱ndrāṇi̍
38.d: (8) शु̱क्रं त्वा̍ शु̱क्रेण̍ क्रीणामि च̱न्द्रं च̱न्द्रेणा̱मृत̍म̱मृते̍न । स̱ग्मे ते̱ गोर̱स्मे ते̍ च̱न्द्राणि̍
38.m:
Bright one, I buy you with what is bright; pure one with what is pure; immortal one with what is immortal.
In our encounter is your cow, with us are your bright [coins].

38.s: tapa̍sasta̱nūra̍si pra̱jāpa̍te̱rvarṇa̍ḥ | pa̱ra̱meṇa̍ pa̱śunā̍ krīyase sahasrapoṣaṃ pu̍ṣeyam
38.d: तप̍सस्त̱नूर̍सि प्र̱जाप̍ते̱र्वर्ण̍ः । प̱र̱मेण̍ प̱शुना̍ क्रीयसे सहस्रपोषं पु̍षेयम्
38.m:
You are the body of ascetic heat, the color of Prajāpati.
You are bought with the supreme beast; may I thrive with a thousandfold thriving.

38.s: mi̱tro na̱ ehi̱ sumi̍tradha̱ indra̍syo̱rumāvi̍śa̱ dakṣi̍ṇam | u̱śannu̱śantam̐ syo̱naḥ syo̱nam
38.d: मि̱त्रो न̱ एहि̱ सुमि̍त्रध̱ इन्द्र̍स्यो̱रुमावि̍श̱ दक्षि̍णम् । उ̱शन्नु̱शन्तम्̐ स्यो̱नः स्यो̱नम्
38.m:
Come to us as Mitra, establishing good friendship; enter the right thigh of Indra,
Eager, into him who is eager, pleasant, into him who is pleasant.

38.s: svā̱na bhrājāṅghā̍re̱ bambhā̍re̱ hasta̱ suha̍sta̱ kṛśā̍no e̱te va̍ḥ soma̱kraya̍ṇā̱stānkṣa̍dhva̱ṃ mā vo̍ dabhan
38.d: स्वा̱न भ्राजाङ्घा̍रे̱ बम्भा̍रे̱ हस्त̱ सुह̍स्त̱ कृशा̍नो ए̱ते व̍ः सोम̱क्रय̍णा̱स्तान्क्ष̍ध्व̱ं मा वो̍ दभन्
38.m:
O Svāna, Bhrāja, Aṅghāri, Bambhāri, Hasta, Suhasta, Kṛśānu,
These are your purchases of Soma: guard them; let them not deceive you.

38.s: pari̍ māgne duśca̍ritādbādhasvā̱ mā suca̍rite bhaja | udāyu̍ṣā svāyuṣoda̍sthā̱mamṛtā̍m̐2̱ anu̍
38.d: परि̍ माग्ने दुश्च̍रिताद्बाधस्वा̱ मा सुच̍रिते भज । उदायु̍षा स्वायुषोद̍स्था̱ममृता̍म्̐2̱ अनु̍
38.m:
Ward me off, O Agni, from bad conduct; assign me to good conduct.
We have risen up with life, with good life, following the immortals.

38.s: prati̱ panthā̍mapadmahi svasti̱gāma̍ne̱hasa̍m | yena̱ viśvā̱ḥ pari̱ dviṣo̍ vṛ̱ṇakti̍ vi̱ndate̱ vasu̍
38.d: प्रति̱ पन्था̍मपद्महि स्वस्ति̱गाम̍ने̱हस̍म् । येन̱ विश्वा̱ः परि̱ द्विषो̍ वृ̱णक्ति̍ वि̱न्दते̱ वसु̍
38.m:
We have reached the path leading to well-being, free from danger,
By which one wards off all enmities and finds wealth.

39.s: adi̍tyā̱stvaga̱syādi̍tyai̱ sada̱ āsī̍da | asta̍bhnā̱dyāmṛ̍ṣa̱bho a̱ntari̍kṣamami̍mīta vari̱māṇa̍ṃ pṛthi̱vyāḥ āsī̍da̱dviśvā̱ bhuva̍nāni sa̱mrāḍviśvā̱tāni̱ varu̍ṇasya vra̱tāni̍
39.d: अदि̍त्या̱स्त्वग̱स्यादि̍त्यै̱ सद̱ आसी̍द । अस्त̍भ्ना̱द्यामृ̍ष̱भो अ̱न्तरि̍क्षममि̍मीत वरि̱माण̍ं पृथि̱व्याः आसी̍द̱द्विश्वा̱ भुव̍नानि स̱म्राड्विश्वा̱तानि̱ वरु̍णस्य व्र̱तानि̍

39.s: vane̍ṣu̱ vya̱ntari̍kṣaṃ tatāna̱ vāja̱marva̍tsu̱ paya̍ u̱sriyā̍su hṛ̱tsu kratu̱ṃ varu̍ṇo vi̱kṣva̱gniṃ di̱vi sūrya̍madadhā̱t soma̱madrau̍
39.d: वने̍षु̱ व्य̱न्तरि̍क्षं ततान̱ वाज̱मर्व̍त्सु̱ पय̍ उ̱स्रिया̍सु हृ̱त्सु क्रतु̱ं वरु̍णो वि̱क्ष्व̱ग्निं दि̱वि सूर्य̍मदधा̱त् सोम̱मद्रौ̍
39.m:
In the trees he spread out the mid-air, vital vigor in coursers, milk in the red cows;
Varuṇa set mental power in hearts, Agni among the clans, the sun in heaven, Soma on the rock.

39.s: sūrya̍sya̱ cakṣu̱rāro̍hā̱gnera̱kṣṇaḥ ka̱nīna̍kām | yatraita̍śebhi̱rīya̍se̱ bhrāja̍māno vi̱pa̱ścitā̍
39.d: सूर्य̍स्य̱ चक्षु̱रारो̍हा̱ग्नेर̱क्ष्णः क̱नीन̍काम् । यत्रैत̍शेभि̱रीय̍से̱ भ्राज̍मानो वि̱प̱श्चिता̍
39.m:
Mount the eye of the sun, the pupil of Agni's eye,
Where you travel with the bay steeds, shining through the wise one.

39.s: u̱srā e̱taṃ dhūrṣā̱hau yu̍jyethā̱mana̱śrū avī̍rahaṇau brahmacoda̍nau sva̱sti yaja̍mānasya gṛ̱hān ga̍cchatam
39.d: उ̱स्रा ए̱तं धूर्षा̱हौ यु̍ज्येथा̱मन̱श्रू अवी̍रहणौ ब्रह्मचोद̍नौ स्व̱स्ति यज̍मानस्य गृ̱हान् ग̍च्छतम्
39.m:
O two bright ones, go together, bearing the yoke; be yoked, tearless, not slaying heroes, impelling the sacred formulation.
Go in safety to the sacrificer's house.

You are auspicious to me; move forward, O lord of becoming, towards all dwellings.
Let not robbers find you, let not highwaymen find you, let not evil wolves find you.
Becoming a falcon, fly away; go to the house of the sacrificer: that is prepared for both of us.

39.s: namo̍ mi̱trasya̱ varu̍ṇasya̱ cakṣa̍se ma̱ho de̱vāya̱ tadṛtam̐ sa̍paryata dū̱re̱dṛśe̍ de̱vajā̍tāya ke̱tave̍ di̱vaspu̱trāya̱ sūryā̍ya śam̐sata
39.d: नमो̍ मि̱त्रस्य̱ वरु̍णस्य̱ चक्ष̍से म̱हो दे̱वाय̱ तदृतम्̐ स̍पर्यत दू̱रे̱दृशे̍ दे̱वजा̍ताय के̱तवे̍ दि̱वस्पु̱त्राय̱ सूर्या̍य शम्̐सत
39.m:
Homage to the eye of Mitra and Varuṇa, to the great god: worship that truth.
Praise the sun, far-seeing, born of the gods, the banner, the son of heaven.

39.s: varu̍ṇasyottambha̍namasi̱ varu̍ṇasya skambhasarja̍nī sthaḥ varu̍ṇasya ṛta̱sada̍nyasi̱ varu̍ṇasya ṛta̱sada̍namasi̱ varu̍ṇasya ṛta̱sada̍nīmāsī̍da
39.d: वरु̍णस्योत्तम्भ̍नमसि̱ वरु̍णस्य स्कम्भसर्ज̍नी स्थः वरु̍णस्य ऋत̱सद̍न्यसि̱ वरु̍णस्य ऋत̱सद̍नमसि̱ वरु̍णस्य ऋत̱सद̍नीमासी̍द
39.m:
You are Varuṇa's prop; you two are Varuṇa's prop-fasteners.
You are Varuṇa's seat of cosmic order; you are Varuṇa's seat of cosmic order; sit on Varuṇa's seat of cosmic order.

39.s:
yā te̱ dhāmā̍ni ha̱viṣā̱ yaja̍nti̱ tā te̱ viśvā̍ pari̱bhūra̍stu ya̱jñam ga̱ya̱sphāna̍: pra̱tara̍ṇaḥ suvī̱ro'vī̍rahā pra̱carā̍ so̱ma̱ duryā̍n
(10) edamaganma tisraḥ
mahīṃnāṃ catasraḥ
ākūtyai dve
ṛksāmayoścatasraḥ
39.d:
या ते̱ धामा̍नि ह̱विषा̱ यज̍न्ति̱ ता ते̱ विश्वा̍ परि̱भूर̍स्तु य̱ज्ञम् ग̱य̱स्फान̍: प्र̱तर̍णः सुवी̱रोऽवी̍रहा प्र̱चरा̍ सो̱म̱ दुर्या̍न्
(10) एदमगन्म तिस्रः
महींनां चतस्रः
आकूत्यै द्वे
ऋक्सामयोश्चतस्रः
39.m:
Whatever abodes of yours they sacrifice to with oblation, let all of them encompass your sacrifice.
Making households thrive, advancing, possessing good heroes, not slaying heroes, go forth, O Soma, through the doors.

39.s:
vrataṃ kṛṇuta nava
eṣā te pañca
vasvasyasi catasraḥ
eṣa te catasraḥ
caṃdraṃ tvā ṣaṭ
adityastvagaṣṭa
39.d:
व्रतं कृणुत नव
एषा ते पञ्च
वस्वस्यसि चतस्रः
एष ते चतस्रः
चंद्रं त्वा षट्
अदित्यस्त्वगष्ट

40.s: agne̍sta̱nūra̍si̱ viṣṇa̍ve tvā̱ soma̍sya ta̱nūra̍si̱ viṣṇa̍ve tvā ati̍therāti̱thyama̍si̱ viṣṇa̍ve tvā śye̱nāya̍ tvā soma̱bhṛte̍ viṣṇa̍ve tvā̱gnaye̍ tvā rāyaspo̱ṣade̱ viṣṇa̍ve tvā
40.d: अग्ने̍स्त̱नूर̍सि̱ विष्ण̍वे त्वा̱ सोम̍स्य त̱नूर̍सि̱ विष्ण̍वे त्वा अति̍थेराति̱थ्यम̍सि̱ विष्ण̍वे त्वा श्ये̱नाय̍ त्वा सोम̱भृते̍ विष्ण̍वे त्वा̱ग्नये̍ त्वा रायस्पो̱षदे̱ विष्ण̍वे त्वा
40.m:
You are Agni's body, for Viṣṇu [I take] you; you are Soma's body, for Viṣṇu [I take] you.
You are the guest's hospitality, for Viṣṇu [I take] you; for the falcon bringing Soma, for Viṣṇu [I take] you; for Agni, giver of thriving of wealth, for Viṣṇu [I take] you.

40.s: a̱gnerjani̍tramasi̱ vṛṣa̍ṇau sthaḥ | u̱rvaśya̍syā̱yura̍si purū̱ravā̍ asi gā̱ya̱treṇa̍ tvā̱ chanda̍sā manthāmi̱ traiṣṭu̍bhena tvā̱ chanda̍sā manthāmi jāga̍tena tvā̱ chanda̍sā manthāmi
40.d: अ̱ग्नेर्जनि̍त्रमसि̱ वृष̍णौ स्थः । उ̱र्वश्य̍स्या̱युर̍सि पुरू̱रवा̍ असि गा̱य̱त्रेण̍ त्वा̱ छन्द̍सा मन्थामि̱ त्रैष्टु̍भेन त्वा̱ छन्द̍सा मन्थामि जाग̍तेन त्वा̱ छन्द̍सा मन्थामि
40.m:
You are the birthplace of Agni; you two are the stallions; you are Urvaśī, you are Āyu, you are Purūravas.
With the gāyatrī metre I churn you; with the triṣṭubh metre I churn you; with the jagatī metre I churn you.

40.s: bhava̍taṃ na̱ḥ sama̍nasau̱ sace̍tasāvare̱pasau̍ mā ya̱jñam̐ hi̍ṃsiṣṭa̱ṃ mā ya̱jñapa̍tiṃ jātavedasau śi̱vau bha̍vatama̱dya na̍ :
40.d: भव̍तं न̱ः सम̍नसौ̱ सचे̍तसावरे̱पसौ̍ मा य̱ज्ञम्̐ हि̍ंसिष्ट̱ं मा य̱ज्ञप̍तिं जातवेदसौ शि̱वौ भ̍वतम̱द्य न̍ :
40.m:
Be of one mind with us, of one thought, unstained.
Do not harm the sacrifice, do not harm the lord of sacrifice, O you two Jātavedases; be auspicious to us today.

40.s: a̱gnā a̱gniśca̍rati̱ pravi̍ṣṭa̱ ṛṣī̍ṇāṃ pu̱tro a̍bhiśasti̱pāvā̍ sa na̍: syo̱naḥ su̱yajā̍ yaje̱ha de̱vebhyo̍ ha̱vyam̐ sada̱mapra̍yuccha̱ntsvāhā̍
40.d: अ̱ग्ना अ̱ग्निश्च̍रति̱ प्रवि̍ष्ट̱ ऋषी̍णां पु̱त्रो अ̍भिशस्ति̱पावा̍ स न̍: स्यो̱नः सु̱यजा̍ यजे̱ह दे̱वेभ्यो̍ ह̱व्यम्̐ सद̱मप्र̍युच्छ̱न्त्स्वाहा̍
40.m:
Agni has entered into Agni, son of the ṛṣis, guardian against curse.
He, gracious to us, sacrificing well, sacrifice here the oblation to the gods, never neglecting them, svāhā.

41.s: (1) āpa̍taye tvā gṛhṇāmi̱ pari̍pataye tvā gṛhṇāmi | tanūna̱ptre śākva̱rāya̱ śakma̱nnoji̍ṣṭhāya
41.d: (1) आप̍तये त्वा गृह्णामि̱ परि̍पतये त्वा गृह्णामि । तनून̱प्त्रे शाक्व̱राय̱ शक्म̱न्नोजि̍ष्ठाय
41.m:
For the lord of descending I take you; for the lord of surrounding I take you;
For Tanūnapāt, the mighty, most powerful in strength.

You are unassailed, the unassailable power of the gods,
Free from curse, guardian against curse, not to be cursed.

41.s: añja̍sā sa̱tyamupa̍geṣam̐ suvi̱te mā̍ dhāḥ | agne̍ vrata̱pāstve vra̍ta̱pāḥ
41.d: अञ्ज̍सा स̱त्यमुप̍गेषम्̐ सुवि̱ते मा̍ धाः । अग्ने̍ व्रत̱पास्त्वे व्र̍त̱पाः
41.m:
Directly have I approached the truth; place me in good fortune.
O Agni, guardian of vows, in you are guardians of vows.

41.s: yā tava̍ ta̱nūri̱yam̐ sā mayi̱ yā mama̍ ta̱nūre̱ṣā sā tvayi̍ sa̱ha nau̍ vratapate vra̱tānyanu̍ me dī̱kṣāṃ dī̱kṣāpa̍tirmanyatā̱manu̱ tapa̱stapa̍spatiḥ
41.d: या तव̍ त̱नूरि̱यम्̐ सा मयि̱ या मम̍ त̱नूरे̱षा सा त्वयि̍ स̱ह नौ̍ व्रतपते व्र̱तान्यनु̍ मे दी̱क्षां दी̱क्षाप̍तिर्मन्यता̱मनु̱ तप̱स्तप̍स्पतिः
41.m:
That body of yours which is this is in me; this body of mine which is this is in you.
Together, O lord of vows, may our vows be; may the lord of consecration consent to my consecration, the lord of ascetic heat to my ascetic heat.

41.s: a̱m̐śum̐ra̍m̐śuṣṭe deva so̱māpyā̍yatā̱mindrā̍yaikadhana̱vide̍ ā tubhya̱mindra̍ḥ pyāya̍tā̱mā tvamindrā̍ya pyāyasva
41.d: अ̱म्̐शुम्̐र̍म्̐शुष्टे देव सो̱माप्या̍यता̱मिन्द्रा̍यैकधन̱विदे̍ आ तुभ्य̱मिन्द्र̍ः प्याय̍ता̱मा त्वमिन्द्रा̍य प्यायस्व
41.m:
May stalk by stalk swell for you, divine Soma, for Indra who finds the single portion of wealth.
May Indra swell for you; swell for Indra.

41.s: ā̱pyāya̍yā̱smān sakhī̍ntsa̱nyā me̱dhayā̍ | sva̱sti te̍ deva soma su̱tyāmu̱dṛca̍maśīya
41.d: आ̱प्याय̍या̱स्मान् सखी̍न्त्स̱न्या मे̱धया̍ । स्व̱स्ति ते̍ देव सोम सु̱त्यामु̱दृच̍मशीय
41.m:
Make us, your friends, swell with acquisition, with wisdom.
In safety, O divine Soma, may I reach the completion of your pressing.

41.s: e̱ṣṭā rā̱yaḥ preṣe bhagā̍ya | ṛ̱tamṛ̍tavā̱dibhyo̱ namo̍ di̱ve nama̍ḥ pṛthi̱vyai
41.d: ए̱ष्टा रा̱यः प्रेषे भगा̍य । ऋ̱तमृ̍तवा̱दिभ्यो̱ नमो̍ दि̱वे नम̍ः पृथि̱व्यै
41.m:
Sought are riches, for sending forth, for Bhaga.
Cosmic order for those who speak cosmic order; homage to heaven, homage to earth.

41.s: yā te̍ agne̱ yaḥ śa̱yā ta̱nūrvarṣi̍ṣṭhā gahva̱reṣṭhā | u̱graṃ vaco̱ apā̍vadhīttve̱ṣaṃ vaco̱ apā̍vadhī̱t svāhā̍ yā te̍ agne̱ raja̍ḥśa̱yā ta̱nūrvarṣi̍ṣṭhā gahva̱reṣṭhā | u̱graṃ vaco̱ apā̍vadhīttve̱ṣaṃ vaco̱ apā̍vadhī̱t svāhā̍ yā te̍ agne̱ harī̍śa̱yā ta̱nūrvarṣi̍ṣṭhā gahva̱reṣṭhā u̱graṃ vaco̱ apā̍vadhīttve̱ṣaṃ vaco̱ apā̍vadhī̱t svāhā̍
41.d: या ते̍ अग्ने̱ यः श̱या त̱नूर्वर्षि̍ष्ठा गह्व̱रेष्ठा । उ̱ग्रं वचो̱ अपा̍वधीत्त्वे̱षं वचो̱ अपा̍वधी̱त् स्वाहा̍ या ते̍ अग्ने̱ रज̍ःश̱या त̱नूर्वर्षि̍ष्ठा गह्व̱रेष्ठा । उ̱ग्रं वचो̱ अपा̍वधीत्त्वे̱षं वचो̱ अपा̍वधी̱त् स्वाहा̍ या ते̍ अग्ने̱ हरी̍श̱या त̱नूर्वर्षि̍ष्ठा गह्व̱रेष्ठा उ̱ग्रं वचो̱ अपा̍वधीत्त्वे̱षं वचो̱ अपा̍वधी̱त् स्वाहा̍
41.m:
That body of yours, Agni, which rests in iron, highest, dwelling in the deep:
it has struck away harsh speech, it has struck away fiery speech, svāhā!
That body of yours, Agni, which rests in silver, highest, dwelling in the deep:
it has struck away harsh speech, it has struck away fiery speech, svāhā!
That body of yours, Agni, which rests in gold, highest, dwelling in the deep:
it has struck away harsh speech, it has struck away fiery speech, svāhā!

42.s: ta̱ptāya̍nī me'si vi̱ttāya̍nī me'si | a̱va̱tānmā vyathi̱tamava̍tānmā nāthi̱tam
42.d: त̱प्ताय̍नी मेऽसि वि̱त्ताय̍नी मेऽसि । अ̱व̱तान्मा व्यथि̱तमव̍तान्मा नाथि̱तम्
42.m: You are my course in heating; you are my course in finding. Protect me from distress, protect me when seeking help.

42.s: vi̱dera̱gnernabho̱ nāmā̍gne̱ aṅgira̱ āyu̍nā nāmnehi̍ yo'syāṃ pṛ̍thi̱vyāmasi̱ yatte̱nādhṛ̍ṣṭa̱ṃ nāma̍ ya̱jñiya̱ṃ tena̱ tvā da̍dhe vi̱dera̱gnernabho̱ nāmā̍gne̱ aṅgira̱ āyu̍nā nāmnehi̍ yo dvi̱tīyā̍syāṃ pṛ̍thi̱vyāmasi̱ yatte̱nādhṛ̍ṣṭa̱ṃ nāma̍ ya̱jñiya̱ṃ tena̱ tvā da̍dhe vi̱dera̱gnernabho̱ nāmā̍gne̱ aṅgira̱ āyu̍nā nāmnehi̍ yastṛ̱tīyā̍syāṃ pṛ̍thi̱vyāmasi̱ yatte̱nādhṛ̍ṣṭa̱ṃ nāma̍ ya̱jñiya̱ṃ tena̱ tvā da̍dhe anu̍ tvā devavī̍taye si̱m̐hya̍si sapatnasā̱hī de̱vebhya̍ḥ kalpasva si̱m̐hya̍si sapatnasā̱hī de̱vebhya̍ḥ śundhasva si̱m̐hya̍si sapatnasā̱hī de̱vebhya̍ḥ śumbhasva
42.d: वि̱देर̱ग्नेर्नभो̱ नामा̍ग्ने̱ अङ्गिर̱ आयु̍ना नाम्नेहि̍ योऽस्यां पृ̍थि̱व्यामसि̱ यत्ते̱नाधृ̍ष्ट̱ं नाम̍ य̱ज्ञिय̱ं तेन̱ त्वा द̍धे वि̱देर̱ग्नेर्नभो̱ नामा̍ग्ने̱ अङ्गिर̱ आयु̍ना नाम्नेहि̍ यो द्वि̱तीया̍स्यां पृ̍थि̱व्यामसि̱ यत्ते̱नाधृ̍ष्ट̱ं नाम̍ य̱ज्ञिय̱ं तेन̱ त्वा द̍धे वि̱देर̱ग्नेर्नभो̱ नामा̍ग्ने̱ अङ्गिर̱ आयु̍ना नाम्नेहि̍ यस्तृ̱तीया̍स्यां पृ̍थि̱व्यामसि̱ यत्ते̱नाधृ̍ष्ट̱ं नाम̍ य̱ज्ञिय̱ं तेन̱ त्वा द̍धे अनु̍ त्वा देववी̍तये सि̱म्̐ह्य̍सि सपत्नसा̱ही दे̱वेभ्य̍ः कल्पस्व सि̱म्̐ह्य̍सि सपत्नसा̱ही दे̱वेभ्य̍ः शुन्धस्व सि̱म्̐ह्य̍सि सपत्नसा̱ही दे̱वेभ्य̍ः शुम्भस्व
42.m:
Find the name of Agni, Nabhas! Agni Aṅgiras, come with the name Āyu!
You who are in this earth, with that unassailable name of yours worthy of sacrifice, with that I place you.
Find the name of Agni, Nabhas! Agni Aṅgiras, come with the name Āyu!
You who are in the second earth, with that unassailable name of yours worthy of sacrifice, with that I place you.
Find the name of Agni, Nabhas! Agni Aṅgiras, come with the name Āyu!
You who are in the third earth, with that unassailable name of yours worthy of sacrifice, with that I place you.
According to the banquet of the gods! You are a lioness overcoming rivals; prepare yourself for the gods. You are a lioness overcoming rivals; purify yourself for the gods. You are a lioness overcoming rivals; adorn yourself for the gods.

43.s: indra̍ghoṣastvā vasu̍bhiḥ pu̱rastā̍tpātu̱ prace̍tāstvā ru̱draiḥ pa̱ścātpā̍tu mano̍javāstvā pi̱tṛbhi̍rdakṣiṇa̱taḥ pā̍tu vi̱śvaka̍rmā tvādityairu̍ttara̱taḥ pā̍tu
43.d: इन्द्र̍घोषस्त्वा वसु̍भिः पु̱रस्ता̍त्पातु̱ प्रचे̍तास्त्वा रु̱द्रैः प̱श्चात्पा̍तु मनो̍जवास्त्वा पि̱तृभि̍र्दक्षिण̱तः पा̍तु वि̱श्वक̍र्मा त्वादित्यैरु̍त्तर̱तः पा̍तु
43.m:
May Indraghoṣa protect you with the Vasus from the east; may Pracetas protect you with the Rudras from the west.
May Manojavas protect you with the Fathers from the south; may Viśvakarman protect you with the Ādityas from the north.

43.s: i̱dama̱haṃ ta̱ptaṃ vārba̍hi̱rdhā ya̱jñānniḥ sṛ̍jāmi si̱m̐hya̍si̱ svāhā̍ si̱m̐hya̍syāditya̱vani̱ḥ svāhā̍
43.d: इ̱दम̱हं त̱प्तं वार्ब̍हि̱र्धा य̱ज्ञान्निः सृ̍जामि सि̱म्̐ह्य̍सि̱ स्वाहा̍ सि̱म्̐ह्य̍स्यादित्य̱वनि̱ः स्वाहा̍
43.m:
Here I pour out the heated water outside the sacrifice.
You are a lioness, svāhā! You are a lioness winning the Ādityas, svāhā!

43.s: si̱m̐hya̍si brahma̱vani̍ḥ kṣatra̱vani̱ḥ svāhā̍ si̱m̐hya̍si suprajā̱vanī̍ rāyaspoṣa̱vani̱ḥ svāhā̍ si̱m̐hya̍syāva̍ha de̱vānyaja̍mānāya̱ svāhā̍ bhū̱tebhya̍stvā
43.d: सि̱म्̐ह्य̍सि ब्रह्म̱वनि̍ः क्षत्र̱वनि̱ः स्वाहा̍ सि̱म्̐ह्य̍सि सुप्रजा̱वनी̍ रायस्पोष̱वनि̱ः स्वाहा̍ सि̱म्̐ह्य̍स्याव̍ह दे̱वान्यज̍मानाय̱ स्वाहा̍ भू̱तेभ्य̍स्त्वा
43.m:
You are a lioness winning Brahman, winning princely power, svāhā! You are a lioness winning good offspring, winning abundance of wealth, svāhā!
You are a lioness; bring here the gods for the sacrificer, svāhā! For the beings [I offer] you.

43.s: dhru̱vo̍'si pṛthi̱vīṃ dṛ̍ṃm̐ha dhru̱vakṣi̍dasya̱ntari̍kṣaṃ dṛm̐ha acyu̍takṣida̍si di̱vaṃ dṛ̍ṃm̐hā̱gnerbhasma̍sya̱gneḥ purī̍ṣamasi
43.d: ध्रु̱वो̍ऽसि पृथि̱वीं दृ̍ंम्̐ह ध्रु̱वक्षि̍दस्य̱न्तरि̍क्षं दृम्̐ह अच्यु̍तक्षिद̍सि दि̱वं दृ̍ंम्̐हा̱ग्नेर्भस्म̍स्य̱ग्नेः पुरी̍षमसि
43.m:
You are firm, make the earth firm. You dwell firmly, make the mid-air firm.
You dwell immovably, make heaven firm. You are Agni's ashes, you are Agni's loose earth.

44.s: yu̱ñjate̱ mana̍ u̱ta yu̍ñjate̱ dhiyo̱ viprā̱ vipra̍sya bṛha̱to vi̍pa̱ścita̍ḥ vi hotrā̍ dadhe vayunā̱videka̱ inma̱hī de̱vasya̍ savi̱tuḥ pari̍ṣṭutiḥ
44.d: यु̱ञ्जते̱ मन̍ उ̱त यु̍ञ्जते̱ धियो̱ विप्रा̱ विप्र̍स्य बृह̱तो वि̍प̱श्चित̍ः वि होत्रा̍ दधे वयुना̱विदेक̱ इन्म̱ही दे̱वस्य̍ सवि̱तुः परि̍ष्टुतिः
44.m:
The inspired poets yoke their mind and yoke their visions, / the inspired poets of the great, insightful inspired poet.
He alone who knows the ordinances arranges the priestly offices; / great is the praise of the divine Savitṛ.

44.s: i̱daṃ viṣṇurvica̍krame tre̱dhā ni da̍dhe pa̱dam | samū̍ḷahamasya pām̐su̱re svāhā̍
44.d: इ̱दं विष्णुर्विच̍क्रमे त्रे̱धा नि द̍धे प̱दम् । समू̍ऌअहमस्य पाम्̐सु̱रे स्वाहा̍
44.m:
Through this Viṣṇu strode out; thrice he planted his foot.
[The whole world] was gathered in its dust, svāhā!

44.s: i̱rāvatī̍ dhe̱numatī̱ hi bhū̱tam̐ sū̍yava̱sinī̱ mana̍ve daśa̱syā vya̍skabhnā̱ roda̍sī̱ viṣṇve̱te dā̱dhartha̍ pṛthi̱vīma̱bhito̍ ma̱yūkhai̱ḥ svāhā̍
44.d: इ̱रावती̍ धे̱नुमती̱ हि भू̱तम्̐ सू̍यव̱सिनी̱ मन̍वे दश̱स्या व्य̍स्कभ्ना̱ रोद̍सी̱ विष्ण्वे̱ते दा̱धर्थ̍ पृथि̱वीम̱भितो̍ म̱यूखै̱ः स्वाहा̍
44.m:
Be rich in refreshing nourishment, rich in milk, / rich in good pasture, bountiful to Manu.
You propped apart the two world-halves, O Viṣṇu; / these two you have held fast, the earth all around with pegs, svāhā!

44.s: de̱va̱śrutau̍ de̱veṣvāghoṣatam | prācī̱ preta̍madhva̱raṃ ka̱lpaya̍ntī ū̱rdhvaṃ ya̱jñaṃ na̍yataṃ mā ji̍hvaratam
44.d: दे̱व̱श्रुतौ̍ दे̱वेष्वाघोषतम् । प्राची̱ प्रेत̍मध्व̱रं क̱ल्पय̍न्ती ऊ̱र्ध्वं य̱ज्ञं न̍यतं मा जि̍ह्वरतम्
44.m: Heard by the gods, proclaim among the gods! Go forward, facing east, making the sacrifice fit; lead the sacrifice upward; do not falter.

44.s: svaṃ goṣṭhamāva̍dataṃ devī durye̱ āyu̍rmā nirva̍diṣṭaṃ pra̱jāṃ mā nirva̍diṣṭam atra̍ ramethā̱ṃ varṣma̍n pṛthi̱vyāḥ
44.d: स्वं गोष्ठमाव̍दतं देवी दुर्ये̱ आयु̍र्मा निर्व̍दिष्टं प्र̱जां मा निर्व̍दिष्टम् अत्र̍ रमेथा̱ं वर्ष्म̍न् पृथि̱व्याः
44.m:
Proclaim your own stall, divine doors; do not speak away life, do not speak away offspring.
Take your delight here on the heights of the earth.

44.s: viṣṇornuka̍ṃ vī̱ryā̍ṇi̱ pravo̍ca̱ṃ yaḥ pārthi̍vāni vima̱me rajā̍ṃm̐si yo aska̍bhāya̱dutta̍ram̐ sa̱dhastha̍ṃ vicakramā̱ṇastre̱dhoru̍gā̱yo viṣṇa̍ve tvā
44.d: विष्णोर्नुक̍ं वी̱र्या̍णि̱ प्रवो̍च̱ं यः पार्थि̍वानि विम̱मे रजा̍ंम्̐सि यो अस्क̍भाय̱दुत्त̍रम्̐ स̱धस्थ̍ं विचक्रमा̱णस्त्रे̱धोरु̍गा̱यो विष्ण̍वे त्वा
44.m:
Now indeed I shall proclaim the heroic deeds of Viṣṇu, who measured out the earthly spaces,
who propped the upper dwelling-place, striding out threefold, wide-striding! For Viṣṇu, you!

44.s: di̱vo vā̍ viṣṇa u̱ta vā̍ pṛthi̱vyā ma̱ho vā̍ viṣṇa u̱rora̱ntari̍kṣāt u̱bhā hi hastā̱ vasu̍nā pṛ̱ṇasvā praya̍ccha̱ dakṣi̍ṇā̱dota sa̱vyādviṣṇa̍ve tvā
44.d: दि̱वो वा̍ विष्ण उ̱त वा̍ पृथि̱व्या म̱हो वा̍ विष्ण उ̱रोर̱न्तरि̍क्षात् उ̱भा हि हस्ता̱ वसु̍ना पृ̱णस्वा प्रय̍च्छ̱ दक्षि̍णा̱दोत स̱व्याद्विष्ण̍वे त्वा
44.m:
Either from heaven, O Viṣṇu, or from earth, or from the great wide mid-air, O Viṣṇu:
fill both your hands with treasure, and bestow it from the right and from the left! For Viṣṇu, you!

44.s: pra tadviṣṇu̍ stavate vī̱rye̍ṇa mṛ̱go na bhī̱maḥ ku̍ca̱ro gi̍ri̱ṣṭhāḥ yasyo̱ruṣu̍ tri̱ṣu vi̱krama̍ṇeṣvadhikṣiyanti̱ bhuva̍nāni̱ viśvā̍
44.d: प्र तद्विष्णु̍ स्तवते वी̱र्ये̍ण मृ̱गो न भी̱मः कु̍च̱रो गि̍रि̱ष्ठाः यस्यो̱रुषु̍ त्रि̱षु वि̱क्रम̍णेष्वधिक्षियन्ति̱ भुव̍नानि̱ विश्वा̍
44.m:
For this deed Viṣṇu is praised for his heroic strength, like a terrifying wild beast roaming at will, dwelling on the mountains,
in whose three wide strides dwell all living creatures.

44.s: viṣṇau̍ rarā̱ṭa̍masi̱ viṣṇo̱ḥ śnaptre̍ stho̱ viṣṇo̱ḥ syūra̍si̱ viṣṇau̍rdhru̱vo̍'si vai̱ṣṇa̱vama̍si̱ viṣṇa̍ve tvā
44.d: विष्णौ̍ ररा̱ट̍मसि̱ विष्णो̱ः श्नप्त्रे̍ स्थो̱ विष्णो̱ः स्यूर̍सि̱ विष्णौ̍र्ध्रु̱वो̍ऽसि वै̱ष्ण̱वम̍सि̱ विष्ण̍वे त्वा
44.m:
You are Viṣṇu's forehead; you two are Viṣṇu's mouth-corners; you are Viṣṇu's seam; you are Viṣṇu's firm [knot].
You belong to Viṣṇu; for Viṣṇu, you!

45.s: (5) de̱vasya̍ tvā savi̱tuḥ pra̍sa̱ve'śvinau̍rbā̱hubhyā̍ṃ pū̱ṣṇo hastā̍bhyām āda̍de nā̱rya̍sīda̱maham̐ rakṣa̍so grī̱vā api̍kṛntāmi bṛ̱hanna̍si bṛ̱hadgra̍vā bṛ̱hatīmindrā̍ya̱ vāca̍ṃ vada | rakṣo̱haṇa̍ṃ valaga̱hana̍ṃ vaiṣṇa̱vīm
45.d: (5) दे̱वस्य̍ त्वा सवि̱तुः प्र̍स̱वेऽश्विनौ̍र्बा̱हुभ्या̍ं पू̱ष्णो हस्ता̍भ्याम् आद̍दे ना̱र्य̍सीद̱महम्̐ रक्ष̍सो ग्री̱वा अपि̍कृन्तामि बृ̱हन्न̍सि बृ̱हद्ग्र̍वा बृ̱हतीमिन्द्रा̍य̱ वाच̍ं वद । रक्षो̱हण̍ं वलग̱हन̍ं वैष्ण̱वीम्
45.m:
At the impulse of divine Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan,
I take you. You are a woman. Here do I cut off the neck of the demon.
You are lofty, lofty-voiced; speak a lofty speech for Indra, slayer of demons, destroyer of charms, belonging to Viṣṇu.

45.s: i̱dama̱haṃ taṃ va̍laga̱mudva̍pāmi̱ yanno̱ niṣṭyo̱ yamamātyo̍ ni̱cakhā̱na̍ i̱dama̱haṃ taṃ va̍laga̱mudva̍pāmi̱ yaṃ na̍ḥ samā̱no yamasa̍māno ni̱cakhā̱na̍ i̱dama̱haṃ taṃ va̍laga̱mudva̍pāmi̱ yaṃ na̱ḥ saba̍ndhu̱ryamasa̍bandhu̱rnica̱khā̱na̍ i̱dama̱haṃ taṃ va̍laga̱mudva̍pāmi̱ yaṃ na̍ḥ sa̱jāto yamasa̍jāto ni̱cakhā̱notkṛtyā̍ṃ kirāmi
45.d: इ̱दम̱हं तं व̍लग̱मुद्व̍पामि̱ यन्नो̱ निष्ट्यो̱ यममात्यो̍ नि̱चखा̱न̍ इ̱दम̱हं तं व̍लग̱मुद्व̍पामि̱ यं न̍ः समा̱नो यमस̍मानो नि̱चखा̱न̍ इ̱दम̱हं तं व̍लग̱मुद्व̍पामि̱ यं न̱ः सब̍न्धु̱र्यमस̍बन्धु̱र्निच̱खा̱न̍ इ̱दम̱हं तं व̍लग̱मुद्व̍पामि̱ यं न̍ः स̱जातो यमस̍जातो नि̱चखा̱नोत्कृत्या̍ं किरामि
45.m:
Here I unearth that charm which a stranger or an inmate has buried.
Here I unearth that charm which an equal or an unequal has buried.
Here I unearth that charm which a kinsman or a non-kinsman has buried.
Here I unearth that charm which one of our own clan or not of our clan has buried. I scatter the witchcraft away!

45.s: sva̱rāḷa̍si sapatna̱hā sa̱ṃtrarāḷa̍syabhimāti̱hā | ja̱na̱rāḷa̍si rakṣo̱hā sa̍rva̱rāḷa̍syamitra̱hā
45.d: स्व̱राऌअ̍सि सपत्न̱हा स̱ंत्रराऌअ̍स्यभिमाति̱हा । ज̱न̱राऌअ̍सि रक्षो̱हा स̍र्व̱राऌअ̍स्यमित्र̱हा
45.m: You are self-ruling, slayer of rivals; you are ruling over all, slayer of the plotter. You are ruling over people, slayer of demons; you are sovereign ruler, slayer of enemies.

45.s: rakṣo̱haṇau̍ valaga̱hanau̱ prokṣā̍mi vaiṣṇa̱vāntra̍kṣo̱haṇau̍ valaga̱hano̍'va̍nayāmi vaiṣṇa̱vān rakṣo̱haṇau̍ valaga̱hano̍'va̍stṛṇāmi vaiṣṇa̱vān
45.d: रक्षो̱हणौ̍ वलग̱हनौ̱ प्रोक्षा̍मि वैष्ण̱वान्त्र̍क्षो̱हणौ̍ वलग̱हनो̍ऽव̍नयामि वैष्ण̱वान् रक्षो̱हणौ̍ वलग̱हनो̍ऽव̍स्तृणामि वैष्ण̱वान्
45.m:
Demon-slaying, charm-destroying, I sprinkle the [posts] belonging to Viṣṇu. Demon-slaying, charm-destroying, I pour [water] into the [holes] belonging to Viṣṇu.
Demon-slaying, charm-destroying, I strew [grass into the holes] belonging to Viṣṇu.

Demon-slaying, charm-destroying, I set down [the two pressing-boards] belonging to Viṣṇu. Demon-slaying, charm-destroying, I bank up [the earth around the two boards] belonging to Viṣṇu.
You belong to Viṣṇu; you all belong to Viṣṇu.

45.s: rakṣo̱haṇau̍ valaga̱hanā̱ upa̍dadhāmi vaiṣṇa̱vī rakṣo̱haṇau̍ valaga̱hanau̱ paryū̍hāmi vaiṣṇa̱vī vai̱ṣṇa̱vama̍si vaiṣṇa̱vā stha̍
45.d: रक्षो̱हणौ̍ वलग̱हना̱ उप̍दधामि वैष्ण̱वी रक्षो̱हणौ̍ वलग̱हनौ̱ पर्यू̍हामि वैष्ण̱वी वै̱ष्ण̱वम̍सि वैष्ण̱वा स्थ̍

46.s: (6) de̱vasya̍ tvā savi̱tuḥ pra̍sa̱ve'śvino̍rbā̱hubhyā̍ṃ pū̱ṣṇo hastā̍bhyām āda̍de̱ nārya̍sīda̱maha̍m̐rakṣa̍so grī̱vā api̍kṛntāmi | yavo̍'si ya̱vayā̱smad dveṣo̍ ya̱vayārā̍tīḥ di̱ve tvā̱ntari̍kṣāya tvā pṛthi̱vyai tvā̍
46.d: (6) दे̱वस्य̍ त्वा सवि̱तुः प्र̍स̱वेऽश्विनो̍र्बा̱हुभ्या̍ं पू̱ष्णो हस्ता̍भ्याम् आद̍दे̱ नार्य̍सीद̱मह̍म्̐रक्ष̍सो ग्री̱वा अपि̍कृन्तामि । यवो̍ऽसि य̱वया̱स्मद् द्वेषो̍ य̱वयारा̍तीः दि̱वे त्वा̱न्तरि̍क्षाय त्वा पृथि̱व्यै त्वा̍
46.m:
At the impulse of divine Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan,
I take you. You are a woman. Here do I cut off the neck of the demon. You are barley; ward off from us malice, ward off enemies.
For heaven, you; for mid-air, you; for earth, you!

46.s: śundha̍ntām̐llo̱kāḥ pi̍tṛ̱ṣada̍nāḥ pi̱tṛ̱ṣada̍namasi udi̍vam̐m̐stabhānāntari̍kṣaṃ pṛ̱ṇa dṛm̐ha̍sva pṛthi̱vyām
46.d: शुन्ध̍न्ताम्̐ल्लो̱काः पि̍तृ̱षद̍नाः पि̱तृ̱षद̍नमसि उदि̍वम्̐म्̐स्तभानान्तरि̍क्षं पृ̱ण दृम्̐ह̍स्व पृथि̱व्याम्
46.m:
May the worlds where the Fathers sit be cleansed! You are the seat of the Fathers.
Prop heaven aloft, fill the mid-air, make yourself firm upon earth.

46.s: dyu̱tānastvā̍ māru̱to mi̍notu mi̱trāvaru̍ṇau dhru̱veṇa̱ dharma̍ṇā bra̱hma̱vani̍ tvā kṣatra̱vani̍ rāyaspoṣa̱vani̱ paryū̍hāmi
46.d: द्यु̱तानस्त्वा̍ मारु̱तो मि̍नोतु मि̱त्रावरु̍णौ ध्रु̱वेण̱ धर्म̍णा ब्र̱ह्म̱वनि̍ त्वा क्षत्र̱वनि̍ रायस्पोष̱वनि̱ पर्यू̍हामि
46.m:
May Dyutāna the Māruta erect you; Mitra and Varuṇa with firm ordinance.
Winning Brahman, winning princely power, winning abundance of wealth, I bank you around.

46.s: brahma̍ dṛm̐ha kṣa̱traṃ dṛ̍m̐hāyu̍rdṛm̐ha pra̱jāṃ dṛ̍m̐ha | dhru̱vāsi̍ dhru̱vo'smi̍nyaja̍māna ā̱yata̍ne bhūyāt ghṛ̱tena̍ dyāvāpṛthivī pū̱ryethā̱mindra̍sya cha̱dira̍si vi̱śvaja̍nasya chā̱yā
46.d: ब्रह्म̍ दृम्̐ह क्ष̱त्रं दृ̍म्̐हायु̍र्दृम्̐ह प्र̱जां दृ̍म्̐ह । ध्रु̱वासि̍ ध्रु̱वोऽस्मि̍न्यज̍मान आ̱यत̍ने भूयात् घृ̱तेन̍ द्यावापृथिवी पू̱र्येथा̱मिन्द्र̍स्य छ̱दिर̍सि वि̱श्वज̍नस्य छा̱या
46.m:
Make Brahman firm, make princely power firm, make life firm, make offspring firm. You are firm; may the sacrificer be firm in this abode.
May heaven and earth be filled with ghee. You are Indra's roof, the shelter of all people.

46.s: pari̍ tvā girvaṇo̱ gira̍ i̱mā bha̍vantu vi̱śvata̍ḥ | vṛ̱ddhāyu̍manu vṛ̱ddhayo̱ juṣṭā̍ bhavantu̱ juṣṭa̍yaḥ
46.d: परि̍ त्वा गिर्वणो̱ गिर̍ इ̱मा भ̍वन्तु वि̱श्वत̍ः । वृ̱द्धायु̍मनु वृ̱द्धयो̱ जुष्टा̍ भवन्तु̱ जुष्ट̍यः
46.m: May these songs encompass you on every side, O lover of songs; / strengthening you whose life is enhanced, may these welcomed [chants] be welcome.
You are Indra’s stitch; you are Indra’s knot. / You belong to Indra; you belong to the All-Gods.

47.s: (7) vi̱bhūra̍si pra̱vāha̍ṇo̱ vahni̍rasi havya̱vāha̍naḥ | śvā̱tro̍'si prace̍tāstu̱tho̍'si vi̱śvave̍dāḥ
47.d: (7) वि̱भूर̍सि प्र̱वाह̍णो̱ वह्नि̍रसि हव्य̱वाह̍नः । श्वा̱त्रो̍ऽसि प्रचे̍तास्तु̱थो̍ऽसि वि̱श्ववे̍दाः
47.m: You are far-reaching, the conveyor; you are the bearer, the bearer of oblations. / You are quick, the wise one; you are Tutha, who knows all.

47.s: u̱śiga̍si ka̱viraṅghā̍rirasi̱ bambhārīḥ | ava̱syura̍si duva̱svāñchundhyū̍rasi mārjā̱līya̍ḥ
47.d: उ̱शिग̍सि क̱विरङ्घा̍रिरसि̱ बम्भारीः । अव̱स्युर̍सि दुव̱स्वाञ्छुन्ध्यू̍रसि मार्जा̱लीय̍ः
47.m: You are eager, the poet; you are Aṅghāri, Bambhāri. / You are the seeker of aid, the active one; you are the cleanser, the Mārjālīya.

47.s: ṛ̱tadhā̍māsi sva̱rjyoti̍ḥ samu̱dro̍'si vi̱śvavya̍cāḥ | a̱jo'syeka̍pā̱dahi̍rasi bu̱dhnya̍ḥ
47.d: ऋ̱तधा̍मासि स्व̱र्ज्योति̍ः समु̱द्रो̍ऽसि वि̱श्वव्य̍चाः । अ̱जोऽस्येक̍पा̱दहि̍रसि बु̱ध्न्य̍ः
47.m: You are the abode of truth, the light of heaven; you are the ocean, all-embracing. / You are the one-footed unborn; you are the serpent of the deep.

47.s: sa̱mrāḷa̍si kṛ̱śānu̍ḥ pari̱ṣadyo̍'si pava̍mānaḥ | nabho̍'si prata̱kvā̍ mṛ̱ṣṭo̍'si havya̱sūda̍naḥ
47.d: स̱म्राऌअ̍सि कृ̱शानु̍ः परि̱षद्यो̍ऽसि पव̍मानः । नभो̍ऽसि प्रत̱क्वा̍ मृ̱ष्टो̍ऽसि हव्य̱सूद̍नः
47.m: You are the sovereign ruler, Kṛśānu; you are the member of the assembly, the purifying one. / You are the vapor, the swift racer; you are cleansed, the oblation-speeder.

47.s: su̱mṛ̱ḍī̱ko̍'si vi̱śvave̍dā ūnātiri̱ktasya̍ prati̱ṣṭhā agna̍yaḥ saga̱rā saga̍rā stha saga̍reṇa̱ nāmnā̍ rau̱dreṇā̱nīke̍na pā̱tamā̍gnayaḥ pipṛ̱tamā̍gnayo̱ namo̍ vo'stu̱ mā mā̍ him̐siṣṭa
47.d: सु̱मृ̱डी̱को̍ऽसि वि̱श्ववे̍दा ऊनातिरि̱क्तस्य̍ प्रति̱ष्ठा अग्न̍यः सग̱रा सग̍रा स्थ सग̍रेण̱ नाम्ना̍ रौ̱द्रेणा̱नीके̍न पा̱तमा̍ग्नयः पिपृ̱तमा̍ग्नयो̱ नमो̍ वोऽस्तु̱ मा मा̍ हिम्̐सिष्ट
47.m: You are to be gathered together, all-knowing, the firm foundation of what is deficient and redundant. / O fires, oceanic, oceanic are you, with oceanic name, with Rudra’s host. / Protect me, O fires! Transport me across, O fires! Homage be to you; do not harm me!

48.s: (8) jyoti̍rasi vi̱śvarū̍pa̱ṃ viśve̍ṣāṃ de̱vānā̍m̐m̐sa̱mit | tvam̐ so̍ma tanū̱kṛdbhyo̱ dveṣo̍bhyo'nyakṛ̍tebhyaḥ u̱ru ya̱ntāsi̱ varū̍tha̱m̐svāhā̍ | juṣā̱ṇo a̱pturājya̍sya vetu̱ svāhā̍
48.d: (8) ज्योति̍रसि वि̱श्वरू̍प̱ं विश्वे̍षां दे̱वाना̍म्̐म्̐स̱मित् । त्वम्̐ सो̍म तनू̱कृद्भ्यो̱ द्वेषो̍भ्योऽन्यकृ̍तेभ्यः उ̱रु य̱न्तासि̱ वरू̍थ̱म्̐स्वाहा̍ । जुषा̱णो अ̱प्तुराज्य̍स्य वेतु̱ स्वाहा̍
48.m: You are light, omniform, the kindling-stick of all the gods. / You, O Soma, from hatreds caused by others that impair our body— / you are a wide defense and shelter, svāhā! / Finding pleasure, may the swift one partake of the ghee, svāhā!

48.s: agne̱ naya̍ su̱pathā̍ rā̱ye a̱smānviśvā̍ni deva va̱yunā̍ni vi̱dvān yu̱yo̱dhya̱smajju̍hurā̱ṇameno̱ bhūyi̍ṣṭhāṃ te̱ nama̍uktiṃ vidhema
48.d: अग्ने̱ नय̍ सु̱पथा̍ रा̱ये अ̱स्मान्विश्वा̍नि देव व̱युना̍नि वि̱द्वान् यु̱यो̱ध्य̱स्मज्जु̍हुरा̱णमेनो̱ भूयि̍ष्ठां ते̱ नम̍उक्तिं विधेम
48.m: O Agni, lead us along a good path to wealth, O god knowing all pathways. / Keep away from us crooked sin; we offer you our most abundant word of homage.

48.s: a̱yaṃ no̍ a̱gnirvari̍vaskṛṇotva̱yaṃ mṛdha̍ḥ pu̱ra e̍tu prabhi̱ndan a̱yaṃ vājā̍ñjayatu̱ vāja̍sātā a̱yam̐ śatrū̍ñjayatu̱ jarhṛ̍ṣāṇa̱ḥ svāhā̍
48.d: अ̱यं नो̍ अ̱ग्निर्वरि̍वस्कृणोत्व̱यं मृध̍ः पु̱र ए̍तु प्रभि̱न्दन् अ̱यं वाजा̍ञ्जयतु̱ वाज̍साता अ̱यम्̐ शत्रू̍ञ्जयतु̱ जर्हृ̍षाण̱ः स्वाहा̍
48.m: May this Agni make broad room for us; may he advance in front, shattering the foes. / May he win vital vigor in the contest for vigor; exulting, may he conquer the enemies, svāhā!

48.s: u̱ru vi̍ṣṇo̱ vikra̍masvo̱ru kṣayā̍ya naskṛdhi | ghṛ̱taṃ ghṛ̍tayone piba̱ prapa̍ ya̱jñapa̍tiṃ ti̱ra svāhā̍
48.d: उ̱रु वि̍ष्णो̱ विक्र̍मस्वो̱रु क्षया̍य नस्कृधि । घृ̱तं घृ̍तयोने पिब̱ प्रप̍ य̱ज्ञप̍तिं ति̱र स्वाहा̍
48.m: Stride out widely, O Viṣṇu; make broad space for our dwelling. / Drink the ghee, you whose womb is ghee; advance the lord of sacrifice further and further, svāhā!

48.s:
de̱va̍ savitare̱ṣa te̱ soma̱stam̐ ra̍kṣasva̱ mā tvā̍ dabhan e̱tattvaṃ de̍va soma de̱vo de̱vām̐ upā̍gāḥ
adhyāyaḥ
48.d:
दे̱व̍ सवितरे̱ष ते̱ सोम̱स्तम्̐ र̍क्षस्व̱ मा त्वा̍ दभन् ए̱तत्त्वं दे̍व सोम दे̱वो दे̱वाम्̐ उपा̍गाः
अध्यायः
48.m: O divine Savitṛ, this is your Soma; guard him, let them not harm you. / Thus, O divine Soma, as a god you have approached the gods.

48.s:
49-55;
i̱dama̱haṃ ma̍nu̱ṣyā̍ntsa̱ha rā̱yaspoṣe̍ṇa̱ svāhā̍ nirvaru̍ṇasya̱ pāśā̍nmucye | agne̍ vrata̱pāstve vra̍ta̱pāḥ
48.d:
49-55;
इ̱दम̱हं म̍नु̱ष्या̍न्त्स̱ह रा̱यस्पोषे̍ण̱ स्वाहा̍ निर्वरु̍णस्य̱ पाशा̍न्मुच्ये । अग्ने̍ व्रत̱पास्त्वे व्र̍त̱पाः
48.m: Here do I, together with prosperity of wealth, svāhā! release men from Varuṇa’s noose. / O Agni, keeper of vows, in you are the keepers of vows.

48.s: yā tava̍ ta̱nūrama̍yyabhū̱deṣā sā tvayi̱ yā mama̍ ta̱nūstvayyabhū̍di̱yam̐ sā mayi̍ ya̱thāya̱thaṃ nau̍ vratapate vra̱tānyanu̍ me dī̱kṣāṃ dī̱kṣāpa̍tiramam̐stānu̱ tapa̍stapa̍spatiḥ
48.d: या तव̍ त̱नूरम̍य्यभू̱देषा सा त्वयि̱ या मम̍ त̱नूस्त्वय्यभू̍दि̱यम्̐ सा मयि̍ य̱थाय̱थं नौ̍ व्रतपते व्र̱तान्यनु̍ मे दी̱क्षां दी̱क्षाप̍तिरमम्̐स्तानु̱ तप̍स्तप̍स्पतिः
48.m: That form of yours which was in me, here it is in you; that form of mine which was in you, here it is in me. / In accordance with each, O lord of vows, are our vows; the lord of consecration has approved my consecration; the lord of ascetic heat has approved my ascetic heat.

49.s: (9) u̱ru vi̍ṣṇo̱ vikra̍masvo̱ru kṣayā̍ya naskṛdhi | ghṛ̱taṃ ghṛ̍tayone piba̱ prapra̍ ya̱jñapa̍tiṃ ti̱ra svāhā̍
49.d: (9) उ̱रु वि̍ष्णो̱ विक्र̍मस्वो̱रु क्षया̍य नस्कृधि । घृ̱तं घृ̍तयोने पिब̱ प्रप्र̍ य̱ज्ञप̍तिं ति̱र स्वाहा̍
49.m: Stride out widely, O Viṣṇu; make broad space for our dwelling. / Drink the ghee, you whose womb is ghee; advance the lord of sacrifice further and further, svāhā!

49.s: atya̱nyām̐2 agā̱ṃ nānyām̐2 upā̍gām | a̱rvāktvā pa̱rebhya̍ḥ pu̱ro'va̍rebhyaḥ
49.d: अत्य̱न्याम्̐2 अगा̱ं नान्याम्̐2 उपा̍गाम् । अ̱र्वाक्त्वा प̱रेभ्य̍ः पु̱रोऽव̍रेभ्यः
49.m: I have gone beyond some, I have not approached others. / Nearer to you than the distant ones, farther than the near ones.

49.s: taṃ tvā̍ juṣāmahe deva vanaspate devaya̱jyāyai̍ | de̱vāstvā̍ devaya̱jyāyai̍ juṣantā̱ṃ viṣṇa̍ve tvā
49.d: तं त्वा̍ जुषामहे देव वनस्पते देवय̱ज्यायै̍ । दे̱वास्त्वा̍ देवय̱ज्यायै̍ जुषन्ता̱ं विष्ण̍वे त्वा
49.m: As such, we welcome you, O divine tree, for the worship of the gods. / May the gods welcome you for the worship of the gods; for Viṣṇu [I take] you.

49.s: oṣa̍dhe̱ trāya̍sva̱ svadhi̍te̱ mainam̐̍ him̐sīḥ di̱vaṃ mā le̍khīra̱ntari̍kṣa̱ṃ mā hi̍ṃm̐sīḥ pṛthi̱vyā saṃbha̍va
49.d: ओष̍धे̱ त्राय̍स्व̱ स्वधि̍ते̱ मैनम्̐̍ हिम्̐सीः दि̱वं मा ले̍खीर̱न्तरि̍क्ष̱ं मा हि̍ंम्̐सीः पृथि̱व्या संभ̍व
49.m: O plant, protect him! O axe, do not harm him! / Do not scratch the sky; do not harm mid-air; be joined with the earth.

49.s:
a̱yam̐ hi tvā̱ svadhi̍ti̱steti̍jānaḥ praṇi̱nāya̍ maha̱te saubha̍gāya ata̍stvaṃ de̍va vanaspate śa̱tava̍lśo virò̍ha sa̱hasra̍valśā̱ vi va̱yam̐ ru̍hema
(10)55290 agnestanūrasi catasraḥ
49.d:
अ̱यम्̐ हि त्वा̱ स्वधि̍ति̱स्तेति̍जानः प्रणि̱नाय̍ मह̱ते सौभ̍गाय अत̍स्त्वं दे̍व वनस्पते श̱तव̍ल्शो विर्ò̍ह स̱हस्र̍वल्शा̱ वि व̱यम्̐ रु̍हेम
(10)55290 अग्नेस्तनूरसि चतस्रः
49.m:
For this axe, sharpened, has brought you forward to great good fortune. / From this, O divine tree, sprout with a hundred shoots; may we sprout with a thousand shoots.

“Agnes tanūr asi” has four [verses]; “ā pataye” has eight; “taptāyanī” has two; “indraghoṣaḥ” has four; / “yuñjate” has nine; “devasya tvā” has five; the second “devasya tvā” has six; “vibhūr asi” has five; “jyotir asi” has seven; “uru viṣṇo” has five: fifty-five [verses] in the ten anuvākas; “agnes tanūr asi” has fifty-five. / Thus ends the fifth chapter in the Śukla Yajurveda Kāṇva Saṃhitā.

50.s: de̱vasya̍ tvā savi̱tuḥ pra̍sa̱ve'śvino̍rbā̱hubhyā̍ṃ pū̱ṣṇo hastā̍bhyām āda̍de̱ nārya̍sī̱dama̱ham̐ rakṣa̍so grī̱vā api̍kṛntāmi yavo̍'si ya̱vayā̱smad dveṣo̍ ya̱vayārā̍tīḥ di̱ve tvā̱ntari̍kṣāya tvā pṛthi̱vyai tvā̍ śundha̍ntām̐llo̱kāḥ pi̍tṛ̱ṣada̍nāḥ pi̱tṛ̱ṣada̍namasi
50.d: दे̱वस्य̍ त्वा सवि̱तुः प्र̍स̱वेऽश्विनो̍र्बा̱हुभ्या̍ं पू̱ष्णो हस्ता̍भ्याम् आद̍दे̱ नार्य̍सी̱दम̱हम्̐ रक्ष̍सो ग्री̱वा अपि̍कृन्तामि यवो̍ऽसि य̱वया̱स्मद् द्वेषो̍ य̱वयारा̍तीः दि̱वे त्वा̱न्तरि̍क्षाय त्वा पृथि̱व्यै त्वा̍ शुन्ध̍न्ताम्̐ल्लो̱काः पि̍तृ̱षद̍नाः पि̱तृ̱षद̍नमसि
50.m: On the impulse of the divine Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, / I take you. You are a woman. Here I cut off the neck of the demon. / You are barley; keep hatred away from us, keep enemies away! / For the sky you, for mid-air you, for the earth you! / Let the worlds, the seats of the fathers, be cleansed! You are the seat of the fathers.

50.s: a̱gre̱ṇīra̍si svāve̱śa unne̍tṝṇā̱metasya̍ vi̱ttādadhi̍ tvā sthāsyati de̱vastvā̍ savi̱tā madhvā̍naktu supippa̱lābhya̱stvauṣa̍dhībhyaḥ di̱vama̱greṇāspṛ̍kṣa ā̱ntari̍kṣa̱ṃ madhyè̍nāprāḥ pṛthi̱vīmupa̍reṇādṛm̐hīḥ
50.d: अ̱ग्रे̱णीर̍सि स्वावे̱श उन्ने̍तॄणा̱मेतस्य̍ वि̱त्तादधि̍ त्वा स्थास्यति दे̱वस्त्वा̍ सवि̱ता मध्वा̍नक्तु सुपिप्प̱लाभ्य̱स्त्वौष̍धीभ्यः दि̱वम̱ग्रेणास्पृ̍क्ष आ̱न्तरि̍क्ष̱ं मध्य्è̍नाप्राः पृथि̱वीमुप̍रेणादृम्̐हीः
50.m: You are the leader, a good entrance for the Unnetṛs; know him, he will stand upon you. / May the divine Savitṛ anoint you with honey, for plants with good berries. / Touch the sky with your top, fill mid-air with your middle, make earth firm with your base.

50.s: yā te̱ dhāmā̍nyuśmasi̱ gama̍dhyai̱ yatra̱ gāvo̱ bhūri̍śṛṅgā ayā̱saḥ atrāhā̱taduru̍gāya̱sya̱ viṣṇo̍ḥ pa̱raṃ pa̱damava̍bhāri̱ bhūri̍
50.d: या ते̱ धामा̍न्युश्मसि̱ गम̍ध्यै̱ यत्र̱ गावो̱ भूरि̍शृङ्गा अया̱सः अत्राहा̱तदुरु̍गाय̱स्य̱ विष्णो̍ः प̱रं प̱दमव̍भारि̱ भूरि̍
50.m: We desire to go to those abodes of yours where the many-horned, untiring cows are; / right there that highest step of the wide-striding Viṣṇu shines down abundantly.

50.s: bra̱hma̱vani̍ tvā kṣatra̱vani̍ rāyaspoṣa̱vani̱ parya̍hāmi brahma̍ dṛm̐ha kṣa̱traṃ dṛ̍m̐hāyu̍rdṛm̐ha pra̱jāṃ dṛ̍m̐ha
50.d: ब्र̱ह्म̱वनि̍ त्वा क्षत्र̱वनि̍ रायस्पोष̱वनि̱ पर्य̍हामि ब्रह्म̍ दृम्̐ह क्ष̱त्रं दृ̍म्̐हायु̍र्दृम्̐ह प्र̱जां दृ̍म्̐ह
50.m: Winning sacred formulation, winning princely power, winning prosperity of wealth, I encompass you. / Strengthen sacred formulation, strengthen princely power, strengthen life, strengthen offspring!

50.s: viṣṇo̱ḥ karmā̍ṇi paśyata̱ yato̍ vra̱tāni̍ paspṛ̱śe | indra̍sya̱ yujya̱: sakhā̍
50.d: विष्णो̱ः कर्मा̍णि पश्यत̱ यतो̍ व्र̱तानि̍ पस्पृ̱शे । इन्द्र̍स्य̱ युज्य̱: सखा̍
50.m: Look upon the deeds of Viṣṇu, whereby he viewed his vows, / the close ally of Indra.

50.s: tadviṣṇo̍: para̱maṃ pa̱dam̐ sadā̍ paśyanti sū̱raya̍: | di̱vī̍va̱ cakṣu̱rāta̍tam
50.d: तद्विष्णो̍: पर̱मं प̱दम्̐ सदा̍ पश्यन्ति सू̱रय̍: । दि̱वी̍व̱ चक्षु̱रात̍तम्
50.m: That highest step of Viṣṇu the patrons ever behold, / like an eye extended across the sky.

50.s: pari̍ vī̱rasi̱ pari̍ tvā̱ daivī̱rviśo̍ vyayantām | parī̱maṃ yaja̍māna̱m̐ rāyo̍ manu̱ṣyā̍ṇām di̱va: sū̱nura̍sye̱ṣa te̍ pṛthi̱vyām̐llo̱ka ā̍ra̱ṇyaste̍ pa̱śu:
50.d: परि̍ वी̱रसि̱ परि̍ त्वा̱ दैवी̱र्विशो̍ व्ययन्ताम् । परी̱मं यज̍मान̱म्̐ रायो̍ मनु̱ष्या̍णाम् दि̱व: सू̱नुर̍स्ये̱ष ते̍ पृथि̱व्याम्̐ल्लो̱क आ̍र̱ण्यस्ते̍ प̱शु:
50.m: You encompass the hero; may the divine clans encompass you; / may the riches of men encompass this sacrificer. / You are the son of the sky; this is your world upon earth; wild is your victim.

51.s: (1) upā̍vī̱rasyupa̍ de̱vān daivī̱rviśa̍: prāgu̍ru̱śijo̱ vahni̍tamān de̱vaṃ tvaṣṭa̍rvasu̍ rama ha̱vyā te̍ svadantām
51.d: (1) उपा̍वी̱रस्युप̍ दे̱वान् दैवी̱र्विश̍: प्रागु̍रु̱शिजो̱ वह्नि̍तमान् दे̱वं त्वष्ट̍र्वसु̍ रम ह̱व्या ते̍ स्वदन्ताम्
51.m: You are the companion; go near to the gods, the divine clans, the eager, best carriers. / O divine Tvaṣṭṛ, take delight in wealth; may the oblations be savored by you.

51.s: reva̍tī̱ rama̍dhva̱ṃ bṛha̍spate dhā̱rayā̱ vasū̍ni ṛ̱tasya̍ tvā devahavi̱ḥ pāśe̍na̱ prati̍muñcāmi dha̱rṣāmā̱nuṣa̍:
51.d: रेव̍ती̱ रम̍ध्व̱ं बृह̍स्पते धा̱रया̱ वसू̍नि ऋ̱तस्य̍ त्वा देवहवि̱ः पाशे̍न̱ प्रति̍मुञ्चामि ध̱र्षामा̱नुष̍:
51.m: O wealthy ones, rest! O Bṛhaspati, hold fast the riches! / With the bond of truth I fasten you, the divine oblation; be bold, O human one!

51.s: de̱vasya̍ tvā savi̱tu: pra̍sa̱ve'śvino̍rbā̱hubhyā̍ṃ pū̱ṣṇo hastā̍bhyām a̱gnīṣomā̍bhyā̱ṃ juṣṭa̍ṃ ni̱yu̍najmi a̱dbhyastvauṣa̍dhībhya̱ḥ prokṣā̍mya̱nu̍ tvā̍ mā̱tā ma̍nyatā̱manu̍ pi̱tānu̱ bhrātā̱ saga̍bhyo'nu̱ sakhā̱ sayū̍thyaḥ a̱gnīṣomā̍bhyāṃ tvā̱ juṣṭa̱ṃ prokṣā̍mi
51.d: दे̱वस्य̍ त्वा सवि̱तु: प्र̍स̱वेऽश्विनो̍र्बा̱हुभ्या̍ं पू̱ष्णो हस्ता̍भ्याम् अ̱ग्नीषोमा̍भ्या̱ं जुष्ट̍ं नि̱यु̍नज्मि अ̱द्भ्यस्त्वौष̍धीभ्य̱ः प्रोक्षा̍म्य̱नु̍ त्वा̍ मा̱ता म̍न्यता̱मनु̍ पि̱तानु̱ भ्राता̱ सग̍भ्योऽनु̱ सखा̱ सयू̍थ्यः अ̱ग्नीषोमा̍भ्यां त्वा̱ जुष्ट̱ं प्रोक्षा̍मि
51.m: On the impulse of the divine Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan, / I bind you, welcome to Agnīṣoma. / With water I sprinkle you for the plants; may your mother approve you, your father approve, your brother born of the same womb approve, your companion of the same herd approve. / I sprinkle you, welcome to Agnīṣoma.

51.s: a̱pāṃ peru̱rasyāpo̍ de̱vī: sva̍dantu | svātta̍ṃ ci̱tsadde̍vahaviḥ
51.d: अ̱पां पेरु̱रस्यापो̍ दे̱वी: स्व̍दन्तु । स्वात्त̍ं चि̱त्सद्दे̍वहविः
51.m: You are the drinker of waters; let the divine waters savor [you]. / Well-savored indeed be the divine oblation.

51.s: saṃ te̍ prā̱ṇo vāte̍na gacchatā̱m̐ samaṅgā̍ni yaja̍traiḥ | saṃ yaja̍māna ā̱śiṣā̍
51.d: सं ते̍ प्रा̱णो वाते̍न गच्छता̱म्̐ समङ्गा̍नि यज̍त्रैः । सं यज̍मान आ̱शिषा̍
51.m: May your breath unite with the wind, your limbs with the worthy of sacrifice, / the sacrificer with his prayer.

51.s: ghṛ̱tenā̱ktau pa̱śūm̐strā̍yethā̱m̐ reva̍ti̱ yaja̍māne | pri̱yaṃ dhā ā̱viśa̍
51.d: घृ̱तेना̱क्तौ प̱शूम्̐स्त्रा̍येथा̱म्̐ रेव̍ति̱ यज̍माने । प्रि̱यं धा आ̱विश̍
51.m: Anointed with ghee, protect the victims; in the wealthy sacrificer / enter the beloved abode.

51.s: u̱rora̱ntari̍kṣātsa̱jūrde̱vena̱ vāte̍na | a̱sya ha̱viṣa̱stmanā̍ ya̱ja sama̍sya ta̱nvā̍ bhava
51.d: उ̱रोर̱न्तरि̍क्षात्स̱जूर्दे̱वेन̱ वाते̍न । अ̱स्य ह̱विष̱स्त्मना̍ य̱ज सम̍स्य त̱न्वा̍ भव
51.m: From the broad mid-air, in league with the divine Wind, / by yourself sacrifice this oblation; be united with his body.

51.s: varṣo̱ varṣī̍yasi ya̱jñe ya̱jñapa̍tiṃ dhāḥ | svāhā̍ de̱vebhyo̍ de̱vebhya̱ḥ svāhā̍ māhi̍rbhū̱rmā pṛdā̍kuḥ
51.d: वर्षो̱ वर्षी̍यसि य̱ज्ञे य̱ज्ञप̍तिं धाः । स्वाहा̍ दे̱वेभ्यो̍ दे̱वेभ्य̱ः स्वाहा̍ माहि̍र्भू̱र्मा पृदा̍कुः
51.m:
In the higher sacrifice place the lord of sacrifice higher. Svāhā to the gods, to the gods svāhā!
Be not a snake, be not a viper.

52.s: (2) nama̍sta ātānā̱narvā̱ prehi̍ | ghṛ̱tasya̍ ku̱lyā upa̍ ṛ̱tasya̱ pathyā̱ upa̍
52.d: (2) नम̍स्त आताना̱नर्वा̱ प्रेहि̍ । घृ̱तस्य̍ कु̱ल्या उप̍ ऋ̱तस्य̱ पथ्या̱ उप̍
52.m:
Homage to you! Spread out, go forward without stumbling,
unto the streams of ghee, unto the paths of truth.

52.s: de̱vīrāpa̍: śu̱ddhā vau̍ḍhva̱m̐ supa̍riviṣṭā de̱veṣu̍ | supa̍riviṣṭā va̱yaṃ pa̍rive̱ṣṭāro̍ bhūyāsma
52.d: दे̱वीराप̍: शु̱द्धा वौ̍ढ्व̱म्̐ सुप̍रिविष्टा दे̱वेषु̍ । सुप̍रिविष्टा व̱यं प̍रिवे̱ष्टारो̍ भूयास्म
52.m:
O divine waters, clean, conveyed, well-served among the gods,
well-served may we become servers.

52.s: vāca̍ṃ te śundhāmi prā̱ṇaṃ te̍ śundhāmi̱ cakṣu̍ste śundhāmi̱ śrotra̍ṃ te śundhāmi nābhi̍ṃ te śundhāmi̱ meḍhra̍ṃ te śundhāmi pā̱yuṃ te̍ śundhāmi ca̱ritrā̍m̐ste śundhāmi
52.d: वाच̍ं ते शुन्धामि प्रा̱णं ते̍ शुन्धामि̱ चक्षु̍स्ते शुन्धामि̱ श्रोत्र̍ं ते शुन्धामि नाभि̍ं ते शुन्धामि̱ मेढ्र̍ं ते शुन्धामि पा̱युं ते̍ शुन्धामि च̱रित्रा̍म्̐स्ते शुन्धामि
52.m:
I cleanse your speech, I cleanse your in-breath, I cleanse your sight, I cleanse your hearing;
I cleanse your navel, I cleanse your penis, I cleanse your anus, I cleanse your feet.

52.s: mana̍sta̱ āpyā̍yatā̱ṃ vākta̱ āpyā̍yatāṃ prā̱ṇasta̱ āpyā̍yatāṃ cakṣu̍sta̱ āpyā̍yatā̱m̐ śrotra̍ṃ ta̱ āpyā̍yatām yatte̍ krū̱raṃ yadāsthi̍ta̱ṃ tatta̱ āpyā̍yatā̱ṃ tatte̱ niṣṭyā̍yatā̱ṃ tatte̍ śudhyatu̱ śamaho̍bhyaḥ
52.d: मन̍स्त̱ आप्या̍यता̱ं वाक्त̱ आप्या̍यतां प्रा̱णस्त̱ आप्या̍यतां चक्षु̍स्त̱ आप्या̍यता̱म्̐ श्रोत्र̍ं त̱ आप्या̍यताम् यत्ते̍ क्रू̱रं यदास्थि̍त̱ं तत्त̱ आप्या̍यता̱ं तत्ते̱ निष्ट्या̍यता̱ं तत्ते̍ शुध्यतु̱ शमहो̍भ्यः
52.m:
May your mind swell, may your speech swell, may your in-breath swell, may your sight swell, may your hearing swell.
What of you is injured, what has been crushed, may that swell of you, may that solidify of you, may that be cleansed of you: peace for days!

52.s: oṣa̍dhe trāya̍sva̱ svadhi̍te̱ maina̍m̐ him̐sīḥ | rakṣa̍sāṃ bhā̱go̍'si̱ nira̍sta̱m̐ rakṣa̍ḥ
52.d: ओष̍धे त्राय̍स्व̱ स्वधि̍ते̱ मैन̍म्̐ हिम्̐सीः । रक्ष̍सां भा̱गो̍ऽसि̱ निर̍स्त̱म्̐ रक्ष̍ः
52.m:
O plant, protect [him]! Axe, do not harm him!
You are the share of the demons; expelled is the demon.

52.s: i̱dama̱ham̐ rakṣo̱'bhiti̍ṣṭhāmī̱dama̱ham̐ rakṣo̍'va̍bādhe | i̱dama̱ham̐ rakṣo̍'dha̱maṃ tamo̍ nayāmi
52.d: इ̱दम̱हम्̐ रक्षो̱ऽभिति̍ष्ठामी̱दम̱हम्̐ रक्षो̍ऽव̍बाधे । इ̱दम̱हम्̐ रक्षो̍ऽध̱मं तमो̍ नयामि
52.m: Here I tread upon the demon; here I press down the demon; here I lead the demon into the lowest darkness.

52.s: ghṛ̱tena̍ dyāvāpṛthi̱vī prorṇvā̍thāṃ vā̱yo ve sto̱kānā̍m juṣā̱ṇo a̱gnirājya̍sya vetu̱ svāhā̍ | svāhā̍kṛte ū̱rdhvarna̍bhasaṃ māru̱taṃ ga̍cchatam
52.d: घृ̱तेन̍ द्यावापृथि̱वी प्रोर्ण्वा̍थां वा̱यो वे स्तो̱काना̍म् जुषा̱णो अ̱ग्निराज्य̍स्य वेतु̱ स्वाहा̍ । स्वाहा̍कृते ऊ̱र्ध्वर्न̍भसं मारु̱तं ग̍च्छतम्
52.m:
Clothe yourselves with ghee, O heaven and earth! O Vāyu, accept the drops!
May Agni, enjoying the clarified butter, accept it: svāhā! Consecrated by svāhā, go to the Maruts' realm high in the clouds!

53.s: (3) saṃ te̱ mano̱ mana̍sā̱ saṃ prā̱ṇaḥ prā̱ṇena̍ gacchatām | reḷa̍sya̱gniṣṭvā̍ śrīṇā̱tvāpa̍stvā sama̍riṇan
53.d: (3) सं ते̱ मनो̱ मन̍सा̱ सं प्रा̱णः प्रा̱णेन̍ गच्छताम् । रेऌअ̍स्य̱ग्निष्ट्वा̍ श्रीणा̱त्वाप̍स्त्वा सम̍रिणन्
53.m:
May your mind unite with mind; may in-breath unite with breath.
You are licking; may Agni cook you; may the waters unite [with you].

53.s: vāta̍sya tvā dhrā̱jyai pū̱ṣṇo ram̐hyā̍ ū̱ṣmaṇo̍ vyathiṣat | prayu̍taṃ dveṣa̍ḥ
53.d: वात̍स्य त्वा ध्रा̱ज्यै पू̱ष्णो रम्̐ह्या̍ ऊ̱ष्मणो̍ व्यथिषत् । प्रयु̍तं द्वेष̍ः
53.m: For the rushing of the wind, for the speed of Pūṣan; from heat may [he] shake off; held back is enmity.

53.s: ghṛ̱taṃ ghṛ̍tapāvānaḥ pibata̱ vasā̍ṃ vasāpāvānaḥ pibata | a̱ntari̍kṣasya ha̱vira̍si̱ svāhā̍
53.d: घृ̱तं घृ̍तपावानः पिबत̱ वसा̍ं वसापावानः पिबत । अ̱न्तरि̍क्षस्य ह̱विर̍सि̱ स्वाहा̍
53.m:
Drink ghee, you ghee-drinkers; drink fat, you fat-drinkers!
You are the oblation of mid-air: svāhā!

53.s: diśa̍ḥ pra̱diśa̍ ā̱diśo̍ vi̱diśa̍ u̱ddiśo̍ di̱gbhyaḥ svāhā̍ aindraḥ prā̱ṇo aṅge̍aṅge nidha̍īta̱ aindra u̍dā̱no aṅge̍aṅge nidī̍dhe
53.d: दिश̍ः प्र̱दिश̍ आ̱दिशो̍ वि̱दिश̍ उ̱द्दिशो̍ दि̱ग्भ्यः स्वाहा̍ ऐन्द्रः प्रा̱णो अङ्गे̍अङ्गे निध̍ईत̱ ऐन्द्र उ̍दा̱नो अङ्गे̍अङ्गे निदी̍धे
53.m:
To the quarters, the intermediate quarters, the principal quarters, the cross-quarters, the upward quarters, to the directions svāhā!
Belonging to Indra is the in-breath deposited in limb by limb; belonging to Indra is the up-breath deposited in limb by limb.

53.s: de̱vaṃ tvaṣṭṛ̱bhūri̍ te̱ sam̐ same̍tu̱ sa lakṣmā yadviṣu̍rūpa̱ṃ bhavā̍ti de̱va̱trā yanta̱mava̍se sakhā̍yo'nu̍ tvā mā̱tā pi̱tarau̍ madantu
53.d: दे̱वं त्वष्टृ̱भूरि̍ ते̱ सम्̐ समे̍तु̱ स लक्ष्मा यद्विषु̍रूप̱ं भवा̍ति दे̱व̱त्रा यन्त̱मव̍से सखा̍योऽनु̍ त्वा मा̱ता पि̱तरौ̍ मदन्तु
53.m:
O divine Tvaṣṭṛ, may abundance come together for you; that is marked which becomes multiform.
As you go to the gods for aid, let your companions, your mother, [and] father rejoice after you.

54.s: (4) samu̱draṃ ga̍ccha̱ svāhā̍ de̱vam̐ sa̍vi̱tāra̍ṃ gaccha̱ svāhā̍ a̱ntari̍kṣaṃ gaccha̱ svāhā̍ mi̱trāvaru̍ṇau gaccha̱ svāhā̍ a̱ho̱rā̱tre ga̍ccha̱ svāhā̱ chandā̍ṃm̐si gaccha̱ svāhā̍ dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī ga̍ccha̱ svāhā̱ soma̍ṃ gaccha̱ svāhā̍ ya̱jñaṃ ga̍ccha̱ svāhā̱ nabho̍ di̱vyaṃ ga̍ccha̱ svāhā̍ a̱gniṃ vai̍śvāna̱raṃ ga̍ccha̱ svāhā̱ mano̍ me̱ hārdya̍ccha
54.d: (4) समु̱द्रं ग̍च्छ̱ स्वाहा̍ दे̱वम्̐ स̍वि̱तार̍ं गच्छ̱ स्वाहा̍ अ̱न्तरि̍क्षं गच्छ̱ स्वाहा̍ मि̱त्रावरु̍णौ गच्छ̱ स्वाहा̍ अ̱हो̱रा̱त्रे ग̍च्छ̱ स्वाहा̱ छन्दा̍ंम्̐सि गच्छ̱ स्वाहा̍ द्यावा̍पृथि̱वी ग̍च्छ̱ स्वाहा̱ सोम̍ं गच्छ̱ स्वाहा̍ य̱ज्ञं ग̍च्छ̱ स्वाहा̱ नभो̍ दि̱व्यं ग̍च्छ̱ स्वाहा̍ अ̱ग्निं वै̍श्वान̱रं ग̍च्छ̱ स्वाहा̱ मनो̍ मे̱ हार्द्य̍च्छ
54.m:
Go to the ocean, svāhā! Go to the divine Savitṛ, svāhā!
Go to mid-air, svāhā! Go to Mitra and Varuṇa, svāhā!
Go to day and night, svāhā! Go to the metres, svāhā!
Go to heaven and earth, svāhā! Go to Soma, svāhā!
Go to the sacrifice, svāhā! Go to the heavenly cloud, svāhā!
Go to Agni Vaiśvānara, svāhā! Reach my heart's mind!

54.s: di̱vaṃ te dhū̱mo ga̍ccha̱tvantari̍kṣa̱ṃ jyorti̍ḥ | pṛ̱thi̱vīṃ bhasma̱nāpṛ̍ṇa̱ svāhā̍
54.d: दि̱वं ते धू̱मो ग̍च्छ̱त्वन्तरि̍क्ष̱ं ज्योर्ति̍ः । पृ̱थि̱वीं भस्म̱नापृ̍ण̱ स्वाहा̍
54.m:
May your smoke go to heaven, [your] light to mid-air.
Fill the earth with ashes: svāhā!

54.s: māpo mauṣa̍dhīrhim̐sīrdhā̱mno̍dhāmno rāja̱m̐stato̍ varuṇa no muñca yadā̱huraghnyā iti̱ varu̍ṇeti̱ śapā̍mahe̱ tato̍ varuṇa no muñca
54.d: मापो मौष̍धीर्हिम्̐सीर्धा̱म्नो̍धाम्नो राज̱म्̐स्ततो̍ वरुण नो मुञ्च यदा̱हुरघ्न्या इति̱ वरु̍णेति̱ शपा̍महे̱ ततो̍ वरुण नो मुञ्च
54.m:
Do not harm the waters, nor the plants! From every abode, O King Varuṇa, release us!
In that they say 'O cows not to be slain', in that we swear by Varuṇa, from that, O Varuṇa, release us!

54.s: su̱mi̱tri̱yā na̱ āpa̱ oṣa̍dhayaḥ santu durmitri̱yāstasmai̍ santu yo'smān dveṣṭi̱ yaṃ ca̍ va̱yaṃ dvi̱ṣmaḥ
54.d: सु̱मि̱त्रि̱या न̱ आप̱ ओष̍धयः सन्तु दुर्मित्रि̱यास्तस्मै̍ सन्तु योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि̱ यं च̍ व̱यं द्वि̱ष्मः
54.m:
Friendly to us be the waters [and] plants; unfriendly may they be to him
who hates us and whom we hate.

54.s: i̱damāpa̍ḥ prava̍hata̱ yatkiṃ ca̍ duri̱taṃ mayi̍ yadvā̱hama̍bhidu̱droha̱ yadvā̍ śe̱pa u̱tānṛ̍tam
54.d: इ̱दमाप̍ः प्रव̍हत̱ यत्किं च̍ दुरि̱तं मयि̍ यद्वा̱हम̍भिदु̱द्रोह̱ यद्वा̍ शे̱प उ̱तानृ̍तम्
54.m:
Wash away, O waters, whatever wrong is in me,
or if I have played false, or if I have sworn [falsely] and spoken untruth.

55.s: (5) ha̱viṣma̍tīri̱mā āpo̍ ha̱viṣmā̍m̐ ārvivasati ha̱viṣmā̍n de̱vo a̍dhva̱ro ha̱viṣmā̍m̐ astu̱ sūrya̍ḥ
55.d: (5) ह̱विष्म̍तीरि̱मा आपो̍ ह̱विष्मा̍म्̐ आर्विवसति ह̱विष्मा̍न् दे̱वो अ̍ध्व̱रो ह̱विष्मा̍म्̐ अस्तु̱ सूर्य̍ः
55.m:
Full of oblations are these waters; with oblations he approaches them.
Full of oblations may the divine sacrifice be; full of oblations may Sūrya be.

55.s: a̱gnervā'pa̍nnagṛhasya̱ sada̍si sādayāmi | indrā̱gnyorbhā̍ga̱dheyī̍ stha mi̱trāvaru̍ṇayorbhā̱ga̱dheyī̍ stha viśve̍ṣāṃ de̱vānā̍ṃ bhā̱ga̱dheyī̍ stha
55.d: अ̱ग्नेर्वाऽप̍न्नगृहस्य̱ सद̍सि सादयामि । इन्द्रा̱ग्न्योर्भा̍ग̱धेयी̍ स्थ मि̱त्रावरु̍णयोर्भा̱ग̱धेयी̍ स्थ विश्वे̍षां दे̱वाना̍ं भा̱ग̱धेयी̍ स्थ
55.m:
I settle you in the seat of Agni whose house has not fallen. You are the share of Indra and Agni; you are the share of Mitra and Varuṇa;
you are the share of the All-Gods.

55.s: a̱mūryā upa̱ sūrye̱ yābhi̍rvā̱ sūrya̍: sa̱ha | tā no̍ hinvantvadhva̱ram
55.d: अ̱मूर्या उप̱ सूर्ये̱ याभि̍र्वा̱ सूर्य̍: स̱ह । ता नो̍ हिन्वन्त्वध्व̱रम्
55.m:
Those [waters] that are near the sun, or those with which the sun is together,
may they speed our sacrifice.

56.s: (6) hṛ̱de tvā̱ mana̍se tvā di̱ve tvā̱ sūryā̍ya tvā | ū̱rdhvo a̍dhva̱raṃ di̱vi de̱veṣu̍ hotrā̍ yaccha
56.d: (6) हृ̱दे त्वा̱ मन̍से त्वा दि̱वे त्वा̱ सूर्या̍य त्वा । ऊ̱र्ध्वो अ̍ध्व̱रं दि̱वि दे̱वेषु̍ होत्रा̍ यच्छ
56.m:
For the heart [I take] you, for the mind you, for heaven you, for Sūrya you!
Upright, extend the sacrifice, the call to the priest, among the gods in heaven.

56.s: soma̍ rāja̱nviśvā̱stvaṃ pra̱jā u̱pāva̍roha | viśvā̱stvāṃ pra̱jā u̱pāva̍rohantu
56.d: सोम̍ राज̱न्विश्वा̱स्त्वं प्र̱जा उ̱पाव̍रोह । विश्वा̱स्त्वां प्र̱जा उ̱पाव̍रोहन्तु
56.m:
O King Soma, descend to all creatures;
may all creatures descend to you.

56.s: śṛ̱ṇotva̱gniḥ sa̱midhā̱ hava̍ṃ me śṛ̱ṇvantvāpo̍ dhiṣaṇā̍śca de̱vīḥ śrotā̍ grāvāṇo vi̱duṣo̱ na ya̱jñam̐ śṛ̱ṇotu̍ de̱vaḥ sa̍vi̱tā hava̍ṃ me̱ svāhā̍
56.d: शृ̱णोत्व̱ग्निः स̱मिधा̱ हव̍ं मे शृ̱ण्वन्त्वापो̍ धिषणा̍श्च दे̱वीः श्रोता̍ ग्रावाणो वि̱दुषो̱ न य̱ज्ञम्̐ शृ̱णोतु̍ दे̱वः स̍वि̱ता हव̍ं मे̱ स्वाहा̍
56.m:
May Agni with fuel hear my call; may the waters and the divine sacred receptacles hear;
hear, O pressing-stones, as wise ones the sacrifice; may the divine Savitṛ hear my call: svāhā!

56.s: de̱vī̍rāpo a̱pāṃ napādyo va̍ ū̱rmirha̱viṣya̍: | indri̱yāvā̍n ma̱dinta̍maḥ
56.d: दे̱वी̍रापो अ̱पां नपाद्यो व̍ ऊ̱र्मिर्ह̱विष्य̍: । इन्द्रि̱यावा̍न् म̱दिन्त̍मः
56.m:
O divine waters, Child of the Waters, that wave of yours which is oblation-worthy,
full of power, most intoxicating,

56.s: taṃ de̱vebhyo̍ de̱va̱trā da̍tta śu̱krapebhya̍: | yeṣā̍ṃ bhā̱ga stha svāhā̍
56.d: तं दे̱वेभ्यो̍ दे̱व̱त्रा द̍त्त शु̱क्रपेभ्य̍: । येषा̍ं भा̱ग स्थ स्वाहा̍
56.m:
give that to the gods, among the gods, to the drinkers of pure [Soma],
whose portion you are: svāhā!

56.s: kārṣi̍rasi samu̱drasya̍ tvā kṣi̱tyā unna̍yāmi | samāpo̍ a̱dbhira̍gmata̱ samoṣa̍dhībhiroṣa̍dhīḥ
56.d: कार्षि̍रसि समु̱द्रस्य̍ त्वा क्षि̱त्या उन्न̍यामि । समापो̍ अ̱द्भिर̍ग्मत̱ समोष̍धीभिरोष̍धीः
56.m:
You are drawn by a furrow. I lift you up with the stillness of the ocean.
The waters have united with the waters, the plants with the plants.

56.s: yama̍gne pṛ̱tsu martya̱mavā̱ vāje̍ṣu̱ yaṃ ju̱nāḥ | sa yantā̱ śaśva̍tī̱riṣa̱: svāhā̍
56.d: यम̍ग्ने पृ̱त्सु मर्त्य̱मवा̱ वाजे̍षु̱ यं जु̱नाः । स यन्ता̱ शश्व̍ती̱रिष̱: स्वाहा̍
56.m:
Whomsoever, O Agni, you aid in battles, whom you impel in contests for vital vigor,
he becomes the guide to continuous refreshments: svāhā!

57.s: (7) de̱vasya̍ tvā savi̱tuḥ pra̍sa̱ve'śvino̍rbā̱hubhyā̍ṃ pū̱ṣṇo hastā̍bhyām āda̍de̱ rāvā̍si gabhī̱rami̱mama̍dhva̱raṃ kṛ̍dhīndrā̍ya su̱ṣūta̍mam u̱tta̱mena̍ pa̱vinorja̍svanta̱ṃ madhu̍manta̱ṃ paya̍svantam ni̱grābhyā̍ stha de̱va̱śruta̍sta̱rpaya̍ta mā
57.d: (7) दे̱वस्य̍ त्वा सवि̱तुः प्र̍स̱वेऽश्विनो̍र्बा̱हुभ्या̍ं पू̱ष्णो हस्ता̍भ्याम् आद̍दे̱ रावा̍सि गभी̱रमि̱मम̍ध्व̱रं कृ̍धीन्द्रा̍य सु̱षूत̍मम् उ̱त्त̱मेन̍ प̱विनोर्ज̍स्वन्त̱ं मधु̍मन्त̱ं पय̍स्वन्तम् नि̱ग्राभ्या̍ स्थ दे̱व̱श्रुत̍स्त̱र्पय̍त मा
57.m:
At the impulse of the divine Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan,
I take [you]. You are a gift. Make this sacrifice deep, well-pressed for Indra,
with the highest rim, full of vigor, full of sweetness, full of milk.
You are the Nigrābhya waters, heard by the gods: satisfy me!

57.s: mano̍ me tarpaya̱ta̱ vāca̍ṃ me tarpayata prā̱ṇaṃ me̍ tarpayata̱ cakṣu̍rme tarpayata̱ śrotra̍ṃ me tarpayata ā̱tmāna̍ṃ me tarpayata pra̱jāṃ me̍ tarpayata pa̱śūn me̍ tarpayata ga̱ṇānme̍ tarpayata ga̱ṇā me̱ mā vi̍tṛṣan
57.d: मनो̍ मे तर्पय̱त̱ वाच̍ं मे तर्पयत प्रा̱णं मे̍ तर्पयत̱ चक्षु̍र्मे तर्पयत̱ श्रोत्र̍ं मे तर्पयत आ̱त्मान̍ं मे तर्पयत प्र̱जां मे̍ तर्पयत प̱शून् मे̍ तर्पयत ग̱णान्मे̍ तर्पयत ग̱णा मे̱ मा वि̍तृषन्
57.m:
Satisfy my mind, satisfy my speech, satisfy my in-breath, satisfy my sight, satisfy my hearing,
satisfy my Self, satisfy my offspring, satisfy my cattle, satisfy my retinues; may my retinues not thirst!

57.s: indrā̍ya tvā vasu̍mate ru̱drava̍ta̱ indrā̍ya tvādi̱tyava̍te indrā̍ya tvābhimāti̱ghne śye̱nāya̍ tvā soma̱bhṛte̱'gnaye̍ tvā rāyaspoṣa̱de
57.d: इन्द्रा̍य त्वा वसु̍मते रु̱द्रव̍त̱ इन्द्रा̍य त्वादि̱त्यव̍ते इन्द्रा̍य त्वाभिमाति̱घ्ने श्ये̱नाय̍ त्वा सोम̱भृते̱ऽग्नये̍ त्वा रायस्पोष̱दे
57.m:
For Indra accompanied by the Vasus, accompanied by the Rudras, for Indra accompanied by the Ādityas,
for Indra slayer of foes; for the falcon that brought Soma; for Agni giver of increase of wealth [I take you].

57.s: yatte̍ soma di̱vi jyoti̱ryatpṛ̍thi̱vyāṃ yadu̱rā a̱ntari̍kṣe tenā̱smai yaja̍mānāyo̱ru rā̱ye kṛ̍dhyadhi̍ dā̱tre vo̍caḥ
57.d: यत्ते̍ सोम दि̱वि ज्योति̱र्यत्पृ̍थि̱व्यां यदु̱रा अ̱न्तरि̍क्षे तेना̱स्मै यज̍मानायो̱रु रा̱ये कृ̍ध्यधि̍ दा̱त्रे वो̍चः
57.m:
Whatever light of yours, O Soma, is in heaven, whatever on earth, whatever in the wide mid-air,
with that make wide room for this sacrificer for wealth; speak for the giver!

57.s: śvā̱trā stha̍ vṛtra̱turo̱ rādho̍gū̱rtā a̱mṛta̍sya̱ patnī̍: tā de̍vīrde̱va̱tremaṃ ya̱jñaṃ na̍ya̱topa̍hūtāḥ soma̍sya pibata
57.d: श्वा̱त्रा स्थ̍ वृत्र̱तुरो̱ राधो̍गू̱र्ता अ̱मृत̍स्य̱ पत्नी̍: ता दे̍वीर्दे̱व̱त्रेमं य̱ज्ञं न̍य̱तोप̍हूताः सोम̍स्य पिबत
57.m:
You are invigorating, overcoming Vṛtra, approved by bounty, spouses of immortality.
As such, O goddesses, lead this sacrifice to the gods; being invited, drink of the Soma!

57.s: mā bhermā saṃvi̍kthā̱ ūrja̍ṃ dhatsva dhiṣaṇe vī̱ḍvī sa̱tī vī̍ḍayethāmūrja̍ṃ dadhāthām pā̱pmā ha̱to na soma̍:
57.d: मा भेर्मा संवि̍क्था̱ ऊर्ज̍ं धत्स्व धिषणे वी̱ड्वी स̱ती वी̍डयेथामूर्ज̍ं दधाथाम् पा̱प्मा ह̱तो न सोम̍:
57.m:
Fear not, tremble not, hold vigor! O two sacred receptacles, being firm, make yourselves firm, hold vigor!
Evil is slain, not Soma.

From the east, from the west, from the north, from the south, from all sides let the directions run to you.
O mother, bring out; may the rivals know!

57.s:
tvama̱ṅga praśa̍m̐siṣo de̱vaḥ śavi̍ṣṭha̱ martya̍m na tvada̱nyo ma̍ghavannasti marḍi̱tendra̱ bravī̍mi̱ te̱ vaca̍ḥ
(8) devasya tvā sapta
upāvīrasyaṣṭa
namaste sapta
sante pañca
samudraṃ pañca
haviṣmatīstisraḥ
hṛde tvā sapta
devasya tvāṣṭa
57.d:
त्वम̱ङ्ग प्रश̍म्̐सिषो दे̱वः शवि̍ष्ठ̱ मर्त्य̍म् न त्वद̱न्यो म̍घवन्नस्ति मर्डि̱तेन्द्र̱ ब्रवी̍मि̱ ते̱ वच̍ः
(8) देवस्य त्वा सप्त
उपावीरस्यष्ट
नमस्ते सप्त
सन्ते पञ्च
समुद्रं पञ्च
हविष्मतीस्तिस्रः
हृदे त्वा सप्त
देवस्य त्वाष्ट
57.m:
You indeed, O mightiest god, praise the mortal; / there is no other comforter than you, O Maghavan, Indra! I speak your word.

‘Devasya tvā’, seven; ‘upāvīrasya’, eight; ‘namas te’, seven; ‘saṃ te’, five; ‘samudram’, five; ‘haviṣmatīḥ’, three; ‘hṛde tvā’, seven; ‘devasya tvā’, eight. / Fifty in the eight anuvākas. Fifty, equal to ‘iṣe devasya’. / Thus ends the sixth adhyāya in the Śukla Yajurveda Kāṇva Saṃhitā.

57.s:
aṣṭānuvākeṣu pañcāśat
iṣe devasya samāḥ pañcāśat
57.d:
अष्टानुवाकेषु पञ्चाशत्
इषे देवस्य समाः पञ्चाशत्

58.s: vā̱caspata̍ye pavasva̱ vṛṣṇo̍ a̱m̐śubhyā̱ṃ gabha̍stipūtaḥ de̱vo de̱vebhya̍ḥ pavasva̱ yeṣā̍ṃ bhā̱go'si̱ madhu̍matī̱rna iṣa̍skṛdhi
58.d: वा̱चस्पत̍ये पवस्व̱ वृष्णो̍ अ̱म्̐शुभ्या̱ं गभ̍स्तिपूतः दे̱वो दे̱वेभ्य̍ः पवस्व̱ येषा̍ं भा̱गोऽसि̱ मधु̍मती̱र्न इष̍स्कृधि
58.m: Clarify yourself for the Lord of Speech from the shoots of the bull, purified by the hands! / Being a god, clarify yourself for the gods whose share you are; make our refreshments full of honey!

58.s: yatte̍ somādā̍bhya̱ṃ nāma̱ jāgṛ̍vi̱ tasmai̍ te soma̱ somā̍ya̱ svāhā̍ svāho̱rva̱ntari̍kṣa̱manve̍mi̱ svāṅkṛ̍to'si̱ viśve̍bhya indri̱yebhyo̍ di̱vyebhya̱: pārthi̍vebhyaḥ
58.d: यत्ते̍ सोमादा̍भ्य̱ं नाम̱ जागृ̍वि̱ तस्मै̍ ते सोम̱ सोमा̍य̱ स्वाहा̍ स्वाहो̱र्व̱न्तरि̍क्ष̱मन्वे̍मि̱ स्वाङ्कृ̍तोऽसि̱ विश्वे̍भ्य इन्द्रि̱येभ्यो̍ दि̱व्येभ्य̱: पार्थि̍वेभ्यः
58.m: What name of yours, O Soma, is undeceived and wakeful, to that of yours, to Soma, svāhā! / Svāhā! I follow along the broad mid-air. You are consecrated for all the divine and earthly sensory powers.

58.s: mana̍stvāṣṭu̱ svāhā̍ tvā svabhāna̱: sūryā̍ya | de̱vebhya̍stvā marīci̱pebhyo̍ de̱vām̐śo̱ yasmai̱ tveḷe̍ tatsa̱tyamu̍pa̱ripru̱tā̍ bha̱ṅgena̍ ha̱tosau phaṭ ⍼ prā̱ṇāya̍ tvā vyā̱nāya̍ tvā
58.d: मन̍स्त्वाष्टु̱ स्वाहा̍ त्वा स्वभान̱: सूर्या̍य । दे̱वेभ्य̍स्त्वा मरीचि̱पेभ्यो̍ दे̱वाम्̐शो̱ यस्मै̱ त्वेऌए̍ तत्स̱त्यमु̍प̱रिप्रु̱ता̍ भ̱ङ्गेन̍ ह̱तोसौ फट् ⍼ प्रा̱णाय̍ त्वा व्या̱नाय̍ त्वा
58.m: May your mind rejoice! Svāhā to you, the well-formed one, for Sūrya! To the gods who drink the rays [I offer] you, O god-shoot, for whichever [god] I implore you! / That is true: with the fragment floating above, struck down is that one, phaṭ! For prāṇa [I take] you, for vyāna you.

59.s:
(
) u̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'syantaryaccha maghavan pā̱hi soma̍m | u̱ruṣya rā̱yoveṣo̍ yajasva
59.d:
(
) उ̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽस्यन्तर्यच्छ मघवन् पा̱हि सोम̍म् । उ̱रुष्य रा̱योवेषो̍ यजस्व
59.m: You are taken with a support; restrain within, O Maghavan! Protect the Soma! / Save for the sake of wealth, O vigorous one; sacrifice!

59.s: a̱ntaste̍ dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī da̍dhāmya̱ntarda̍dhāmyu̱rva̱ntari̍kṣam sa̱jūrde̱vebhi̱ravarai̱: parai̍ścāntaryā̱me ma̍ghavan mādayasva svāho̱rva̱ntari̍kṣa̱manve̍mi̱ svāṅkṛ̍to'si̱ viśve̍bhya indri̱yebhyo̍ di̱vyebhya̱: pārthi̍vebhyaḥ mana̍stvāṣṭu̱ svāhā̍ tvā svabhāna̱: sūryā̍ya | de̱vebhya̍stvā marīci̱pebhya̍ u̱dānāya̍ tvā
59.d: अ̱न्तस्ते̍ द्यावा̍पृथि̱वी द̍धाम्य̱न्तर्द̍धाम्यु̱र्व̱न्तरि̍क्षम् स̱जूर्दे̱वेभि̱रवरै̱: परै̍श्चान्तर्या̱मे म̍घवन् मादयस्व स्वाहो̱र्व̱न्तरि̍क्ष̱मन्वे̍मि̱ स्वाङ्कृ̍तोऽसि̱ विश्वे̍भ्य इन्द्रि̱येभ्यो̍ दि̱व्येभ्य̱: पार्थि̍वेभ्यः मन̍स्त्वाष्टु̱ स्वाहा̍ त्वा स्वभान̱: सूर्या̍य । दे̱वेभ्य̍स्त्वा मरीचि̱पेभ्य̍ उ̱दानाय̍ त्वा
59.m: Within you I place heaven and earth; within I place the broad mid-air. / United with the lower and higher gods, exhilarate yourself in the Antaryāma cup, O Maghavan! / Svāhā! I follow along the broad mid-air. You are consecrated for all the divine and earthly sensory powers. / May your mind rejoice! Svāhā to you, the well-formed one, for Sūrya! To the gods who drink the rays [I offer] you, for udāna you.

60.s: (2)5 ā vā̍yo bhūṣa śucipā̱ upa̍ naḥ sa̱hasra̍ṃ te ni̱yuto̍ viśvavāra upo̍ te andho̱ madya̍mayāmi̱ yasya̍ deva dadhi̱ṣe pūrva̱peya̍ṃ vā̱yave̍ tvā
60.d: (2)5 आ वा̍यो भूष शुचिपा̱ उप̍ नः स̱हस्र̍ं ते नि̱युतो̍ विश्ववार उपो̍ ते अन्धो̱ मद्य̍मयामि̱ यस्य̍ देव दधि̱षे पूर्व̱पेय̍ं वा̱यवे̍ त्वा
60.m: Come near, O Vāyu, drinker of the pure, to us; a thousand are your teams of steeds, O you desired by all! / To you I bring near the intoxicating plant-juice, of which, O god, you hold the first drink; for Vāyu [I take] you.

60.s: indra̍vāyū i̱me su̱tā upa̱ prayo̍bhirāga̍tam | inda̍vo vāmu̱śanti̱ hi u̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'si vā̱yava̍ indravā̱yubhyā̱ṃ tvaiṣa te̱ yoni̍: sa̱joṣo̍bhyāṃ tvā
60.d: इन्द्र̍वायू इ̱मे सु̱ता उप̱ प्रयो̍भिराग̍तम् । इन्द̍वो वामु̱शन्ति̱ हि उ̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽसि वा̱यव̍ इन्द्रवा̱युभ्या̱ं त्वैष ते̱ योनि̍: स̱जोषो̍भ्यां त्वा
60.m: O Indra and Vāyu, these [soma juices] are pressed; come with refreshments! / For the drops desire you both. / You are taken with a support; for Vāyu, for Indra and Vāyu [I take] you. This is your womb; for the two who rejoice together [I take] you.

61.s: (3) a̱yaṃ vā̍ṃ mitrāvaruṇā su̱taḥ soma̍ ṛtāvṛdhā | mamedi̱ha śru̍ta̱m̐ hava̍m u̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'si mi̱trāvaru̍ṇābhyāṃ tvā
61.d: (3) अ̱यं वा̍ं मित्रावरुणा सु̱तः सोम̍ ऋतावृधा । ममेदि̱ह श्रु̍त̱म्̐ हव̍म् उ̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽसि मि̱त्रावरु̍णाभ्यां त्वा
61.m: This Soma has been pressed for you both, O Mitra and Varuṇa, who increase truth! / Hear my call here! / You are taken with a support; for Mitra and Varuṇa [I take] you.

61.s: rā̱yā va̱yam̐ sa̍sṛvā̱m̐so̍ madema ha̱vyena̍ devā yava̍sena̱ gāva̍ḥ tāṃ dhe̱nuṃ mi̍trāvaruṇā yu̱vaṃ no̍ vi̱śvāhā̍ dhatta̱mana̍pasphurantīm | e̱ṣa te̱ yoni̍rṛtā̱yubhyā̍ṃ tvā
61.d: रा̱या व̱यम्̐ स̍सृवा̱म्̐सो̍ मदेम ह̱व्येन̍ देवा यव̍सेन̱ गाव̍ः तां धे̱नुं मि̍त्रावरुणा यु̱वं नो̍ वि̱श्वाहा̍ धत्त̱मन̍पस्फुरन्तीम् । ए̱ष ते̱ योनि̍रृता̱युभ्या̍ं त्वा
61.m: Having obtained wealth may we exult, as the gods with oblation, as cows with grass! / Grant to us forever, O Mitra and Varuṇa, that unkicking milch-cow! This is your womb; for the two who cherish truth [I take] you.

62.s:
(4)9 yā vā̱ṃ kaśā̱ madhu̍matyaśvinā sū̱nṛtā̍vatī | tayā̍ ya̱jñaṃ mi̍mikṣatam u̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'sya̱śvibhyā̍ṃ tvai̱ṣa te̱ yoni̱rmādhvī̍bhyāṃ tvā
(5) taṃ pra̱tnathā̍ pū̱rvathā̍ vi̱śvathe̱mathā̍ jye̱ṣṭhatā̍tiṃ barhi̱ṣada̍m̐ sva̱rvida̍m pra̱tīcī̍naṃ vṛ̱jana̍ṃ dohase dhuni̍mā̱śuṃ jaya̍nta̱manu̱ yāsu̱ vardha̍se | u̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'si śa̱ṇḍāya̍ tvā
62.d:
(4)9 या वा̱ं कशा̱ मधु̍मत्यश्विना सू̱नृता̍वती । तया̍ य̱ज्ञं मि̍मिक्षतम् उ̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽस्य̱श्विभ्या̍ं त्वै̱ष ते̱ योनि̱र्माध्वी̍भ्यां त्वा
(5) तं प्र̱त्नथा̍ पू̱र्वथा̍ वि̱श्वथे̱मथा̍ ज्ये̱ष्ठता̍तिं बर्हि̱षद̍म्̐ स्व̱र्विद̍म् प्र̱तीची̍नं वृ̱जन̍ं दोहसे धुनि̍मा̱शुं जय̍न्त̱मनु̱ यासु̱ वर्ध̍से । उ̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽसि श̱ण्डाय̍ त्वा
62.m:
The whip of yours that is full of sweetness, O Aśvins, full of true praise, / with that sprinkle the sacrifice! / You are taken with a support; for the Aśvins [I take] you. This is your womb; for the two lovers of sweetness [I take] you.

Him, as of old, as formerly, as everywhere, as now, the elder, sitting on the sacrificial grass, finding heaven, / facing towards us, to milk the roaring throng, swift, conquering, among whom you grow. / You are taken with a support; for Śaṇḍa [I take] you.

62.s: e̱ṣa te̱ yoni̍rvī̱ratā̍ṃ pā̱hyapa̍mṛṣṭaḥ śa̱ṇḍo de̱vāstvā̍ śu̱krapāḥ praṇa̍yantvanā̍dhṛṣṭāsi su̱vīro̍ vī̱rān pra̍ja̱nayan parī̍hya̱bhi rā̱yaspoṣe̍ṇa̱ yaja̍mānam saṃ ja̍gmāno di̱vā pṛ̍thi̱vyā śu̱kraḥ śu̱kraśo̍ciṣā̱ nira̍staḥ śa̱ṇḍaḥ śu̱krasyādhi̍ṣṭhānamasi
62.d: ए̱ष ते̱ योनि̍र्वी̱रता̍ं पा̱ह्यप̍मृष्टः श̱ण्डो दे̱वास्त्वा̍ शु̱क्रपाः प्रण̍यन्त्वना̍धृष्टासि सु̱वीरो̍ वी̱रान् प्र̍ज̱नयन् परी̍ह्य̱भि रा̱यस्पोषे̍ण̱ यज̍मानम् सं ज̍ग्मानो दि̱वा पृ̍थि̱व्या शु̱क्रः शु̱क्रशो̍चिषा̱ निर̍स्तः श̱ण्डः शु̱क्रस्याधि̍ष्ठानमसि
62.m: This is your womb; protect heroism! Wiped away is Śaṇḍa; may the gods who drink the pure lead you forth! You are unassailable. / Rich in heroes, begetting heroes, encompass the sacrificer with abundance of wealth! / Uniting with heaven and earth, pure with pure brilliance, expelled is Śaṇḍa; you are the resting-place of the pure.

62.s: acchi̍nnasya te deva soma suvī̱rya̍sya rā̱yaspoṣa̍sya dadi̱tāra̍: syāma sā pra̍tha̱mā saṃm̐skṛ̍tirvi̱śvavā̍rā̱ sa pra̍tha̱mo varu̍ṇo mi̱tro a̱gniḥ
62.d: अच्छि̍न्नस्य ते देव सोम सुवी̱र्य̍स्य रा̱यस्पोष̍स्य ददि̱तार̍: स्याम सा प्र̍थ̱मा संम्̐स्कृ̍तिर्वि̱श्ववा̍रा̱ स प्र̍थ̱मो वरु̍णो मि̱त्रो अ̱ग्निः
62.m: May we be the givers of your unbroken, heroic vigor and abundance of wealth, O divine Soma! / That first preparation was all-desirable; that first one was Varuṇa, Mitra, Agni.

62.s: sa pra̍tha̱mo bṛha̱spati̍ścikitvām̐stasmā indrā̍ya sutamā ju̍hotu̱ svāhā̍ tṛmpantu̱ hotrā̱ madhvo̍ ya̱tsviṣṭa̱ṃ yatsu̍bhṛ̱taṃ yatsvāhā̍
62.d: स प्र̍थ̱मो बृह̱स्पति̍श्चिकित्वाम्̐स्तस्मा इन्द्रा̍य सुतमा जु̍होतु̱ स्वाहा̍ तृम्पन्तु̱ होत्रा̱ मध्वो̍ य̱त्स्विष्ट̱ं यत्सु̍भृ̱तं यत्स्वाहा̍
62.m: That first one was wise Bṛhaspati; to that Indra offer the pressed [Soma], svāhā! / May the Hotṛ-callings be satisfied with the sweet, whatever has been well sacrificed, whatever has been well brought, whatever with svāhā!

63.s: (6) a̱yaṃ ve̱naśco̍daya̱tpṛśni̍garbhā̱ jyoti̍rjarā̱yū raja̍so vi̱māne̍ i̱mama̱pām̐ sa̍ṃga̱me sūrya̍sya̱ śiśu̱ṃ na viprā̍ ma̱tibhī̍ rihanti u̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'si ma̱rkāya̍ tvā
63.d: (6) अ̱यं वे̱नश्चो̍दय̱त्पृश्नि̍गर्भा̱ ज्योति̍र्जरा̱यू रज̍सो वि̱माने̍ इ̱मम̱पाम्̐ स̍ंग̱मे सूर्य̍स्य̱ शिशु̱ं न विप्रा̍ म̱तिभी̍ रिहन्ति उ̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽसि म̱र्काय̍ त्वा
63.m: This longing [bird] has urged on those with the mottled womb, whose afterbirth is light, in the measure of mid-air. / Him, at the union of the waters and the sun, the inspired poets lick with thoughts as a child. / You are taken with a support; for Marka [I take] you.

63.s: mano̱ na yeṣu̱ hava̍neṣu ti̱gmaṃ vipa̍: śacyā̍ vanutho̱ drava̍ntā ā yaḥ śaryā̍bhistuvi̱nṛmṇo a̱syā śrīṇī̱tādi̱śaṃ gabha̍stau
63.d: मनो̱ न येषु̱ हव̍नेषु ति̱ग्मं विप̍: शच्या̍ वनुथो̱ द्रव̍न्ता आ यः शर्या̍भिस्तुवि̱नृम्णो अ̱स्या श्रीणी̱तादि̱शं गभ̍स्तौ
63.m: In which invocations, running by might like the mind, you win the sharp song of praise; / who, of great manly power, with arrows in his hand, has arrayed the quarter.

63.s: e̱ṣa te̱ yoni̍: pra̱jāḥ pā̱hyapa̍mṛṣṭo ma̱rko de̱vāstvā̍ ma̱nthipāḥ praṇa̍yantvanā̍dhṛṣṭāsi supra̱jāḥ pra̱jāḥ pra̍ja̱nayan parī̍hya̱bhi rā̱yaspoṣe̍ṇa̱ yaja̍mānam saṃja̍gmāno di̱vā pṛ̍thi̱vyā ma̱nthī ma̱nthiśo̍ciṣā̱ nira̍sto ma̱rko ma̱nthino'dhi̍ṣṭhānamasi
63.d: ए̱ष ते̱ योनि̍: प्र̱जाः पा̱ह्यप̍मृष्टो म̱र्को दे̱वास्त्वा̍ म̱न्थिपाः प्रण̍यन्त्वना̍धृष्टासि सुप्र̱जाः प्र̱जाः प्र̍ज̱नयन् परी̍ह्य̱भि रा̱यस्पोषे̍ण̱ यज̍मानम् संज̍ग्मानो दि̱वा पृ̍थि̱व्या म̱न्थी म̱न्थिशो̍चिषा̱ निर̍स्तो म̱र्को म̱न्थिनोऽधि̍ष्ठानमसि
63.m: This is your womb; protect offspring! Wiped away is Marka; may the gods who drink the stirred [soma] lead you forth! You are unassailable. / Rich in good offspring, begetting offspring, encompass the sacrificer with abundance of wealth! / Uniting with heaven and earth, stirred with stirred brilliance, expelled is Marka; you are the resting-place of the stirred [soma].

63.s: acchi̍nnasya te deva soma suvī̱rya̍sya rā̱yaspoṣa̍sya dadi̱tāra̍: syāma sā pra̍tha̱mā saṃm̐skṛ̍tirvi̱śvavā̍rā̱ sa pra̍tha̱mo varu̍ṇo mi̱tro a̱gniḥ
63.d: अच्छि̍न्नस्य ते देव सोम सुवी̱र्य̍स्य रा̱यस्पोष̍स्य ददि̱तार̍: स्याम सा प्र̍थ̱मा संम्̐स्कृ̍तिर्वि̱श्ववा̍रा̱ स प्र̍थ̱मो वरु̍णो मि̱त्रो अ̱ग्निः
63.m: May we be the givers of your unbroken, heroic vigor and abundance of wealth, O divine Soma! / That first preparation was all-desirable; that first one was Varuṇa, Mitra, Agni.

63.s: sa pra̍tha̱mo bṛha̱spati̍ścikitvām̐stasmā indrā̍ya sutamā ju̍hotu̱ svāhā̍ tṛmpantu̱ hotrā̱ madhvo̍ ya̱tsviṣṭa̱ṃ yatsu̍bhṛ̱taṃ yatsvāhā̍
63.d: स प्र̍थ̱मो बृह̱स्पति̍श्चिकित्वाम्̐स्तस्मा इन्द्रा̍य सुतमा जु̍होतु̱ स्वाहा̍ तृम्पन्तु̱ होत्रा̱ मध्वो̍ य̱त्स्विष्ट̱ं यत्सु̍भृ̱तं यत्स्वाहा̍
63.m: That first one was wise Bṛhaspati; to that Indra offer the pressed [Soma], svāhā! / May the Hotṛ-callings be satisfied with the sweet, whatever has been well sacrificed, whatever has been well brought, whatever with svāhā!

64.s: ) ye de̍vāso di̱vyekā̍daśa̱ stha pṛ̍thi̱vyāmaddhyekā̍daśa̱ stha a̱psu̱kṣito̍ mahi̱naikā̍daśa̱ stha te de̍vāso ya̱jñami̱maṃ ju̍ṣadhvam
64.d: ) ये दे̍वासो दि̱व्येका̍दश̱ स्थ पृ̍थि̱व्यामद्ध्येका̍दश̱ स्थ अ̱प्सु̱क्षितो̍ महि̱नैका̍दश̱ स्थ ते दे̍वासो य̱ज्ञमि̱मं जु̍षध्वम्
64.m: You gods who are eleven in heaven, who are eleven upon the earth, / who dwell in the waters, eleven in your greatness: you gods, enjoy this sacrifice!

64.s: u̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'syāgraya̱ṇo̍'si svāgraya̱ṇaḥ | pā̱hi ya̱jñaṃ pā̱hi ya̱jñapa̍tim
64.d: उ̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽस्याग्रय̱णो̍ऽसि स्वाग्रय̱णः । पा̱हि य̱ज्ञं पा̱हि य̱ज्ञप̍तिम्
64.m: You are taken with a support; you are the Āgrayaṇa cup, having a good beginning. Protect the sacrifice, protect the lord of sacrifice!

64.s: viṣṇu̱stvāmi̍ndri̱yeṇa̍ pātu̱ viṣṇu̱ṃ tvaṃ pā̍hya̱bhi sava̍nāni pāhi soma̍: pava̱te̱ soma̍: pava̱te̱ soma̍: pavate
64.d: विष्णु̱स्त्वामि̍न्द्रि̱येण̍ पातु̱ विष्णु̱ं त्वं पा̍ह्य̱भि सव̍नानि पाहि सोम̍: पव̱ते̱ सोम̍: पव̱ते̱ सोम̍: पवते
64.m: May Viṣṇu protect you with sensory power; protect Viṣṇu; protect all beings! / Soma clarifies himself; Soma clarifies himself; Soma clarifies himself!

64.s: a̱smai brahma̍ṇe pavate̱'smai kṣa̱trāya̍ pavate̱'smai su̍nva̱te yaja̍mānāya pavate iṣa ūrje pa̍vate̱'dbhya oṣa̍dhībhyaḥ pava̱te̱ dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vībhyā̍ṃ pavate subhū̱tāya̍ pavate brahmavarca̱sā' pavate viśve̍bhyastvā de̱vebhya̍ e̱ṣa te̱ yoni̱rviśve̍bhyastvā de̱vebhya̍:
64.d: अ̱स्मै ब्रह्म̍णे पवते̱ऽस्मै क्ष̱त्राय̍ पवते̱ऽस्मै सु̍न्व̱ते यज̍मानाय पवते इष ऊर्जे प̍वते̱ऽद्भ्य ओष̍धीभ्यः पव̱ते̱ द्यावा̍पृथि̱वीभ्या̍ं पवते सुभू̱ताय̍ पवते ब्रह्मवर्च̱सा' पवते विश्वे̍भ्यस्त्वा दे̱वेभ्य̍ ए̱ष ते̱ योनि̱र्विश्वे̍भ्यस्त्वा दे̱वेभ्य̍:
64.m: For this Brahman he clarifies himself; for this princely power he clarifies himself; for this pressing sacrificer he clarifies himself; / for refreshment, for strength he clarifies himself; for the waters and the plants he clarifies himself; for heaven and earth he clarifies himself; for well-being he clarifies himself; for spiritual splendor he clarifies himself. / For the All-Gods [I take] you. This is your womb; for the All-Gods [I take] you.

65.s: (8) u̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'sīndrā̍ya tvā bṛha̱dvate̱ vaya̍svata ukthā̱yuva̍ṃ gṛhṇāmi yatta̍ indra bṛha̱dvaya̱stasmai̍ tvā̱ viṣṇa̍ve tvai̱ṣate̱ yoni̍ru̱kthebhya̍stvā
65.d: (8) उ̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽसीन्द्रा̍य त्वा बृह̱द्वते̱ वय̍स्वत उक्था̱युव̍ं गृह्णामि यत्त̍ इन्द्र बृह̱द्वय̱स्तस्मै̍ त्वा̱ विष्ण̍वे त्वै̱षते̱ योनि̍रु̱क्थेभ्य̍स्त्वा
65.m: You are taken with a support; for Indra who has the Bṛhat [sāman], who possesses vigor, longing for hymns, I take you. / What lofty vigor is yours, O Indra, for that [I take] you; for Viṣṇu [I take] you. This is your womb; for the recited hymns [I take] you.

65.s: de̱vebhya̍stvā de̱vāyuva̍ṃ gṛhṇāmi ya̱jñasyāyu̍ṣe mi̱trāvaru̍ṇābhyāṃ tvā de̱vāyuva̍ṃ gṛhṇāmi ya̱jñasyāyu̍ṣe indrā̍ya tvā de̱vāyuva̍ṃ gṛhṇāmi ya̱jñasyāyu̍ṣa indrā̱gnibhyā̍ṃ tvā de̱vāyuva̍ṃ gṛhṇāmi ya̱jñasyāyu̍ṣe indrā̍ya tvā de̱vāyuva̍ṃ gṛhṇāmi ya̱jñasyāyu̍ṣa indrā̱varu̍ṇābhyāṃ tvā de̱vāyuva̍ṃ gṛhṇāmi ya̱jñasyāyu̍ṣe indrā̱bṛha̱spati̍bhyāṃ tvā de̱vāyuva̍ṃ gṛhṇāmi ya̱jñasyāyu̍ṣa indrā̱viṣṇu̍bhyāṃ tvā de̱vāyuva̍ṃ gṛhṇāmi ya̱jñasyāyu̍ṣe
65.d: दे̱वेभ्य̍स्त्वा दे̱वायुव̍ं गृह्णामि य̱ज्ञस्यायु̍षे मि̱त्रावरु̍णाभ्यां त्वा दे̱वायुव̍ं गृह्णामि य̱ज्ञस्यायु̍षे इन्द्रा̍य त्वा दे̱वायुव̍ं गृह्णामि य̱ज्ञस्यायु̍ष इन्द्रा̱ग्निभ्या̍ं त्वा दे̱वायुव̍ं गृह्णामि य̱ज्ञस्यायु̍षे इन्द्रा̍य त्वा दे̱वायुव̍ं गृह्णामि य̱ज्ञस्यायु̍ष इन्द्रा̱वरु̍णाभ्यां त्वा दे̱वायुव̍ं गृह्णामि य̱ज्ञस्यायु̍षे इन्द्रा̱बृह̱स्पति̍भ्यां त्वा दे̱वायुव̍ं गृह्णामि य̱ज्ञस्यायु̍ष इन्द्रा̱विष्णु̍भ्यां त्वा दे̱वायुव̍ं गृह्णामि य̱ज्ञस्यायु̍षे
65.m:
I take you, devoted to the gods, for the gods, for the life of the sacrifice. I take you, devoted to the gods, for Mitra and Varuṇa, for the life of the sacrifice.
I take you, devoted to the gods, for Indra, for the life of the sacrifice. I take you, devoted to the gods, for Indrāgnī, for the life of the sacrifice.
I take you, devoted to the gods, for Indra, for the life of the sacrifice. I take you, devoted to the gods, for Indrāvaruṇa, for the life of the sacrifice.
I take you, devoted to the gods, for Indrābṛhaspati, for the life of the sacrifice. I take you, devoted to the gods, for Indrāviṣṇu, for the life of the sacrifice.

66.s: (9) mū̱rdhāna̍ṃ di̱vo a̍ra̱tiṃ pṛ̍thi̱vyā vai̍śvāna̱ramṛ̱ta ā jā̱tama̱gnim ka̱vim̐ sa̱mrāja̱mati̍thiṃ janā̍nāmā̱sannā pā̱tra̍ṃ janayanta de̱vāḥ
66.d: (9) मू̱र्धान̍ं दि̱वो अ̍र̱तिं पृ̍थि̱व्या वै̍श्वान̱रमृ̱त आ जा̱तम̱ग्निम् क̱विम्̐ स̱म्राज̱मति̍थिं जना̍नामा̱सन्ना पा̱त्र̍ं जनयन्त दे̱वाः
66.m:
The head of heaven, the ruler of the earth, Agni Vaiśvānara born in cosmic order,
the sage, the sovereign king, the guest of men—him the gods brought forth as a vessel for their mouth.

66.s: u̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'si dhru̱vo̍'si dhruvakṣi̱tirdhru̱vāṇā̍ṃ dhru̱vata̱mo'cyu̍tānāmacyutakṣi̱ttama̍: e̱ṣa te̱ yoni̍rvaiśvāna̱rāya̍ tvā
66.d: उ̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽसि ध्रु̱वो̍ऽसि ध्रुवक्षि̱तिर्ध्रु̱वाणा̍ं ध्रु̱वत̱मोऽच्यु̍तानामच्युतक्षि̱त्तम̍: ए̱ष ते̱ योनि̍र्वैश्वान̱राय̍ त्वा
66.m:
You are taken with a support; you are firm, the firm-seated, the firmest of the firm, the most unshakeably settled of the unshakeable.
This is your womb; for Vaiśvānara [I take] you.

66.s: dhru̱vaṃ dhru̱veṇa̱ mana̍sā vā̱cā soma̍mava̍nayāmi | athā̍ na̱ indra̱ idviśo̍ sapa̱tnāḥ sama̍nasaskarat
66.d: ध्रु̱वं ध्रु̱वेण̱ मन̍सा वा̱चा सोम̍मव̍नयामि । अथा̍ न̱ इन्द्र̱ इद्विशो̍ सप̱त्नाः सम̍नसस्करत्
66.m: With a firm mind, with speech, I pour down the firm soma, so that Indra may make our clans free from rivals and of one mind.

67.s:
yaste̍ dra̱psa skanda̍ti̱ yaste̍ a̱m̐śurbā̱hvacyu̍to dhi̱ṣaṇa̍yoru̱pasthā̍t a̱dhva̱ryorvā̱ pari̍ vā̱ yaḥ pa̱vitrā̱ttaṃ te̍ juhomi̱ mana̍sā vaṣa̍ṭkṛ̱tam̐ svāhā̍ de̱vānā̍mutkrama̍ṇamasi
(11) u̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'si ma̱dhave̍ tvo̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'si māgha̍vāya tvā u̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'si śu̱krāya̍ tvo̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'si śuca̍ye tvā u̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'si nabha̍se tvo̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'si̱ nabha̱syā̍ya tvā u̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'sīṣe tvo̍pa̱yāmagṛ̍hīto'syūrje tvā̍ u̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'si saha̍se tvo̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'si saha̱syā̍ya tvā u̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'si tapa̍se tvo̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'si tapa̱syā̍ya tvā u̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'syam̐hasaspata̍ye tvā
(12) indrā̍gnī ārga̍tam̐ su̱taṃ gī̱rbhirnamo̱ vare̍ṇyam | a̱sya pā̍taṃ dhi̱yeṣi̍tā u̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'sīndrā̱gnibhyā̍ṃ tvai̱ṣa te̱ yoni̍rindrā̱gnibhyā̍ṃ tvā
67.d:
यस्ते̍ द्र̱प्स स्कन्द̍ति̱ यस्ते̍ अ̱म्̐शुर्बा̱ह्वच्यु̍तो धि̱षण̍योरु̱पस्था̍त् अ̱ध्व̱र्योर्वा̱ परि̍ वा̱ यः प̱वित्रा̱त्तं ते̍ जुहोमि̱ मन̍सा वष̍ट्कृ̱तम्̐ स्वाहा̍ दे̱वाना̍मुत्क्रम̍णमसि
(11) उ̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽसि म̱धवे̍ त्वो̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽसि माघ̍वाय त्वा उ̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽसि शु̱क्राय̍ त्वो̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽसि शुच̍ये त्वा उ̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽसि नभ̍से त्वो̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽसि̱ नभ̱स्या̍य त्वा उ̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽसीषे त्वो̍प̱यामगृ̍हीतोऽस्यूर्जे त्वा̍ उ̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽसि सह̍से त्वो̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽसि सह̱स्या̍य त्वा उ̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽसि तप̍से त्वो̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽसि तप̱स्या̍य त्वा उ̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽस्यम्̐हसस्पत̍ये त्वा
(12) इन्द्रा̍ग्नी आर्ग̍तम्̐ सु̱तं गी̱र्भिर्नमो̱ वरे̍ण्यम् । अ̱स्य पा̍तं धि̱येषि̍ता उ̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽसीन्द्रा̱ग्निभ्या̍ं त्वै̱ष ते̱ योनि̍रिन्द्रा̱ग्निभ्या̍ं त्वा
67.m:
What drop of yours falls, what stalk of yours, shaken by the pressing-stones, falls from the lap of the sacred receptacles,
or from the Adhvaryu priest, or from the strainer—that I offer for you with the mind, consecrated with vaṣaṭ, svāhā! You are the ascending of the gods.

You are taken with a support; for Madhu [I take] you. You are taken with a support; for Mādhava [I take] you.
