92.s: prā̱ṇāya̍ me varco̱dā varca̍se pavasva vyā̱nāya̍ me varco̱dā varca̍se pavasva u̱dā̱nāya̍ me varco̱dā varca̍se pavasva vā̱ce me̍ varco̱dā varca̍se pavasva
92.d: प्रा̱णाय̍ मे वर्चो̱दा वर्च̍से पवस्व व्या̱नाय̍ मे वर्चो̱दा वर्च̍से पवस्व उ̱दा̱नाय̍ मे वर्चो̱दा वर्च̍से पवस्व वा̱चे मे̍ वर्चो̱दा वर्च̍से पवस्व
92.m: Bestowing splendor for my in-breath, clarify yourself for splendor; bestowing splendor for my diffused breath, clarify yourself for splendor; / bestowing splendor for my up-breath, clarify yourself for splendor; bestowing splendor for my speech, clarify yourself for splendor.

92.s: kratū̱dakṣā̍bhyāṃ me varco̱dā varca̍se pavasva̱ śrotrā̍ya me varco̱dā varca̍se pavasva cakṣu̍bhyāṃ me varco̱dasau̱ varca̍se pavethām
92.d: क्रतू̱दक्षा̍भ्यां मे वर्चो̱दा वर्च̍से पवस्व̱ श्रोत्रा̍य मे वर्चो̱दा वर्च̍से पवस्व चक्षु̍भ्यां मे वर्चो̱दसौ̱ वर्च̍से पवेथाम्
92.m: Bestowing splendor for my resolve and skill, clarify yourself for splendor; bestowing splendor for my hearing, clarify yourself for splendor; / you two, bestowing splendor for my two eyes, clarify yourselves for splendor.

92.s: ā̱tmane̍ me varco̱dā varca̍se pava̱svauja̍se me varco̱dā varca̍se pava̱svāyu̍ṣe me varco̱dā varca̍se pavasva viśvā̍bhyo me pra̱jābhyo̍ varco̱dasau̱ varca̍se pavethām
92.d: आ̱त्मने̍ मे वर्चो̱दा वर्च̍से पव̱स्वौज̍से मे वर्चो̱दा वर्च̍से पव̱स्वायु̍षे मे वर्चो̱दा वर्च̍से पवस्व विश्वा̍भ्यो मे प्र̱जाभ्यो̍ वर्चो̱दसौ̱ वर्च̍से पवेथाम्
92.m: Bestowing splendor for my Self, clarify yourself for splendor; bestowing splendor for my vigor, clarify yourself for splendor; bestowing splendor for my life, clarify yourself for splendor; / you two, bestowing splendor for all my offspring, clarify yourselves for splendor.

92.s: ko̍'si kata̱mo̍'si kasyā̍si̱ ko nāmā̍si yasya̍ te̱ nāmāmanma̍hi̱ yaṃ tvā̱ some̱nātī̍tṛpāma
92.d: को̍ऽसि कत̱मो̍ऽसि कस्या̍सि̱ को नामा̍सि यस्य̍ ते̱ नामामन्म̍हि̱ यं त्वा̱ सोमे̱नाती̍तृपाम
92.m: Who are you? Which one of many are you? Whose are you? What is your name? / Whose name we have meditated upon, you whom we have satiated with soma.

92.s:
bhūrbhuva̱ḥ sva̍ḥ supra̱jāḥ pra̱jayā̍ bhūyāsam | su̱vīro̍ vī̱raiḥ su̱poṣa̱ḥ poṣai̍ḥ
(1)
92.d:
भूर्भुव̱ः स्व̍ः सुप्र̱जाः प्र̱जया̍ भूयासम् । सु̱वीरो̍ वी̱रैः सु̱पोष̱ः पोषै̍ः
(1)
92.m: Bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ! May I be rich in offspring through offspring, rich in heroes through heroes, rich in nourishment through nourishments.

93.s: udu̱ tyaṃ jā̱tave̍dasaṃ de̱vaṃ va̍hanti ke̱tava̍ḥ | dṛ̱śe viśvā̍ya̱ sūrya̍m
93.d: उदु̱ त्यं जा̱तवे̍दसं दे̱वं व̍हन्ति के̱तव̍ः । दृ̱शे विश्वा̍य̱ सूर्य̍म्
93.m: His beams carry up that god Jātavedas, / Sūrya, for all to see.

93.s: ci̱traṃ de̱vānā̱muda̍gā̱danī̍ka̱ṃ cakṣu̍rmi̱trasya̱ varu̍ṇasyā̱gneḥ ā prā̱ dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī a̱ntari̍kṣa̱m̐ sūrya̍ ā̱tmā jaga̍tasta̱sthuṣa̍śca
93.d: चि̱त्रं दे̱वाना̱मुद̍गा̱दनी̍क̱ं चक्षु̍र्मि̱त्रस्य̱ वरु̍णस्या̱ग्नेः आ प्रा̱ द्यावा̍पृथि̱वी अ̱न्तरि̍क्ष̱म्̐ सूर्य̍ आ̱त्मा जग̍तस्त̱स्थुष̍श्च
93.m: The wondrous face of the gods has arisen, the eye of Mitra, of Varuṇa, of Agni; / he has filled heaven and earth and mid-air, Sūrya, the Self of the moving and standing.

93.s: agne̱ naya̍ su̱pathā̍ rā̱ye a̱smān viśvā̍ni deva va̱yunā̍ni vi̱dvān yu̱yo̱dhya̱smajju̍hurā̱ṇameno̱ bhūyi̍ṣṭhāṃ te̱ nama̍ u̱ktiṃ vi̍dhema
93.d: अग्ने̱ नय̍ सु̱पथा̍ रा̱ये अ̱स्मान् विश्वा̍नि देव व̱युना̍नि वि̱द्वान् यु̱यो̱ध्य̱स्मज्जु̍हुरा̱णमेनो̱ भूयि̍ष्ठां ते̱ नम̍ उ̱क्तिं वि̍धेम
93.m: O Agni, lead us along a fair path to wealth, you, O god, who know all ways; / keep away from us crooked sin; we would offer you the most abundant word of homage.

93.s:
a̱yaṃ no̍ a̱gnirvari̍vaskṛṇotva̱yaṃ mṛdha̍ḥ pu̱ra e̍tu prabhi̱ndan a̱yaṃ vājā̍m̐ jayatu vā̱jasā̍tā a̱yam̐ śatrū̍m̐ jayatu jarhṛṣā̱ṇaḥ svāhā̍
rūpeṇa̍ vo rū̱pama̱bhyāgā̱ṃ tutho vo̍ vi̱śvave̍dā̱ vibha̍jatu ṛ̱tasya̍ pa̱thā preta̍ ca̱ndrada̍kṣiṇāḥ
93.d:
अ̱यं नो̍ अ̱ग्निर्वरि̍वस्कृणोत्व̱यं मृध̍ः पु̱र ए̍तु प्रभि̱न्दन् अ̱यं वाजा̍म्̐ जयतु वा̱जसा̍ता अ̱यम्̐ शत्रू̍म्̐ जयतु जर्हृषा̱णः स्वाहा̍
रूपेण̍ वो रू̱पम̱भ्यागा̱ं तुथो वो̍ वि̱श्ववे̍दा̱ विभ̍जतु ऋ̱तस्य̍ प̱था प्रेत̍ च̱न्द्रद̍क्षिणाः
93.m:
May this Agni make broad space for us; may he advance, shattering the adversaries; / may he win vital vigor in the contest for vital vigor; exulting, may he conquer the enemies, svāhā!

With form have I approached your form; let Tutha who knows all distribute you; / advance along the path of truth, O bright sacrificial gifts!

93.s: vi sva̍ḥ paśya̱vya̱ntari̍kṣaṃ yata̍sva sada̱syai̍ḥ brā̱hmaṇama̱dya vi̍deya pitṛ̱manta̍ṃ paitṛma̱tyamṛṣi̍mā̱rṣeya̱m̐ su̱dhātu̍da̱kṣiṇam
93.d: वि स्व̍ः पश्य̱व्य̱न्तरि̍क्षं यत̍स्व सद̱स्यै̍ः ब्रा̱ह्मणम̱द्य वि̍देय पितृ̱मन्त̍ं पैतृम̱त्यमृषि̍मा̱र्षेय̱म्̐ सु̱धातु̍द̱क्षिणम्
93.m: Look upon heaven, gaze across mid-air, join with the members of the assembly; / may I today find a brahmin having a [noble] father, having a [noble] grandfather, a seer sprung from seers, with well-portioned sacrificial gifts.

93.s: a̱smadrā̍tā de̱vatrā ga̍ccha pradā̱tāra̱māvi̍śa a̱gnaye̍ tvā̱ mahya̱ṃ varu̍ṇo dadātu̱ so'mṛ̍ta̱tvama̍śyāt
93.d: अ̱स्मद्रा̍ता दे̱वत्रा ग̍च्छ प्रदा̱तार̱मावि̍श अ̱ग्नये̍ त्वा̱ मह्य̱ं वरु̍णो ददातु̱ सोऽमृ̍त̱त्वम̍श्यात्
93.m: Given by us, go among the gods; enter into the giver. / Let Varuṇa give you to Agni for me; may he attain immortality!

93.s: āyu̍rdā̱tra e̍dhi̱ mayo̱ mahya̍ṃ pratigrahī̱tre ru̱drāya̍ tvā̱ mahya̱ṃ varu̍ṇo dadātu̱ so'mṛ̍ta̱tvama̍śyāt | prā̱ṇo dā̱tra e̍dhi̱ mayo̱ mahya̍ṃ pratigrahī̱tre bṛha̱spata̍ye tvā̱ mahya̱ṃ varu̍ṇo dadātu̱ so'mṛ̍ta̱tvama̍śyāt | tvagdā̱tra e̍dhi̱ mayo̱ mahya̍ṃ pratigrahī̱tre ya̱māya̍ tvā̱ mahya̱ṃ varu̍ṇo dadātu̱ so'mṛ̍ta̱tvama̍śyāt vayo̍ dā̱tra e̍dhi̱ mayo̱ mahya̍ṃ pratigrahī̱tre
93.d: आयु̍र्दा̱त्र ए̍धि̱ मयो̱ मह्य̍ं प्रतिग्रही̱त्रे रु̱द्राय̍ त्वा̱ मह्य̱ं वरु̍णो ददातु̱ सोऽमृ̍त̱त्वम̍श्यात् । प्रा̱णो दा̱त्र ए̍धि̱ मयो̱ मह्य̍ं प्रतिग्रही̱त्रे बृह̱स्पत̍ये त्वा̱ मह्य̱ं वरु̍णो ददातु̱ सोऽमृ̍त̱त्वम̍श्यात् । त्वग्दा̱त्र ए̍धि̱ मयो̱ मह्य̍ं प्रतिग्रही̱त्रे य̱माय̍ त्वा̱ मह्य̱ं वरु̍णो ददातु̱ सोऽमृ̍त̱त्वम̍श्यात् वयो̍ दा̱त्र ए̍धि̱ मयो̱ मह्य̍ं प्रतिग्रही̱त्रे
93.m: Be life for the giver, joy for me, the receiver. / Let Varuṇa give you to Rudra for me; may he attain immortality! Be in-breath for the giver, joy for me, the receiver. / Let Varuṇa give you to Bṛhaspati for me; may he attain immortality! Be skin for the giver, joy for me, the receiver. / Let Varuṇa give you to Yama for me; may he attain immortality! / Be full life-span for the giver, joy for me, the receiver.

93.s: kau'dā̱tkasmā̍ adā̱tkāmo̍'dā̱tkāmā̍yādāt kāmo̍ dā̱tā kāma̍ḥ pratigrahī̱tā kāmai̱tatte̱ tatra̍ kāma sutā bhūṃnajāmahai
93.d: कौऽदा̱त्कस्मा̍ अदा̱त्कामो̍ऽदा̱त्कामा̍यादात् कामो̍ दा̱ता काम̍ः प्रतिग्रही̱ता कामै̱तत्ते̱ तत्र̍ काम सुता भूंनजामहै
93.m: Who gave? To whom did he give? Desire gave; to Desire he gave. / Desire is the giver; Desire is the receiver. O Desire, this is yours; there, O Desire, may we prosper with the pressed [soma].

94.s: (2) sami̍ndra ṇo̱ mana̍sā neṣi̱ gobhi̱ḥ sam̐ sū̱ribhi̍rmagha̱vantsam̐ sva̱styā saṃ brahma̍ṇā de̱vakṛ̍ta̱ṃ yadasti̱ saṃ de̱vānā̱ṃm̐ suma̍tau ya̱jñiyā̍nām
94.d: (2) समि̍न्द्र णो̱ मन̍सा नेषि̱ गोभि̱ः सम्̐ सू̱रिभि̍र्मघ̱वन्त्सम्̐ स्व̱स्त्या सं ब्रह्म̍णा दे̱वकृ̍त̱ं यदस्ति̱ सं दे̱वाना̱ंम्̐ सुम̍तौ य̱ज्ञिया̍नाम्
94.m: O Indra, bring us together with mind, with cows; bring [us] together with patrons, O bounteous one, together with well-being; / together with the sacred formulation which is made by the gods, together in the goodwill of the gods worthy of sacrifice.

94.s: saṃ varca̍sā̱ paya̍sā̱ saṃ ta̱nūbhi̱raga̍nmahi̱ mana̍sā̱ sam̐ śi̱vena̍ tvaṣṭā̍ su̱datro̱ vida̍dhātu̱ rāyo'nu̍māṣṭuṃ ta̱nvo̱ yadvili̍ṣṭam
94.d: सं वर्च̍सा̱ पय̍सा̱ सं त̱नूभि̱रग̍न्महि̱ मन̍सा̱ सम्̐ शि̱वेन̍ त्वष्टा̍ सु̱दत्रो̱ विद̍धातु̱ रायोऽनु̍माष्टुं त̱न्वो̱ यद्विलि̍ष्टम्
94.m: We have united with splendor, with milk, with bodies, with auspicious mind. / May Tvaṣṭṛ, the bountiful, bestow riches; may he smooth over whatever in our body is torn.

94.s: dhā̱tā rā̱tiḥ sa̍vi̱tedaṃ ju̍ṣantāṃ pra̱jāpa̍tirnidhi̱pā de̱vo a̱gniḥ tvaṣṭā̱ viṣṇu̍ḥ pra̱jayā̍ sam̐rarā̱ṇo yaja̍mānāya̱ dravi̍ṇaṃ dadhātu
94.d: धा̱ता रा̱तिः स̍वि̱तेदं जु̍षन्तां प्र̱जाप̍तिर्निधि̱पा दे̱वो अ̱ग्निः त्वष्टा̱ विष्णु̍ः प्र̱जया̍ सम्̐ररा̱णो यज̍मानाय̱ द्रवि̍णं दधातु
94.m: May Dhātṛ, generosity, and Savitṛ enjoy this, and Prajāpati, the keeper of treasures, the god Agni; / may Tvaṣṭṛ and Viṣṇu, rejoicing together with offspring, bestow wealth upon the sacrificer.

94.s: su̱gā vo̍ de̱vāḥ sada̍nā akarma̱ ya ā̍ja̱gmedam̐ sava̍naṃ juṣā̱ṇāḥ bhara̍māṇā̱ vaha̍mānā ha̱vīm̐ṣya̱sme dha̍tta vasavo̱ vasū̍ni
94.d: सु̱गा वो̍ दे̱वाः सद̍ना अकर्म̱ य आ̍ज̱ग्मेदम्̐ सव̍नं जुषा̱णाः भर̍माणा̱ वह̍माना ह̱वीम्̐ष्य̱स्मे ध̍त्त वसवो̱ वसू̍नि
94.m: We have made your places easy to traverse, O gods, you who came delighting in this pressing; / carrying, conveying the oblations, O Vasus, bestow goods upon us.

94.s: yām̐3 ārva̍ha uśa̱to de̍va de̱vām̐stānprera̍ya̱ sve a̍gne sa̱dhasthe̍ ja̱kṣivām̐sa̍ḥ papivām̐sa̍śca̱ viśve'su̍ṃ gha̱rmam̐ svarāti̍ṣṭha̱tānu̍
94.d: याम्̐3 आर्व̍ह उश̱तो दे̍व दे̱वाम्̐स्तान्प्रेर̍य̱ स्वे अ̍ग्ने स̱धस्थे̍ ज̱क्षिवाम्̐स̍ः पपिवाम्̐स̍श्च̱ विश्वेऽसु̍ं घ̱र्मम्̐ स्वराति̍ष्ठ̱तानु̍
94.m: Those desiring gods whom you brought here, O divine Agni, urge them forth to their own abode; / having eaten, having drunk, all of you, take your stand upon life, upon the hot offering, upon heaven!

94.s: va̱yam̐ hi tvā̍ pra̱yati̍ ya̱jñe a̱sminnagne̱ hotā̍ra̱mavṛ̍ṇīmahī̱ha ṛ̱dhagayā̍ ṛdha̱gutāśa̍miṣṭhāḥ prajā̱nan‌ya̱jñamupa̍yāhi vi̱dvān
94.d: व̱यम्̐ हि त्वा̍ प्र̱यति̍ य̱ज्ञे अ̱स्मिन्नग्ने̱ होता̍र̱मवृ̍णीमही̱ह ऋ̱धगया̍ ऋध̱गुताश̍मिष्ठाः प्रजा̱नन्‌य̱ज्ञमुप̍याहि वि̱द्वान्
94.m: For at the beginning of this sacrifice, O Agni, we chose you as Hotṛ here; / prosperously, prosperously you have sacrificed and pacified [the gods]; knowing, understanding, approach the sacrifice.

94.s: de̱vā̍ gātuvido gā̱tumi̱tvā gā̱tumi̍ta | mana̍saspata i̱maṃ de̍va ya̱jñam̐ svāhā̱ vāte̍ dhāḥ
94.d: दे̱वा̍ गातुविदो गा̱तुमि̱त्वा गा̱तुमि̍त । मन̍सस्पत इ̱मं दे̍व य̱ज्ञम्̐ स्वाहा̱ वाते̍ धाः
94.m: O gods who find the way, having found the way, go on your way! / O Lord of Mind, place this sacrifice in the wind, svāhā!

94.s: ya̱jñaṃ ya̱jñaṃ ga̍ccha ya̱jñapa̍tiṃ gaccha̱ svāṃ yoni̍ṃ gaccha̱ svāhā̍ e̱ṣa te̍ ya̱jño ya̍jñapate sa̱hasū̍ktavā̱kaḥ sarva̍vīra̱staṃ ju̍ṣasva̱ svāhā̍
94.d: य̱ज्ञं य̱ज्ञं ग̍च्छ य̱ज्ञप̍तिं गच्छ̱ स्वां योनि̍ं गच्छ̱ स्वाहा̍ ए̱ष ते̍ य̱ज्ञो य̍ज्ञपते स̱हसू̍क्तवा̱कः सर्व̍वीर̱स्तं जु̍षस्व̱ स्वाहा̍
94.m: O sacrifice, go to the sacrifice; go to the lord of sacrifice; go to your own womb, svāhā! / This is your sacrifice, O lord of sacrifice, with the hymn of praise, accompanied by all heroic sons: delight in it, svāhā!

95.s: (3) māhi̍rbhū̱rmā pṛdā̍kuḥ | u̱rum̐ hi rājā̱ varu̍ṇaśca̱kāra̱ sūryā̍ya̱ panthā̱manve̍ta̱vā u̍ a̱pade̱ pādā̱ prati̍dhātave'karu̱tāpa̍vṛkta̱ hṛda̍yāvi̱dhaści̍t namo̱ varu̍ṇāyā̱bhiṣṭa̍to̱ varu̍ṇasya̱ pāśa̍ḥ
95.d: (3) माहि̍र्भू̱र्मा पृदा̍कुः । उ̱रुम्̐ हि राजा̱ वरु̍णश्च̱कार̱ सूर्या̍य̱ पन्था̱मन्वे̍त̱वा उ̍ अ̱पदे̱ पादा̱ प्रति̍धातवेऽकरु̱ताप̍वृक्त̱ हृद̍यावि̱धश्चि̍त् नमो̱ वरु̍णाया̱भिष्ट̍तो̱ वरु̍णस्य̱ पाश̍ः
95.m: Be not a snake, be not a viper. / King Varuṇa has made a wide path for the sun to follow, / to set his feet where there is no footing, and he dispels whatever pierces the heart. / Homage to Varuṇa! Trodden down is Varuṇa's noose.

95.s: a̱gneranī̍kama̱pa āvi̍veśā̱pāṃ napā̍t pratirakṣa̍nnasu̍ryam dame̍dame sa̱midha̍ṃ yakṣyagne̱ prati̍ te ji̱hvā ghṛ̱tamucca̍raṇyat svāhā̍
95.d: अ̱ग्नेरनी̍कम̱प आवि̍वेशा̱पां नपा̍त् प्रतिरक्ष̍न्नसु̍र्यम् दमे̍दमे स̱मिध̍ं यक्ष्यग्ने̱ प्रति̍ ते जि̱ह्वा घृ̱तमुच्च̍रण्यत् स्वाहा̍
95.m: The face of Agni has entered the waters, Apāṃ Napāt guarding the asura-power. / In house after house you will sacrifice to the kindling stick, O Agni; let your tongue reach up to the ghee! Svāhā!

95.s: sa̱mu̱dre te̱ hṛda̍yama̱psva̱ntaḥ saṃ tvā̍ viśantvoṣa̍dhīru̱tāpa̍ḥ ya̱jñasya̍ tvā ya̱jñapa̍te sū̱ktoktau̱ namo̍vā̱ke vi̍dhema̱ yat svāhā̍
95.d: स̱मु̱द्रे ते̱ हृद̍यम̱प्स्व̱न्तः सं त्वा̍ विशन्त्वोष̍धीरु̱ताप̍ः य̱ज्ञस्य̍ त्वा य̱ज्ञप̍ते सू̱क्तोक्तौ̱ नमो̍वा̱के वि̍धेम̱ यत् स्वाहा̍
95.m: Your heart is in the ocean, within the waters; let the plants and waters enter into you. / At the recitation of the hymn, at the utterance of homage, let us serve you, O lord of sacrifice, when it is the sacrifice! Svāhā!

95.s: de̱vīrāpa e̱ṣa vo̱ garbha̱stam̐ suprī̱tam̐ subhṛ̍taṃ bibhṛta de̱va̍ somai̱ṣa te̍ lo̱kaḥ pari̍ ca vakṣi̱ śaṃ ca̍ vakṣi | ava̍bhṛtha nicumpuṇa nice̱rura̍si nicumpuṇa ava̍ de̱vairde̱vakṛ̍ta̱meno̍'yāsiṣa̱mava̱ martyairmartya̍kṛtaṃ pururāvṇo̍ deva riṣaspā̍hi de̱vānā̱ṃm̐ sami̍dasi
95.d: दे̱वीराप ए̱ष वो̱ गर्भ̱स्तम्̐ सुप्री̱तम्̐ सुभृ̍तं बिभृत दे̱व̍ सोमै̱ष ते̍ लो̱कः परि̍ च वक्षि̱ शं च̍ वक्षि । अव̍भृथ निचुम्पुण निचे̱रुर̍सि निचुम्पुण अव̍ दे̱वैर्दे̱वकृ̍त̱मेनो̍ऽयासिष̱मव̱ मर्त्यैर्मर्त्य̍कृतं पुरुराव्णो̍ देव रिषस्पा̍हि दे̱वाना̱ंम्̐ समि̍दसि
95.m: O divine waters, this is your child; bear him well-pleased, well-carried. / O divine Soma, this is your place: carry around, and carry bliss! / O Nicumpuṇa of the purificatory bath, who glides downward, you are Nicumpuṇa! / Through the gods I have cleared away the sin committed against the gods; through mortals, that committed against mortals. O god, protect me from the harm of the loud-howling foe! / You are the kindling stick of the gods.

96.s: (4) eja̍tu̱ daśa̍māsyo̱ garbho̍ ja̱rāyu̍ṇā sa̱ha yathā̱yaṃ vā̱yurerja̍ti̱ yathā̍ samu̱dra eja̍tye̱vāyaṃ daśa̍māsyo asra̍jja̱rāyu̍ṇā sa̱ha
96.d: (4) एज̍तु̱ दश̍मास्यो̱ गर्भो̍ ज̱रायु̍णा स̱ह यथा̱यं वा̱युरेर्ज̍ति̱ यथा̍ समु̱द्र एज̍त्ये̱वायं दश̍मास्यो अस्र̍ज्ज̱रायु̍णा स̱ह
96.m: Let the ten-month child stir along with the afterbirth! / Just as this wind stirs, just as the ocean stirs, even so let this ten-month child come forth along with the afterbirth!

96.s: yasyā̍ste ya̱jñiyo̱ garbho̱ yasyā̱ yoni̍rhira̱ṇyayī̍ aṅgā̍nyahru̍tā yasyā̱ taṃ mā̱trā sama̍jīgama̱m̐ svāhā̍
96.d: यस्या̍स्ते य̱ज्ञियो̱ गर्भो̱ यस्या̱ योनि̍र्हिर̱ण्ययी̍ अङ्गा̍न्यह्रु̍ता यस्या̱ तं मा̱त्रा सम̍जीगम̱म्̐ स्वाहा̍
96.m: You whose child is worthy of sacrifice, whose womb is golden, / whose limbs are unbroken, him have I united with his mother! Svāhā!

96.s: pu̱ru̱dasmo̱ viṣu̍rūpa̱ indu̍ra̱ntarma̍hi̱māna̍mānañja̱ dhīra̍ḥ eka̍padīṃ dvi̱padī̍ṃ tri̱padī̱ṃ catu̍ṣpadīma̱ṣṭāpa̍dī̱ṃ bhuva̍nānu̍ prathantā̱m̐ svāhā̍
96.d: पु̱रु̱दस्मो̱ विषु̍रूप̱ इन्दु̍र̱न्तर्म̍हि̱मान̍मानञ्ज̱ धीर̍ः एक̍पदीं द्वि̱पदी̍ं त्रि̱पदी̱ं चतु̍ष्पदीम̱ष्टाप̍दी̱ं भुव̍नानु̍ प्रथन्ता̱म्̐ स्वाहा̍
96.m: The wise drop of many wonders, multiform, has internally anointed the greatness. / Let the one-footed, two-footed, three-footed, four-footed, eight-footed [verses] extend throughout the worlds! Svāhā!

96.s: maru̍to̱ yasya̱ hi kṣaye̍ pā̱thā di̱vo vi̍mahasaḥ | sa su̍gopā̱tamo̱ jana̍ḥ
96.d: मरु̍तो̱ यस्य̱ हि क्षये̍ पा̱था दि̱वो वि̍महसः । स सु̍गोपा̱तमो̱ जन̍ः
96.m: For in whose house you, O Maruts of great might, drink from heaven, / that man is best protected.

96.s: ma̱hī dyauḥ pṛ̍thi̱vī ca̍ na i̱maṃ ya̱jñaṃ mi̍mikṣatām | pi̱pṛ̱tāṃ no̱ bharī̍mabhiḥ
96.d: म̱ही द्यौः पृ̍थि̱वी च̍ न इ̱मं य̱ज्ञं मि̍मिक्षताम् । पि̱पृ̱तां नो̱ भरी̍मभिः
96.m: May great Heaven and Earth sprinkle this sacrifice of ours; / may they fill us with sustainers.

97.s: (5) āji̍ghra ka̱laśa̍ṃ ma̱hyā tvā̍ viśantvinda̍vaḥ puna̍rū̱rjā nivarta̍sva̱ sā na̍ḥ sa̱hasra̍ṃ dhukṣvoru̱dhārā̱ paya̍svatī̱ puna̱rmāvi̍śatādra̱yiḥ
97.d: (5) आजि̍घ्र क̱लश̍ं म̱ह्या त्वा̍ विशन्त्विन्द̍वः पुन̍रू̱र्जा निवर्त̍स्व̱ सा न̍ः स̱हस्र̍ं धुक्ष्वोरु̱धारा̱ पय̍स्वती̱ पुन̱र्मावि̍शताद्र̱यिः
97.m: Inhale the jar! May the generous drops enter you! / Return again with food-sap; yield us a thousandfold, wide-flowing, full of milk. Let wealth enter me again!

97.s: i̱ḍye̱ kāmye̱ ile̱ rante̱ candre̱ jyote'di̍te̱ sara̍svati̱ mahi̱ viśru̍ti e̱tā te̍ aghnye̱ nāmā̍ni de̱veṣu̍ mā sukṛ̱taṃ brū̍tāt
97.d: इ̱ड्ये̱ काम्ये̱ इले̱ रन्ते̱ चन्द्रे̱ ज्योतेऽदि̍ते̱ सर̍स्वति̱ महि̱ विश्रु̍ति ए̱ता ते̍ अघ्न्ये̱ नामा̍नि दे̱वेषु̍ मा सुकृ̱तं ब्रू̍तात्
97.m: O offering, O desirable one, O Iḍā, O joyful one, O radiant one, O light, O Aditi, O Sarasvatī, O great one, O widely renowned! / These, O inviolable one, are your names; announce me among the gods as a doer of good deeds!

97.s: i̱ha rati̍ri̱ha rama̍dhvami̱ha dhṛti̍ri̱ha svadhṛti̍ḥ svāhā̍ u̱pasṛ̱jaṃ dha̱ruṇa̍ṃ mā̱tre dha̱ruṇau̍ mā̱tara̍ṃ dhaya̍ntrā̱yaspoṣa̍ma̱smāsu̍ dīdharat svāhā̍
97.d: इ̱ह रति̍रि̱ह रम̍ध्वमि̱ह धृति̍रि̱ह स्वधृति̍ः स्वाहा̍ उ̱पसृ̱जं ध̱रुण̍ं मा̱त्रे ध̱रुणौ̍ मा̱तर̍ं धय̍न्त्रा̱यस्पोष̍म̱स्मासु̍ दीधरत् स्वाहा̍
97.m: Here is pleasure, take pleasure here; here is steadfastness, here is self-steadfastness! Svāhā! / I release the supporter to the mother; may the supporter, sucking the mother, establish abundance of wealth in us! Svāhā!

97.s: aga̍nma̱ jyoti̍ra̱mṛtā̍ abhūma̱ diva̍ṃ pṛthi̱vyā adhyāru̍hāma avi̍dāma de̱vāntsva̱rjyoti̍ḥ
97.d: अग̍न्म̱ ज्योति̍र̱मृता̍ अभूम̱ दिव̍ं पृथि̱व्या अध्यारु̍हाम अवि̍दाम दे̱वान्त्स्व̱र्ज्योति̍ः
97.m: We have gone to the light, we have become immortal; we have mounted heaven from earth; / we have found the gods, the light of heaven.

97.s: yu̱vaṃ tāmi̍ndrāparvatā puro̱yudhā̱ yo na̍ḥ pṛta̱nyādapa̱ taṃta̍middha̱taṃ vajre̍ṇa̱ taṃta̍middha̱tam dū̱re ca̱ttāya̍ chanta̱sadgaha̍na̱ṃ yadina̍kṣadu̱smāka̱m̐ śatrūn pari̍ śūra vi̱śvato̍ da̱rmā da̍rṣāṣṭa vi̱śvata̍ḥ
97.d: यु̱वं तामि̍न्द्रापर्वता पुरो̱युधा̱ यो न̍ः पृत̱न्यादप̱ तंत̍मिद्ध̱तं वज्रे̍ण̱ तंत̍मिद्ध̱तम् दू̱रे च̱त्ताय̍ छन्त̱सद्गह̍न̱ं यदिन̍क्षदु̱स्माक̱म्̐ शत्रून् परि̍ शूर वि̱श्वतो̍ द̱र्मा द̍र्षाष्ट वि̱श्वत̍ः
97.m: O Indra and Parvata, who fight in the vanguard, whoever fights us, strike him down, strike him down with the thunderbolt! / May a dense concealment cover him when he is driven far away! When he reaches our enemies, O hero, shatterer, may he shatter them all around!

97.s: bhūrbhuva̱ḥ sva̍ḥ supra̱jāḥ pra̱jayā̍ bhūyāsam | su̱vīro̍ vī̱raiḥ su̱poṣa̱ḥ poṣai̍ḥ
97.d: भूर्भुव̱ः स्व̍ः सुप्र̱जाः प्र̱जया̍ भूयासम् । सु̱वीरो̍ वी̱रैः सु̱पोष̱ः पोषै̍ः
97.m: Bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ! May I be rich in offspring through offspring, rich in heroes through heroes, rich in nourishment through nourishments!

98.s: pa̱ra̱me̱ṣṭhya̍bhidhī̍taḥ pra̱jāpa̍ti̱rvāci vyāhṛ̍tāyāma̱ndho acchai̍taḥ savi̱tā su̱nyām vi̱śvaka̍rmā dī̱kṣāyā̍ṃ pū̱ṣā sau̍ma̱kraya̍ṇyām
98.d: प̱र̱मे̱ष्ठ्य̍भिधी̍तः प्र̱जाप̍ति̱र्वाचि व्याहृ̍तायाम̱न्धो अच्छै̍तः सवि̱ता सु̱न्याम् वि̱श्वक̍र्मा दी̱क्षाया̍ं पू̱षा सौ̍म̱क्रय̍ण्याम्
98.m: As Parameṣṭhin he is meditated upon; as Prajāpati when speech is uttered; as the blind he goes toward [it]; as Savitṛ at the gift; / as Viśvakarman at the consecration; as Pūṣan when the Soma-cow is present;

98.s: indra̍śca ma̱ruta̍śca kra̱yāyopotthi̍taḥ | asu̍raḥ pū̱yamā̍no mi̱traḥ krī̱taḥ
98.d: इन्द्र̍श्च म̱रुत̍श्च क्र̱यायोपोत्थि̍तः । असु̍रः पू̱यमा̍नो मि̱त्रः क्री̱तः
98.m: as Indra and the Maruts when he rises up for purchase; as an Asura when he is bargained for; as Mitra when bought;

98.s: viṣṇu̍ḥ śi̱pivi̱ṣṭa ū̱rā āsa̍n no vi̱ṣṇurna̍randhi̱ṣaḥ prohyamā̍ṇaḥ soma̱ āga̍to varu̍ṇa āsa̱ndyāmāsa̍nnaḥ
98.d: विष्णु̍ः शि̱पिवि̱ष्ट ऊ̱रा आस̍न् नो वि̱ष्णुर्न̍रन्धि̱षः प्रोह्यमा̍णः सोम̱ आग̍तो वरु̍ण आस̱न्द्यामास̍न्नः
98.m: as Viṣṇu Śipiviṣṭa when seated on the thigh; as Viṣṇu Narandhiṣa when carried forward; / as Soma when arrived; as Varuṇa when seated on the throne;

98.s: a̱gnirāgnī̍dhra̱ indro̍ havi̱rdhāne̍ | atha̍rvā̱pāva̍hriyamā̍ṇo viśve̍ de̱vā a̱m̐śuṣu̍ nyu̱pyamā̍neṣu
98.d: अ̱ग्निराग्नी̍ध्र̱ इन्द्रो̍ हवि̱र्धाने̍ । अथ̍र्वा̱पाव̍ह्रियमा̍णो विश्वे̍ दे̱वा अ̱म्̐शुषु̍ न्यु̱प्यमा̍नेषु
98.m: as Agni at the fire-place; as Indra in the havirdhāna shed; / as Atharvan when brought down; as the Viśve Devāḥ when the shoots are strewn;

98.s: vi̱ṣṇu̍rāprī̱tapā ā̍pyā̱yyamā̍no ya̱maḥ sūyamā̍no vi̱ṣṇu̍ḥ sa̱ṃbhriyamā̍ṇaḥ | vā̱yuḥ pū̱yamā̍naḥ śu̱kraḥ pū̱taḥ5
98.d: वि̱ष्णु̍राप्री̱तपा आ̍प्या̱य्यमा̍नो य̱मः सूयमा̍नो वि̱ष्णु̍ः स̱ंभ्रियमा̍णः । वा̱युः पू̱यमा̍नः शु̱क्रः पू̱तः5
98.m: as Viṣṇu Āprītapā when swelled; as Yama when pressed; as Viṣṇu when gathered together; / as Vāyu when being purified; as the pure [Śukra] when purified;
as Śukra when mixed with milk; as Manthin when mixed with barley meal; / as the Viśve Devāḥ when drawn up in the cups; as an Asura when raised for the offering;

98.s: ru̱dro hūyamā̍no vāto̍'bhyāvṛ̍tto nṛ̱cakṣā̍ḥ prati̍khyāto bha̱kṣaḥ pī̱taḥ pi̱tarau̍ nārāśa̱m̐sāḥ sādyamā̍naḥ sindhu̍ravabhṛ̱thāyodya̍taḥ samu̱dro̍'bhyava̍hriyamā̍ṇaḥ sali̱laḥ praplu̍taḥ
98.d: रु̱द्रो हूयमा̍नो वातो̍ऽभ्यावृ̍त्तो नृ̱चक्षा̍ः प्रति̍ख्यातो भ̱क्षः पी̱तः पि̱तरौ̍ नाराश̱म्̐साः साद्यमा̍नः सिन्धु̍रवभृ̱थायोद्य̍तः समु̱द्रो̍ऽभ्यव̍ह्रियमा̍णः सलि̱लः प्रप्लु̍तः
98.m: as Rudra when offered; as Vāta when turned toward; as the watcher of men when beheld; as the drink when consumed; as the ancestral Nārāśaṃsa [cups] when set down; / as the Indus when raised for the purificatory bath; as the ocean when taken down; as the surge when plunging into [the water].

98.s: yayo̱roja̍sā skabhi̱tā rajā̍ṃm̐si vī̱ryai̍bhirvī̱rata̍mā śavi̍ṣṭhā yā patyai̍te apra̍tī̱tā saho̍bhi̱rviṣṇū̍ aganvaru̍ṇā pūrva̱hūtau̍
98.d: ययो̱रोज̍सा स्कभि̱ता रजा̍ंम्̐सि वी̱र्यै̍भिर्वी̱रत̍मा शवि̍ष्ठा या पत्यै̍ते अप्र̍ती̱ता सहो̍भि̱र्विष्णू̍ अगन्वरु̍णा पूर्व̱हूतौ̍
98.m: By whose might the earthly spaces were propped apart, the most heroic of heroes, the strongest, / who rule unopposed through their powers: may Viṣṇu and Varuṇa come at the early invocation!

98.s: de̱vān diva̍magan ya̱jñastato̍ mā̱ dravi̍ṇamaṣṭu manu̱ṣyā̍na̱ntari̍kṣamagan ya̱jñastato̍ mā̱ dravi̍ṇamaṣṭu pi̱tṝn pṛ̍thi̱vīma̍gan ya̱jñaḥ tato̍ mā̱ dravi̍ṇamaṣṭu yaṃ kaṃ ca̍ lo̱kama̍gan ya̱jñastato̍ me bha̱drama̍bhūt
98.d: दे̱वान् दिव̍मगन् य̱ज्ञस्ततो̍ मा̱ द्रवि̍णमष्टु मनु̱ष्या̍न̱न्तरि̍क्षमगन् य̱ज्ञस्ततो̍ मा̱ द्रवि̍णमष्टु पि̱तॄन् पृ̍थि̱वीम̍गन् य̱ज्ञः ततो̍ मा̱ द्रवि̍णमष्टु यं कं च̍ लो̱कम̍गन् य̱ज्ञस्ततो̍ मे भ̱द्रम̍भूत्
98.m: The sacrifice has gone to the gods in heaven; from there may wealth come to me. The sacrifice has gone to mortals in the mid-air; from there may wealth come to me. / The sacrifice has gone to the fathers on earth; from there may wealth come to me. To whatever world the sacrifice has gone, from there has good fortune come to me.

98.s:
prāṇāya me pañca
udu tyaṃ na ṣa
samindra ṇo'ṣṭa
māhiṣmatarūḥ
ejatu daśamāsyaḥ pañca
ājighra ṣaṭ
parameṣṭhī nava
saptānuvākeṣu ṣaṭcatvāriṃśat
prāṇā nājaraha iti śuklayajuḥkāṇvasaṃhitāyāṃ navamo'dhyāyaḥ
yajvā ṣaṭcatvā
98.d:
प्राणाय मे पञ्च
उदु त्यं न ष
समिन्द्र णोऽष्ट
माहिष्मतरूः
एजतु दशमास्यः पञ्च
आजिघ्र षट्
परमेष्ठी नव
सप्तानुवाकेषु षट्चत्वारिंशत्
प्राणा नाजरह इति शुक्लयजुःकाण्वसंहितायां नवमोऽध्यायः
यज्वा षट्चत्वा
98.m: [The anuvāka starting with] prāṇāya me has five [verses]. udu tyaṃ has nine. samidro naḥ has eight. māhiḥ has four. ejatu daśamāsyaḥ has five. / ājighra has six. parameṣṭhī has nine. In the seven anuvākas there are forty-six [verses]. / Thus ends the ninth adhyāya in the Śukla Yajurveda Kāṇva Saṃhitā.

99.s: de̱vaṃ savi̱tuḥ prasu̍va ya̱jñaṃ prasu̍ve̱maṃ bhagā̍ya di̱vyo ga̍ndha̱rvaḥ ke̍ta̱pāḥ keta̍ naḥ punātu vā̱caspata̍irno a̱dya vāja̍m̐ svadatu
99.d: दे̱वं सवि̱तुः प्रसु̍व य̱ज्ञं प्रसु̍वे̱मं भगा̍य दि̱व्यो ग̍न्ध̱र्वः के̍त̱पाः केत̍ नः पुनातु वा̱चस्पत̍इर्नो अ̱द्य वाज̍म्̐ स्वदतु
99.m: Impel the divine sacrifice, O Savitṛ; impel this for fortune! / May the heavenly Gandharva, guardian of intention, purify our intention; may the lord of speech sweeten our vital vigor today!

99.s: dhru̱vasa̱da̍ṃ tvā nṛ̱ṣada̍ṃ mana̱ḥsada̍m u̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'sīndrā̍ya tvā juṣṭa̍ṃ gṛhṇāmye̱ṣa te̱ yoni̱rindrā̍ya tvā juṣṭa̍tamam
99.d: ध्रु̱वस̱द̍ं त्वा नृ̱षद̍ं मन̱ःसद̍म् उ̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽसीन्द्रा̍य त्वा जुष्ट̍ं गृह्णाम्ये̱ष ते̱ योनि̱रिन्द्रा̍य त्वा जुष्ट̍तमम्
99.m: You who sit firmly, who sit among men, who sit in the mind! / You are taken with a holder. I take you pleasing to Indra. This is your cradle; for Indra, most welcome to you!

99.s: a̱psu̱ṣada̍ tvā ghṛ̱ta̱sada̍ṃ vyoma̱sada̍m u̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'sīndrā̍ya tvā̱ juṣṭa̍ṃ gṛhṇāmye̱ṣa te̱ yoni̱rindrā̍ya tvā̱ juṣṭa̍tamam pṛ̱thi̱vi̱sada̍ tvā'ntarikṣa̱sada̍ṃ di̱vi̱sada̍ṃ de̱va̱sada̱ṃ nāka̱sada̍m u̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'sīndrā̍ya tvā̱ juṣṭa̍ṃ gṛhṇāmye̱ṣa te̱ yoni̱rindrā̍ya tvā̱ juṣṭa̍tamam
99.d: अ̱प्सु̱षद̍ त्वा घृ̱त̱सद̍ं व्योम̱सद̍म् उ̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽसीन्द्रा̍य त्वा̱ जुष्ट̍ं गृह्णाम्ये̱ष ते̱ योनि̱रिन्द्रा̍य त्वा̱ जुष्ट̍तमम् पृ̱थि̱वि̱सद̍ त्वाऽन्तरिक्ष̱सद̍ं दि̱वि̱सद̍ं दे̱व̱सद̱ं नाक̱सद̍म् उ̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽसीन्द्रा̍य त्वा̱ जुष्ट̍ं गृह्णाम्ये̱ष ते̱ योनि̱रिन्द्रा̍य त्वा̱ जुष्ट̍तमम्
99.m: You who sit in the waters, who sit in ghee, who sit in the sky! / You are taken with a holder. I take you pleasing to Indra. This is your cradle; for Indra, most welcome to you! / You who sit on earth, who sit in the mid-air, who sit in heaven, who sit among gods, who sit on the firmament! / You are taken with a holder. I take you pleasing to Indra. This is your cradle; for Indra, most welcome to you!

99.s: a̱pām̐ rasa̱mudva̍yasa̱m̱̐ sūrye̱ santa̍m̐ samā̱hita̍m | a̱pām̐ rasa̍sya̱ yo rasa̱staṃ vo̍ gṛhṇāmyutta̱mam u̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'sīndrā̍ya tvā̱ juṣṭa̍ṃ gṛhṇāmye̱ṣa te̱ yoni̱rindrā̍ya tvā̱ juṣṭa̍tamam
99.d: अ̱पाम्̐ रस̱मुद्व̍यस̱म्̱̐ सूर्ये̱ सन्त̍म्̐ समा̱हित̍म् । अ̱पाम्̐ रस̍स्य̱ यो रस̱स्तं वो̍ गृह्णाम्युत्त̱मम् उ̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽसीन्द्रा̍य त्वा̱ जुष्ट̍ं गृह्णाम्ये̱ष ते̱ योनि̱रिन्द्रा̍य त्वा̱ जुष्ट̍तमम्
99.m: The sap of the waters, highest vigor, abiding in the sun, gathered together— / the sap of the sap of the waters, that highest one of yours I take! / You are taken with a holder. I take you pleasing to Indra. This is your cradle; for Indra, most welcome to you!

99.s: grahā̍ ūrṇāhutayo̱ vyanto̱ viprā̍ya ma̱tim | teṣā̍ṃ vi̱śipri̍yāṇāṃ vo'hama̱iṣa̱mūrja̱m̱̐ sama̍grabham u̱payā̱magṛ̍hīto'sīndrā̍ya tvā̱ juṣṭa̍ṃ gṛhṇāmye̱ṣa te̱ yoni̱rindrā̍ya tvā̱ juṣṭa̍tamam
99.d: ग्रहा̍ ऊर्णाहुतयो̱ व्यन्तो̱ विप्रा̍य म̱तिम् । तेषा̍ं वि̱शिप्रि̍याणां वोऽहम̱इष̱मूर्ज̱म्̱̐ सम̍ग्रभम् उ̱पया̱मगृ̍हीतोऽसीन्द्रा̍य त्वा̱ जुष्ट̍ं गृह्णाम्ये̱ष ते̱ योनि̱रिन्द्रा̍य त्वा̱ जुष्ट̍तमम्
99.m:
You cups are offerings of refreshing nourishment, pursuing insight for the inspired seer. / From these, your well-formed vessels, I have gathered food and nourishment.
You are drawn with a base-cup. I take you pleasing to Indra. This is your womb. For Indra, most pleasing to you.

99.s:
sa̱ṃpṛca̍ stha̱ saṃ mā̍ bha̱dreṇa̍ pṛṅkta | vi̱pṛca̍ stha̱ vi mā̍ pā̱pena̍ pṛṅkta
(1)
99.d:
स̱ंपृच̍ स्थ̱ सं मा̍ भ̱द्रेण̍ पृङ्क्त । वि̱पृच̍ स्थ̱ वि मा̍ पा̱पेन̍ पृङ्क्त
(1)
99.m: You are uniting: unite me with what is auspicious! / You are separating: separate me from evil!

100.s: indra̍sya̱ vajro̍'si vā̱jasāstvayā̱ yaṃ vāja̍m̐ set vāja̍sya̱ nu pra̍sa̱ve mā̱tara̍ṃ ma̱hīmadi̍ti̱ṃ nāma̱ vaca̍sā karāmahe yasyā̍mi̱daṃ viśva̱ṃ bhuva̍namāvi̱veśa̱ tasyā̍ṃ no de̱vaḥ sa̍vi̱tā dharma̍ sāviṣat
100.d: इन्द्र̍स्य̱ वज्रो̍ऽसि वा̱जसास्त्वया̱ यं वाज̍म्̐ सेत् वाज̍स्य̱ नु प्र̍स̱वे मा̱तर̍ं म̱हीमदि̍ति̱ं नाम̱ वच̍सा करामहे यस्या̍मि̱दं विश्व̱ं भुव̍नमावि̱वेश̱ तस्या̍ं नो दे̱वः स̍वि̱ता धर्म̍ साविषत्
100.m:
You are Indra's thunderbolt, winning vital vigor. Through you, may he win vital vigor!
In the impulse of vital vigor, we now invoke with speech / the great mother, named Aditi, / into whom this whole world has entered. In her may god Savitṛ impel cosmic order for us.

100.s: de̱vīrāpo apāṃnapādyo va̍ ū̱rmiḥ pra̍tūrttiḥ | ka̱kunmā̍n vā̱jasāstenā̱yaṃ vāja̍m̐ set
100.d: दे̱वीरापो अपांनपाद्यो व̍ ऊ̱र्मिः प्र̍तूर्त्तिः । क̱कुन्मा̍न् वा̱जसास्तेना̱यं वाज̍म्̐ सेत्
100.m: Divine waters, child of waters, whichever wave of yours is forward-rushing, / crested, winning vital vigor—through that may this one win vital vigor!

100.s: a̱psvanta̱ramṛ̍ta̱ma̱psu bhe̍ṣa̱jama̱pāmu̱ta praśa̍stibhiḥ | aśvā̍ bhava̍ta vā̱jina̍ḥ
100.d: अ̱प्स्वन्त̱रमृ̍त̱म̱प्सु भे̍ष̱जम̱पामु̱त प्रश̍स्तिभिः । अश्वा̍ भव̍त वा̱जिन̍ः
100.m: Within the waters is immortality, within the waters is healing, / and by the praises of the waters, become, O horses, steeds of vital vigor!

100.s: vāto̍ vā̱ vo mano̍ vā gandha̱rvāḥ sa̱ptavi̍m̐śatiḥ | te agre'śva̍mayuñja̱m̱̐ste a̍smiñja̱vamāda̍dhuḥ
100.d: वातो̍ वा̱ वो मनो̍ वा गन्ध̱र्वाः स̱प्तवि̍म्̐शतिः । ते अग्रेऽश्व̍मयुञ्ज̱म्̱̐स्ते अ̍स्मिञ्ज̱वमाद̍धुः
100.m: Either the wind or the mind [is] your [speed], or the twenty-seven Gandharvas. / They harnessed the horse in the beginning; they placed speed in him.

100.s: vāta̍ram̐hā bhava vājin yu̱jyamā̍na̱ indra̍syeva̱ dakṣi̍ṇaḥ śri̱yaidhi̍ yu̱ñjantu̍ tvā ma̱ruto̍ vi̱śvave̍dasa̱ ā te̱ tvaṣṭā̍ pa̱tsu ja̱vaṃ da̍dhātu
100.d: वात̍रम्̐हा भव वाजिन् यु̱ज्यमा̍न̱ इन्द्र̍स्येव̱ दक्षि̍णः श्रि̱यैधि̍ यु̱ञ्जन्तु̍ त्वा म̱रुतो̍ वि̱श्ववे̍दस̱ आ ते̱ त्वष्टा̍ प̱त्सु ज̱वं द̍धातु
100.m: Be swift as the wind, O steed, when harnessed; / thrive for glory like Indra’s right [hand]! / Let the Maruts, of all possessions, harness you; / let Tvaṣṭṛ place speed in your feet!

100.s: javo yaste̍ vājinnihi̍to̱ guhā̱ yaḥ śye̱ne parī̍tto a̱cara̍cca̱ vāte̍ tena̍ no vājin bala̍vān bale̍na vā̱jajiccai̍dhi̱ sama̍ne ca pārayi̱ṣṇuḥ
100.d: जवो यस्ते̍ वाजिन्निहि̍तो̱ गुहा̱ यः श्ये̱ने परी̍त्तो अ̱चर̍च्च̱ वाते̍ तेन̍ नो वाजिन् बल̍वान् बले̍न वा̱जजिच्चै̍धि̱ सम̍ने च पारयि̱ष्णुः
100.m: The speed that was hidden within you, O steed, / which went forth in the falcon and moved in the wind— / with that, O steed, being strong through strength, / become a winner of vital vigor and victorious in the contest!
O steeds, winners of vital vigor, about to run for vital vigor, / sniff at Bṛhaspati's share!

101.s: de̱vasya̍ va̱yam̐ sa̍vi̱tuḥ sa̱ve sa̱tyasa̍vasaḥ | bṛha̱spate̍rutta̱maṃ nāka̍m̐ ruhemendra̍syotta̱maṃ nāka̍m̐ ruhema de̱vasya̍ va̱yam̐ sa̍vi̱tuḥ sa̱ve sa̱tyasa̍vasaḥ| bṛha̱spate̍rutta̱maṃ nāka̍maruhāmendra̍syotta̱maṃ nāka̍maruhāma
101.d: दे̱वस्य̍ व̱यम्̐ स̍वि̱तुः स̱वे स̱त्यस̍वसः । बृह̱स्पते̍रुत्त̱मं नाक̍म्̐ रुहेमेन्द्र̍स्योत्त̱मं नाक̍म्̐ रुहेम दे̱वस्य̍ व̱यम्̐ स̍वि̱तुः स̱वे स̱त्यस̍वसः। बृह̱स्पते̍रुत्त̱मं नाक̍मरुहामेन्द्र̍स्योत्त̱मं नाक̍मरुहाम
101.m: In the impulse of god Savitṛ of true impulse, / may we climb Bṛhaspati's highest firmament, may we climb Indra's highest firmament! / In the impulse of god Savitṛ of true impulse, / we have climbed Bṛhaspati's highest firmament, we have climbed Indra's highest firmament!

101.s: bṛha̍spate̱ vāja̍ṃ jaya̱ bṛha̱spata̍ye̱ vāca̍ṃ vadata | bṛha̱spati̱ṃ vāja̍ṃ jāpayata
101.d: बृह̍स्पते̱ वाज̍ं जय̱ बृह̱स्पत̍ये̱ वाच̍ं वदत । बृह̱स्पति̱ं वाज̍ं जापयत
101.m: O Bṛhaspati, win vital vigor! Speak the word for Bṛhaspati! / Cause Bṛhaspati to win vital vigor!

101.s: indra̱ vāja̍ṃ jayendrā̍ya̱ vāca̍ṃ vadata | indra̱ṃ vāja̍ṃ jāpayata
101.d: इन्द्र̱ वाज̍ं जयेन्द्रा̍य̱ वाच̍ं वदत । इन्द्र̱ं वाज̍ं जापयत
101.m: O Indra, win vital vigor! Speak the word for Indra! / Cause Indra to win vital vigor!

101.s: e̱ṣā va̍ḥ sā sa̱tyā saṃvā̱gbhūdyayā̱ bṛha̱spati̱ṃ vāja̍majī̍japata ājī̍japata̱ bṛha̱spati̱ṃ vāca̍ṃ vana̍spatayo vimu̍cyadhvam
101.d: ए̱षा व̍ः सा स̱त्या संवा̱ग्भूद्यया̱ बृह̱स्पति̱ं वाज̍मजी̍जपत आजी̍जपत̱ बृह̱स्पति̱ं वाच̍ं वन̍स्पतयो विमु̍च्यध्वम्
101.m: This true shared speech of yours has come to pass, by which you caused Bṛhaspati to win vital vigor. / You have caused Bṛhaspati to win vital vigor! O trees, release your voice!

101.s: de̱vasya̍ va̱yam̐ sa̍vi̱tuḥ sa̱ve sa̱tyasa̍vasaḥ | bṛha̱spate̍rvā̱jaji̱to vāja̍ṃ jeṣma
101.d: दे̱वस्य̍ व̱यम्̐ स̍वि̱तुः स̱वे स̱त्यस̍वसः । बृह̱स्पते̍र्वा̱जजि̱तो वाज̍ं जेष्म
101.m: In the impulse of god Savitṛ of true impulse, / may we win the vital vigor of Bṛhaspati, winner of vital vigor!

101.s: vā̱jino̱ vāja̍ jaya̱tādhva̍na skabhanta̍ḥ | yoja̍nā̱ mimā̍nāḥ kāṣṭhāṃ gacchata
101.d: वा̱जिनो̱ वाज̍ जय̱ताध्व̍न स्कभन्त̍ः । योज̍ना̱ मिमा̍नाः काष्ठां गच्छत
101.m: O steeds, win vital vigor, establishing the paths! / Measuring the leagues, reach the goal!

101.s: e̱ṣa sya vā̱jī kṣipa̱ṇiṃ tu̍raṇyati grī̱vāyā̍ṃ ba̱ddho a̍pika̱kṣa ā̱sani̍ kratu̍ṃ dadhi̱krā anu̍ santavītvatpa̱thāmaṅkām̐syanvāpanī̍phaṇat
101.d: ए̱ष स्य वा̱जी क्षिप̱णिं तु̍रण्यति ग्री̱वाया̍ं ब̱द्धो अ̍पिक̱क्ष आ̱सनि̍ क्रतु̍ं दधि̱क्रा अनु̍ सन्तवीत्वत्प̱थामङ्काम्̐स्यन्वापनी̍फणत्
101.m: This steed here hastens under the whip, / bound at the neck, at the flank, at the mouth. / Dadhikrā, displaying his mental power, / gallops along the windings of the tracks.

101.s: u̱ta smā̍sya̱ drava̍tastura̱ṇyata̍ḥ pa̱rṇaṃ na ve̱ranu̍vāti pra̱ga̱rdhina̍ḥ śye̱nasye̍va̱ dhraja̍to a̱ṅkasa̱ṃ pari̍ dadhi̱krāvṇa̍ḥ sa̱horjā tari̍trataḥ
101.d: उ̱त स्मा̍स्य̱ द्रव̍तस्तुर̱ण्यत̍ः प̱र्णं न वे̱रनु̍वाति प्र̱ग̱र्धिन̍ः श्ये̱नस्ये̍व̱ ध्रज̍तो अ̱ङ्कस̱ं परि̍ दधि̱क्राव्ण̍ः स̱होर्जा तरि̍त्रतः
101.m: And the wing of the bird, as it were, blows behind him as he runs, rushing, eager; / like the curving flight of a swooping falcon, / of Dadhikrāvan traversing with power and vigor.

101.s: śaṃ no̍ bhavantu vā̱jino̱ have̍ṣu de̱vatā̍tā mi̱tadra̍vaḥ sva̱rkāḥ jambhayanto'hi̱ṃ vṛka̱m̐ rakṣā̍ṃm̐si̱ sane̍mya̱smadyu̍yavannamī̍vāḥ
101.d: शं नो̍ भवन्तु वा̱जिनो̱ हवे̍षु दे̱वता̍ता मि̱तद्र̍वः स्व̱र्काः जम्भयन्तोऽहि̱ं वृक̱म्̐ रक्षा̍ंम्̐सि̱ सने̍म्य̱स्मद्यु̍यवन्नमी̍वाः
101.m: May the steeds be auspicious to us at our invocations, / measured in course, well-praising, in the divine service, / crushing the serpent, the wolf, and the demons, / completely driving away sickness from us!

101.s: te no̱ arva̍nto hava̱naśruto̱ hava̱ṃ viśve̍ śṛṇvantu vā̱jino̍ mi̱tadra̍vaḥ sa̱hasra̍sā me̱dhasā̍tā i̱va tmanā̍ ma̱ho ye dhana̍ṃm̐ sa̱mithe̍ṣu jajñi̱re
101.d: ते नो̱ अर्व̍न्तो हव̱नश्रुतो̱ हव̱ं विश्वे̍ शृण्वन्तु वा̱जिनो̍ मि̱तद्र̍वः स̱हस्र̍सा मे̱धसा̍ता इ̱व त्मना̍ म̱हो ये धन̍ंम्̐ स̱मिथे̍षु जज्ञि̱रे
101.m: May those coursers who listen to our call, / all the steeds of measured course, hear our invocation, / winners of thousands, who by themselves, as if in the winning of wisdom, / have borne away great wealth in battles!

101.s: vāje̍vāje'vata vājino no̱ dhane̍ṣu viprā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ a̱sya madhva̍ḥ pibata mā̱daya̍dhvaṃ tṛ̱ptā yā̍ta pa̱thibhi̍rde̱vayā̱naiḥ
101.d: वाजे̍वाजेऽवत वाजिनो नो̱ धने̍षु विप्रा अमृता ऋतज्ञाः अ̱स्य मध्व̍ः पिबत मा̱दय̍ध्वं तृ̱प्ता या̍त प̱थिभि̍र्दे̱वया̱नैः
101.m: At every prize help us, O steeds, in the contests for wealth, / inspired seers, immortal, knowing truth! / Drink of this sweet mead, exhilarate yourselves; / satisfied, go along the paths traveled by the gods!

101.s: ā mā̱ vāja̍sya prasa̱vo ja̍gamyā̱deme dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī vi̱śvarū̍pe ā mā̱ ganta̍ṃ pitarā mātarā yu̱vamā mā̱ somo̍ a̱mṛta̱tvārya̍ gamyāt
101.d: आ मा̱ वाज̍स्य प्रस̱वो ज̍गम्या̱देमे द्यावा̍पृथि̱वी वि̱श्वरू̍पे आ मा̱ गन्त̍ं पितरा मातरा यु̱वमा मा̱ सोमो̍ अ̱मृत̱त्वार्य̍ गम्यात्
101.m: May the impulse of vital vigor come to me, / and these two, heaven and earth, of all forms! / May father and mother come to me, both of you! / May Soma come to me for immortality!

101.s: vā̱jino̍ vāja̱jito̱ vāja̍ṃm̐ sasṛvām̐sa̍ḥ | bṛha̱spate̍rbhā̱gamava̍jighrata nimṛjānāḥ
101.d: वा̱जिनो̍ वाज̱जितो̱ वाज̍ंम्̐ ससृवाम्̐स̍ः । बृह̱स्पते̍र्भा̱गमव̍जिघ्रत निमृजानाः
101.m: O steeds, winners of vital vigor, having run for vital vigor, / sniff, while cleansing yourselves, at Bṛhaspati's share!

102.s: āpaye̱ svāhā̍ svā̱paye̱ svāhā̍'pi̱jāya̱ svāhā̱ krata̍ve̱ svāhā̍ | vasa̍ve̱ svāhā̍'harpa̱taye̱ svāhā̍ ahne̍ mu̱gdhāya̱ svāhā̍ mu̱gdhāya̍ vainam̐śi̱nāya̱ svāhā̍ vina̱m̐śi̱na āntyāya̱nāya̱ svāhāntyā̍ya bhauva̱nāya̱ svāhā̱ bhuva̍nasya̱ pata̍ye̱ svāhādhi̍pataye̱ svāhā̍
102.d: आपये̱ स्वाहा̍ स्वा̱पये̱ स्वाहा̍ऽपि̱जाय̱ स्वाहा̱ क्रत̍वे̱ स्वाहा̍ । वस̍वे̱ स्वाहा̍ऽहर्प̱तये̱ स्वाहा̍ अह्ने̍ मु̱ग्धाय̱ स्वाहा̍ मु̱ग्धाय̍ वैनम्̐शि̱नाय̱ स्वाहा̍ विन̱म्̐शि̱न आन्त्याय̱नाय̱ स्वाहान्त्या̍य भौव̱नाय̱ स्वाहा̱ भुव̍नस्य̱ पत̍ये̱ स्वाहाधि̍पतये̱ स्वाहा̍
102.m: To Āpi, svāhā! To Svāpi, svāhā! To Apija, svāhā! To Kratu, svāhā! / To Vasu, svāhā! To the lord of day, svāhā! / To the bewildered day, svāhā! To the bewildered, destroyer, svāhā! To the destroyer, son of Antya, svāhā! To Antya, born of the world, svāhā! To the lord of the world, svāhā! To the overlord, svāhā!

102.s: āyu̍rya̱jñena̍ kalpatāṃ prā̱ṇo ya̱jñena̍ kalpatāṃ cakṣu̍rya̱jñena̍ kalpatām̐ śrotra̍ṃ ya̱jñena̍ kalpatām pṛ̱ṣṭhaṃ ya̱jñena̍ kalpatāṃ ya̱jño ya̱jñena̍ kalpatām
102.d: आयु̍र्य̱ज्ञेन̍ कल्पतां प्रा̱णो य̱ज्ञेन̍ कल्पतां चक्षु̍र्य̱ज्ञेन̍ कल्पताम्̐ श्रोत्र̍ं य̱ज्ञेन̍ कल्पताम् पृ̱ष्ठं य̱ज्ञेन̍ कल्पतां य̱ज्ञो य̱ज्ञेन̍ कल्पताम्
102.m: May lifespan be fashioned by the sacrifice! May in-breath be fashioned by the sacrifice! May sight be fashioned by the sacrifice! May hearing be fashioned by the sacrifice! / May the back be fashioned by the sacrifice! May the sacrifice be fashioned by the sacrifice!

102.s: jā̱yu ehi̱ svo rohā̍va | pra̱jāpa̍teḥ pra̱jā a̍bhū̱ma sva̍rde̱vā aganmāmṛtā̍ abhūma
102.d: जा̱यु एहि̱ स्वो रोहा̍व । प्र̱जाप̍तेः प्र̱जा अ̍भू̱म स्व̍र्दे̱वा अगन्मामृता̍ अभूम
102.m: Come, wife, let us both mount to heaven! / We have become the offspring of Prajāpati; we have reached heaven, O gods; we have become immortal!

102.s: a̱sme vo̍ astvindri̱yama̱sme nṛ̱mṇamu̱ta kratu̍ḥ | a̱sme varco̍m̐si santu vaḥ
102.d: अ̱स्मे वो̍ अस्त्विन्द्रि̱यम̱स्मे नृ̱म्णमु̱त क्रतु̍ः । अ̱स्मे वर्चो̍म्̐सि सन्तु वः
102.m: In us be your Indra-like power; in us be manly vigor and purpose! / In us be your radiant splendors!

102.s: namo̍ mā̱tre pṛ̍thi̱vyā i̱yaṃ te̱ rāḍyantāsi̱ yama̍naḥ dhru̱vo̍'si dha̱ruṇa̍ḥ kṛ̱ṣyai kṣemā̍ya ra̱yyai poṣā̍ya
102.d: नमो̍ मा̱त्रे पृ̍थि̱व्या इ̱यं ते̱ राड्यन्तासि̱ यम̍नः ध्रु̱वो̍ऽसि ध̱रुण̍ः कृ̱ष्यै क्षेमा̍य र̱य्यै पोषा̍य
102.m: Homage to Mother Earth! / This is your kingdom: you are the ruler, the restrainer. / You are firm, a supporter, for plowing, for security, for wealth, for prospering!

103.s: (4) vāja̍sye̱maṃ pra̍sa̱vaḥ su̍ṣuve'gre̱ soma̱m̐ rājā̍na̱moṣa̍dhīṣva̱psu tā a̱smabhya̱ṃ madhu̍matīrbhavantu va̱yam̐ rāṣṭre jā̍gṛyāma purohi̍tāḥ
103.d: (4) वाज̍स्ये̱मं प्र̍स̱वः सु̍षुवेऽग्रे̱ सोम̱म्̐ राजा̍न̱मोष̍धीष्व̱प्सु ता अ̱स्मभ्य̱ं मधु̍मतीर्भवन्तु व̱यम्̐ राष्ट्रे जा̍गृयाम पुरोहि̍ताः
103.m: The impulse of vital vigor first brought forth this King Soma / among the plants and the waters. / May they be sweet for us; / may we watch over the realm as royal priests!

103.s: vāja̍sye̱daṃ pra̍sa̱va āba̍bhūve̱mā ca̱ viśvā̱ bhuva̍nāni sa̱rvata̍ḥ sane̍mi̱ rājā̱ pari̍yāti vi̱dvān ra̱yiṃ pu̱ṣṭiṃ va̱rdhaya̍māno a̱sme
103.d: वाज̍स्ये̱दं प्र̍स̱व आब̍भूवे̱मा च̱ विश्वा̱ भुव̍नानि स̱र्वत̍ः सने̍मि̱ राजा̱ परि̍याति वि̱द्वान् र̱यिं पु̱ष्टिं व̱र्धय̍मानो अ̱स्मे
103.m: The impulse of vital vigor has become this universe, / and all these worlds on every side. / Knowing, the king goes completely around, / increasing wealth and thriving among us.

103.s: vāja̍sye̱māṃ pra̍sa̱vaḥ śi̍śri̱ye di̱vami̱mā ca̱ viśvā̱ bhuva̍nāni sa̱mrāṭ ādi̍tsantaṃ dāpayati prajāna̱ntasa no̍ ra̱yim̐ sa̱rvavī̍ra̱ṃ niya̍cchatu
103.d: वाज̍स्ये̱मां प्र̍स̱वः शि̍श्रि̱ये दि̱वमि̱मा च̱ विश्वा̱ भुव̍नानि स̱म्राट् आदि̍त्सन्तं दापयति प्रजान̱न्तस नो̍ र̱यिम्̐ स̱र्ववी̍र̱ं निय̍च्छतु
103.m: The impulse of vital vigor, the universal ruler, / has resorted to this heaven and all these worlds. / Knowing, he makes him give who is reluctant to give. / May he bestow on us wealth consisting of all heroic sons!

103.s: agne̱ acchā̍vadeha na̱ḥ prati̍ naḥ su̱manā̍ bhava pra no̍ yaccha sahasraji̱ttvam̐ hi dha̍na̱dā asi̍
103.d: अग्ने̱ अच्छा̍वदेह न̱ः प्रति̍ नः सु̱मना̍ भव प्र नो̍ यच्छ सहस्रजि̱त्त्वम्̐ हि ध̍न̱दा असि̍
103.m: O Agni, speak well to us here; / be favorably disposed toward us! / Bestow [wealth] on us, winner of thousands, / for you are the giver of wealth!

103.s: soma̱m̐ rājā̍namava̍se'gnima̱nvāra̍bhāmahe | ā̱di̱tyaṃ viṣṇu̱m̐ sūrya̍ bra̱hmāṇa̍ṃ ca̱ bṛha̱spati̍m
103.d: सोम̱म्̐ राजा̍नमव̍सेऽग्निम̱न्वार̍भामहे । आ̱दि̱त्यं विष्णु̱म्̐ सूर्य̍ ब्र̱ह्माण̍ं च̱ बृह̱स्पति̍म्
103.m: We take hold of King Soma for assistance, and Agni, / Āditya, Viṣṇu, Sūrya, / and the priest Bṛhaspati.

103.s: pra no̍ yacchatvarya̱mā pra pū̱ṣā pra sara̍svatī | pra vāgde̱vī da̍dātu naḥ
103.d: प्र नो̍ यच्छत्वर्य̱मा प्र पू̱षा प्र सर̍स्वती । प्र वाग्दे̱वी द̍दातु नः
103.m: May Aryaman bestow on us, may Pūṣan, may Sarasvatī! / May the divine speech give to us!

103.s: arya̱maṇa̱ṃ bṛha̱spati̱mindra̍ṃ dānā̍ya codaya | vāca̱ṃ viṣṇu̱m̐ sara̍svatīm̐ savi̱tāra̍ṃ ca vā̱jina̍m
103.d: अर्य̱मण̱ं बृह̱स्पति̱मिन्द्र̍ं दाना̍य चोदय । वाच̱ं विष्णु̱म्̐ सर̍स्वतीम्̐ सवि̱तार̍ं च वा̱जिन̍म्
103.m: Impel Aryaman, Bṛhaspati, and Indra to give, / and Speech, Viṣṇu, Sarasvatī, / and Savitṛ, the steed of vital vigor!

103.s: de̱vasya̍ tvā savi̱tuḥ pra̍sa̱ve'śvino̍rbā̱hubhyā̍ṃ pū̱ṣṇo hastā̍bhyām sara̍svatyai vā̱co ya̱nturya̱ntreṇa̍ dadhāmi bṛha̱spate̍ṣṭvā sā̱mrājye̍nā̱bhiṣi̍ñcāmīndra̍sya tvā sā̱mrājye̍nā̱bhiṣi̍ñcāmi
103.d: दे̱वस्य̍ त्वा सवि̱तुः प्र̍स̱वेऽश्विनो̍र्बा̱हुभ्या̍ं पू̱ष्णो हस्ता̍भ्याम् सर̍स्वत्यै वा̱चो य̱न्तुर्य̱न्त्रेण̍ दधामि बृह̱स्पते̍ष्ट्वा सा̱म्राज्ये̍ना̱भिषि̍ञ्चामीन्द्र̍स्य त्वा सा̱म्राज्ये̍ना̱भिषि̍ञ्चामि
103.m:
At the impulse of god Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan,
I place you in the control of Sarasvatī, speech the controller.
With the universal rule of Bṛhaspati I consecrate you; with the universal rule of Indra I consecrate you.

104.s: (5) a̱gnirekā̍kṣareṇa prā̱ṇamuda̍jaya̱t tamu̱jjeṣa̱maśvinau̱ dvya̍kṣareṇa dvi̱pado̍ manu̱ṣyānuda̍jayatā̱ṃ tānu̱jjeṣam viṣṇu̱strya̍kṣareṇa̱ trīni̱mām̐llo̱kānuda̍jaya̱ttānu̱jjeṣa̱m̐ soma̱ścatu̍rakṣareṇa catu̍ṣpadaḥ pa̱śūnuda̍jaya̱ttānu̱jjeṣam
104.d: (5) अ̱ग्निरेका̍क्षरेण प्रा̱णमुद̍जय̱त् तमु̱ज्जेष̱मश्विनौ̱ द्व्य̍क्षरेण द्वि̱पदो̍ मनु̱ष्यानुद̍जयता̱ं तानु̱ज्जेषम् विष्णु̱स्त्र्य̍क्षरेण̱ त्रीनि̱माम्̐ल्लो̱कानुद̍जय̱त्तानु̱ज्जेष̱म्̐ सोम̱श्चतु̍रक्षरेण चतु̍ष्पदः प̱शूनुद̍जय̱त्तानु̱ज्जेषम्
104.m:
Agni through the monosyllable won the in-breath; may I win that. The Aśvins through the disyllable won two-footed men; may I win them.
Viṣṇu through the trisyllable won these three worlds; may I win them. Soma through the quadrisyllable won four-footed animals; may I win them.

104.s: pū̱ṣā pañcā̍kṣareṇa̱ pañca̍ ṛ̱tūnuda̍jaya̱ttānu̱jjeṣa̱m̐ savi̱tā ṣaḍa̍kṣareṇa̱ ṣaḍṛ̱tūnuda̍jaya̱ttānu̱jjeṣam ma̱ruta̍ḥ sa̱ptākṣa̍reṇa sa̱pta grā̱myān pa̱śūnuda̍jaya̱m̐stānu̱jjeṣa̍ṃ bṛha̱spati̍ra̱ṣṭākṣa̍reṇa gāya̱trīmuda̍jaya̱ttāmu̱jjeṣam
104.d: पू̱षा पञ्चा̍क्षरेण̱ पञ्च̍ ऋ̱तूनुद̍जय̱त्तानु̱ज्जेष̱म्̐ सवि̱ता षड̍क्षरेण̱ षडृ̱तूनुद̍जय̱त्तानु̱ज्जेषम् म̱रुत̍ः स̱प्ताक्ष̍रेण स̱प्त ग्रा̱म्यान् प̱शूनुद̍जय̱म्̐स्तानु̱ज्जेष̍ं बृह̱स्पति̍र̱ष्टाक्ष̍रेण गाय̱त्रीमुद̍जय̱त्तामु̱ज्जेषम्
104.m:
Pūṣan through the five-syllable won the five seasons; may I win them. Savitṛ through the six-syllable won the six seasons; may I win them.
The Maruts through the seven-syllable won the seven domestic animals; may I win them. Bṛhaspati through the eight-syllable won the Gāyatrī; may I win it.

104.s: mi̱tro navā̍kṣareṇa tri̱vṛta̱m̐ stoma̱muda̍jaya̱t tamu̱jjeṣa̱ṃ varu̍ṇo da̱śākṣa̍reṇa vi̱rāja̱muda̍jaya̱ttāmu̱jjeṣam indra̱ ekā̍daśākṣareṇa tri̱ṣṭubha̱muda̍jaya̱ttāmu̱jjeṣa̱ṃ viśve̍ de̱vā dvā̍da̍śākṣareṇa jaga̍tī̱muda̍jaya̱m̐stāmu̱jjeṣam
104.d: मि̱त्रो नवा̍क्षरेण त्रि̱वृत̱म्̐ स्तोम̱मुद̍जय̱त् तमु̱ज्जेष̱ं वरु̍णो द̱शाक्ष̍रेण वि̱राज̱मुद̍जय̱त्तामु̱ज्जेषम् इन्द्र̱ एका̍दशाक्षरेण त्रि̱ष्टुभ̱मुद̍जय̱त्तामु̱ज्जेष̱ं विश्वे̍ दे̱वा द्वा̍द̍शाक्षरेण जग̍ती̱मुद̍जय̱म्̐स्तामु̱ज्जेषम्
104.m:
Mitra through the nine-syllable won the threefold chant; may I win that. Varuṇa through the ten-syllable won the Virāj; may I win it.
Indra through the eleven-syllable won the Triṣṭubh; may I win it. The All-Gods through the twelve-syllable won the Jagatī; may I win it.

104.s: vasa̍va̱strayo̍daśākṣareṇa trayoda̱śam̐ stoma̱muda̍jaya̱m̐stamu̱jjeṣa̱m̐ ru̱drāścatu̍rdaśākṣareṇa caturda̱śam̐ stoma̱muda̍jaya̱m̐stamu̱jjeṣam ā̱di̱tyāḥ pañca̍daśākṣareṇa pañcada̱śam̐ stoma̱muda̍jaya̱m̐stamu̱jjeṣa̱madi̍tiḥ ṣoḍa̍śākṣareṇa ṣoḍa̱śam̐ stoma̱muda̍jaya̱ttamu̱jjeṣam pra̱jāpa̍tiḥ sa̱ptada̍śākṣareṇa saptada̱śam̐ stoma̱muda̍jaya̱ttamu̱jjeṣam
104.d: वस̍व̱स्त्रयो̍दशाक्षरेण त्रयोद̱शम्̐ स्तोम̱मुद̍जय̱म्̐स्तमु̱ज्जेष̱म्̐ रु̱द्राश्चतु̍र्दशाक्षरेण चतुर्द̱शम्̐ स्तोम̱मुद̍जय̱म्̐स्तमु̱ज्जेषम् आ̱दि̱त्याः पञ्च̍दशाक्षरेण पञ्चद̱शम्̐ स्तोम̱मुद̍जय̱म्̐स्तमु̱ज्जेष̱मदि̍तिः षोड̍शाक्षरेण षोड̱शम्̐ स्तोम̱मुद̍जय̱त्तमु̱ज्जेषम् प्र̱जाप̍तिः स̱प्तद̍शाक्षरेण सप्तद̱शम्̐ स्तोम̱मुद̍जय̱त्तमु̱ज्जेषम्
104.m:
The Vasus through the thirteen-syllable won the thirteenfold chant; may I win that. The Rudras through the fourteen-syllable won the fourteenfold chant; may I win that.
The Ādityas through the fifteen-syllable won the fifteenfold chant; may I win that. Aditi through the sixteen-syllable won the sixteenfold chant; may I win that.
Prajāpati through the seventeen-syllable won the seventeenfold chant; may I win that.

106.s: atha prathamo'dhyāyaḥ ( athaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ) e̱ṣa te̍ nirṛte bhā̱gastaṃ ju̍ṣasva̱ svāhā̱'gnine̍trebhyo de̱vebhya̍: pu̱raḥsadbhya̱: svāhā̍ ya̱mane̍trebhyo de̱vebhyo̍ dakṣi̱ṇasadbhya̱: svāhā̍ vi̱śvade̍vanetrebhyo de̱vebhya̍: pa̱ścātsadbhya̱: svāhā̍ mi̱trāvaru̍ṇanetrebhyo vā ma̱runne̍trebhyo vā de̱vebhya̍ utta̱rasadbhya̱: svāhā̍ soma̍netrebhyo de̱vebhya̍ upa̱risadbhyo duva̍svadbhya̱: svāhā̍
106.d: अथ प्रथमोऽध्यायः ( अथैकादशोऽध्यायः ) ए̱ष ते̍ निरृते भा̱गस्तं जु̍षस्व̱ स्वाहा̱ऽग्निने̍त्रेभ्यो दे̱वेभ्य̍: पु̱रःसद्भ्य̱: स्वाहा̍ य̱मने̍त्रेभ्यो दे̱वेभ्यो̍ दक्षि̱णसद्भ्य̱: स्वाहा̍ वि̱श्वदे̍वनेत्रेभ्यो दे̱वेभ्य̍: प̱श्चात्सद्भ्य̱: स्वाहा̍ मि̱त्रावरु̍णनेत्रेभ्यो वा म̱रुन्ने̍त्रेभ्यो वा दे̱वेभ्य̍ उत्त̱रसद्भ्य̱: स्वाहा̍ सोम̍नेत्रेभ्यो दे̱वेभ्य̍ उप̱रिसद्भ्यो दुव̍स्वद्भ्य̱: स्वाहा̍
106.m:
This is your share, O Nirṛti; enjoy it, svāhā! To the gods who have Agni as their leader, who sit in the east, svāhā! To the gods who have Yama as their leader, who sit in the south, svāhā!
To the gods who have the All-Gods as their leader, who sit in the west, svāhā! To the gods who have Mitrāvaruṇa as their leaders, or who have the Maruts as their leaders, who sit in the north, svāhā!
To the gods who have Soma as their leader, who sit above, the reverent ones, svāhā!

106.s: ye de̱vā a̱gnine̍trāḥ pu̱raḥsadustebhya̱: svāhā̱ ye de̱vā ya̱mane̍trā dakṣi̱ṇasadustebhya̱: svāhā̍ ye de̱vā vi̱śvade̍vanetrāḥ pa̱ścātsadustebhya̱: svāhā̱ ye de̱vā mi̱trāvaru̍ṇanetrā vā ma̱runne̍trā votta̱rasadustebhya̱: svāhā̍ ye de̱vāḥ soma̍netrā upa̱risado duva̍svanta̱stebhya̱: svāhā̍
106.d: ये दे̱वा अ̱ग्निने̍त्राः पु̱रःसदुस्तेभ्य̱: स्वाहा̱ ये दे̱वा य̱मने̍त्रा दक्षि̱णसदुस्तेभ्य̱: स्वाहा̍ ये दे̱वा वि̱श्वदे̍वनेत्राः प̱श्चात्सदुस्तेभ्य̱: स्वाहा̱ ये दे̱वा मि̱त्रावरु̍णनेत्रा वा म̱रुन्ने̍त्रा वोत्त̱रसदुस्तेभ्य̱: स्वाहा̍ ये दे̱वाः सोम̍नेत्रा उप̱रिसदो दुव̍स्वन्त̱स्तेभ्य̱: स्वाहा̍
106.m:
Which gods have Agni as leader, sitting in the east, to them svāhā! Which gods have Yama as leader, sitting in the south, to them svāhā!
Which gods have the All-Gods as leader, sitting in the west, to them svāhā! Which gods have Mitrāvaruṇa as leaders or have the Maruts as leaders, sitting in the north, to them svāhā!
Which gods have Soma as leader, sitting above, reverent, to them svāhā!

106.s: agne̱ saha̍sva̱ pṛta̍nā a̱bhimā̍tī̱rapā̍sya | du̱ṣṭara̱stara̱nnarā̍tī̱rvarco̍ dhā ya̱jñavā̍hasi de̱vasya̍ tvā savi̱tuḥ pra̍sa̱ve'śvino̍rbā̱hubhyā̍ṃ pū̱ṣṇo hastā̍bhyām
106.d: अग्ने̱ सह̍स्व̱ पृत̍ना अ̱भिमा̍ती̱रपा̍स्य । दु̱ष्टर̱स्तर̱न्नरा̍ती̱र्वर्चो̍ धा य̱ज्ञवा̍हसि दे̱वस्य̍ त्वा सवि̱तुः प्र̍स̱वेऽश्विनो̍र्बा̱हुभ्या̍ं पू̱ष्णो हस्ता̍भ्याम्
106.m:
O Agni, overpower the armies, drive off the adversaries.
Crossing what is hard to cross, overmastering the enemies, establish brilliance in the bearer of the sacrifice.
At the impulse of god Savitṛ, with the arms of the Aśvins, with the hands of Pūṣan—

106.s: u̱pām̐śorvī̱rye̍ṇa juhomi ha̱tam̐ rakṣa̱: svāhā̍ | rakṣa̍sāṃ tvā va̱dhāyāva̍dhiṣma̱ rakṣo'muṣya̍ tvā va̱dhāyāmuma̍vadhiṣma | juṣā̱ṇo'dhvājya̍sya vetu̱ svāhā̍
106.d: उ̱पाम्̐शोर्वी̱र्ये̍ण जुहोमि ह̱तम्̐ रक्ष̱: स्वाहा̍ । रक्ष̍सां त्वा व̱धायाव̍धिष्म̱ रक्षोऽमुष्य̍ त्वा व̱धायामुम̍वधिष्म । जुषा̱णोऽध्वाज्य̍स्य वेतु̱ स्वाहा̍
106.m: With the power of the Upāṃśu [cup] I offer. Smitten is the demon, svāhā! For the destruction of the demons [I take] you; we have smitten the demon. For the destruction of so-and-so [I take] you; we have smitten so-and-so. May he, taking pleasure in the course, partake of the clarified butter, svāhā!

107.m:
The gods took the sweet waters, rich in sap, king-makers, discerning,
with which they consecrated Mitrāvaruṇa, with which they led Indra beyond the enemies.

107.s: vṛṣṇa̍ ū̱rmira̍si rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭraṃ me̍ dehi̱ svāhā̱ vṛṣṇa̍ ū̱rmira̍si rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭrama̱muṣmai̍ dehi vṛṣase̱no̍'si rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭraṃ me̍ dehi̱ svāhā̍ vṛṣase̱no̍'si rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭrama̱muṣmai̍ dehi
107.d: वृष्ण̍ ऊ̱र्मिर̍सि राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रं मे̍ देहि̱ स्वाहा̱ वृष्ण̍ ऊ̱र्मिर̍सि राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रम̱मुष्मै̍ देहि वृषसे̱नो̍ऽसि राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रं मे̍ देहि̱ स्वाहा̍ वृषसे̱नो̍ऽसि राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रम̱मुष्मै̍ देहि
107.m:
A male wave are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to me, svāhā! A male wave are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to so-and-so.
A host of males are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to me, svāhā! A host of males are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to so-and-so.

107.s: arthe̱ta̍ stha rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭraṃ me̍ datta̱ svāhā̍rthe̱ta̍ stha rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭrama̱muṣmai̍ datta oja̍svatī stha rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭraṃ me̍ datta̱ svāhauja̍svatī stha rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭrama̱muṣmai̍ datta āpa̍: pari̱vāhi̍ṇī̍ stha rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭraṃ me̍ datta̱ svāhāpa̍: pari̱vāhi̍ṇī̍ stha rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭrama̱muṣmai̍ datta a̱pāṃ pati̍rasi rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭraṃ me̍ dehi̱ svāhā̱pāṃ pati̍rasi rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭrama̱muṣmai̍ dehi a̱pāṃ garbho̍'si rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭraṃ me̍ dehi̱ svāhā̱pāṃ garbho̍'si rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭrama̱muṣmai̍ dehi sūrya̍varcasa stha rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭraṃ me̍ datta̱ svāhā̱ sūrya̍varcasa stha rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭrama̱muṣmai̍ datta sūrya̍tvaca stha rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭraṃ me̍ datta̱ svāhā̱ sūrya̍tvaca stha rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭrama̱muṣmai̍ datta vra̱jakṣi̍ta̍ stha rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭraṃ me̍ datta̱ svāhā̍ vra̱jakṣi̍ta̍ stha rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭrama̱muṣmai̍ datta vā̱śā stha̍ rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭraṃ me̍ datta̱ svāhā̍ vā̱śā stha̍ rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭrama̱muṣmai̍ datta mā̱ndā stha̍ rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭraṃ me̍ datta̱ svāhā̍ mā̱ndā stha̍ rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭrama̱muṣmai̍ datta śakvarī̍ stha rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭraṃ me̍ datta̱ svāhā̱ śakvarī̍ stha rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭrama̱muṣmai̍ datta ja̱na̱bhṛta̍ stha rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭraṃ me̍ datta̱ svāhā̍ jana̱bhṛta̍ stha rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭrama̱muṣmai̍ datta vi̱śva̱bhṛta̍ stha rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭraṃ me̍ datta̱ svāhā̍ viśva̱bhṛta̍ stha rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭrama̱muṣmai̍ datta sva̱rāṭ stha rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭraṃ me̍ datta̱ svāhā̍ sva̱rāṭ stha rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭrama̱muṣmai̍ datta āpa̍ḥ svārā̱jñī stha̍ rāṣṭra̱dā rā̱ṣṭrama̱muṣmai̍ datta
107.d: अर्थे̱त̍ स्थ राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रं मे̍ दत्त̱ स्वाहा̍र्थे̱त̍ स्थ राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रम̱मुष्मै̍ दत्त ओज̍स्वती स्थ राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रं मे̍ दत्त̱ स्वाहौज̍स्वती स्थ राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रम̱मुष्मै̍ दत्त आप̍: परि̱वाहि̍णी̍ स्थ राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रं मे̍ दत्त̱ स्वाहाप̍: परि̱वाहि̍णी̍ स्थ राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रम̱मुष्मै̍ दत्त अ̱पां पति̍रसि राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रं मे̍ देहि̱ स्वाहा̱पां पति̍रसि राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रम̱मुष्मै̍ देहि अ̱पां गर्भो̍ऽसि राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रं मे̍ देहि̱ स्वाहा̱पां गर्भो̍ऽसि राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रम̱मुष्मै̍ देहि सूर्य̍वर्चस स्थ राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रं मे̍ दत्त̱ स्वाहा̱ सूर्य̍वर्चस स्थ राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रम̱मुष्मै̍ दत्त सूर्य̍त्वच स्थ राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रं मे̍ दत्त̱ स्वाहा̱ सूर्य̍त्वच स्थ राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रम̱मुष्मै̍ दत्त व्र̱जक्षि̍त̍ स्थ राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रं मे̍ दत्त̱ स्वाहा̍ व्र̱जक्षि̍त̍ स्थ राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रम̱मुष्मै̍ दत्त वा̱शा स्थ̍ राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रं मे̍ दत्त̱ स्वाहा̍ वा̱शा स्थ̍ राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रम̱मुष्मै̍ दत्त मा̱न्दा स्थ̍ राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रं मे̍ दत्त̱ स्वाहा̍ मा̱न्दा स्थ̍ राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रम̱मुष्मै̍ दत्त शक्वरी̍ स्थ राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रं मे̍ दत्त̱ स्वाहा̱ शक्वरी̍ स्थ राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रम̱मुष्मै̍ दत्त ज̱न̱भृत̍ स्थ राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रं मे̍ दत्त̱ स्वाहा̍ जन̱भृत̍ स्थ राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रम̱मुष्मै̍ दत्त वि̱श्व̱भृत̍ स्थ राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रं मे̍ दत्त̱ स्वाहा̍ विश्व̱भृत̍ स्थ राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रम̱मुष्मै̍ दत्त स्व̱राट् स्थ राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रं मे̍ दत्त̱ स्वाहा̍ स्व̱राट् स्थ राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रम̱मुष्मै̍ दत्त आप̍ः स्वारा̱ज्ञी स्थ̍ राष्ट्र̱दा रा̱ष्ट्रम̱मुष्मै̍ दत्त
107.m:
Purposeful are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to me, svāhā! Purposeful are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to so-and-so.
Vigorous are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to me, svāhā! Vigorous are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to so-and-so.
Flowing around, O waters, are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to me, svāhā! Flowing around, O waters, are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to so-and-so.
Lord of the waters are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to me, svāhā! Lord of the waters are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to so-and-so.
Embryo of the waters are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to me, svāhā! Embryo of the waters are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to so-and-so.
Possessed of the sun's brilliance are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to me, svāhā! Possessed of the sun's brilliance are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to so-and-so.
Sun-skinned are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to me, svāhā! Sun-skinned are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to so-and-so.
Dwelling in the pen are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to me, svāhā! Dwelling in the pen are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to so-and-so.
Eagerly lowing are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to me, svāhā! Eagerly lowing are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to so-and-so.
Delight-bringing are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to me, svāhā! Delight-bringing are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to so-and-so.
Mighty are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to me, svāhā! Mighty are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to so-and-so.
Sustaining people are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to me, svāhā! Sustaining people are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to so-and-so.
All-sustaining are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to me, svāhā! All-sustaining are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to so-and-so.
Most excellent are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to me, svāhā! Most excellent are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to so-and-so.
Self-ruling waters are you, bestowing dominion; give dominion to so-and-so.

107.s: saṃ madhu̍matī̱rmadhu̍matībhiḥ pṛcyantā̱ṃ mahi̍ kṣa̱traṃ kṣa̱triyā̍ya vanvā̱nāḥ anā̍dhṛṣṭāḥ sīdata sahaurjasā̱ mahi̍ kṣa̱traṃ kṣa̱triyā̍ya̱ dadha̍tīḥ
107.d: सं मधु̍मती̱र्मधु̍मतीभिः पृच्यन्ता̱ं महि̍ क्ष̱त्रं क्ष̱त्रिया̍य वन्वा̱नाः अना̍धृष्टाः सीदत सहौर्जसा̱ महि̍ क्ष̱त्रं क्ष̱त्रिया̍य̱ दध̍तीः
107.m: Let the sweet ones mingle with the sweet ones, winning great princely power for the kṣatriya. / Unassailable, sit down with might, bestowing great princely power upon the kṣatriya.

108.s: (2) savi̱tā tvā̍ prasā̱vānā̱ṃ suvatāma̱gnirgṛhapa̍tīnā̱m̐somo̱ vana̱spatī̍nām bṛha̱spati̍rvā̱ca indro̱ jyaiṣṭhyā̍ya ru̱draḥ pa̱śūnā̍ṃ mi̱traḥ sa̱tyāya̱ varu̍ṇo dharma̍patīnām
108.d: (2) सवि̱ता त्वा̍ प्रसा̱वाना̱ं सुवताम̱ग्निर्गृहप̍तीना̱म्̐सोमो̱ वन̱स्पती̍नाम् बृह̱स्पति̍र्वा̱च इन्द्रो̱ ज्यैष्ठ्या̍य रु̱द्रः प̱शूना̍ं मि̱त्रः स̱त्याय̱ वरु̍णो धर्म̍पतीनाम्
108.m: May Savitṛ impel you of the impulses, Agni of the householders, Soma of the lords of the forest, / Bṛhaspati of speech, Indra for preeminence, Rudra of the cattle, Mitra for truth, Varuṇa of the lords of sacred law.

108.s: i̱maṃ de̍vā asapa̱tnam̐ su̍vadhvaṃ maha̱te kṣa̱trāya̍ maha̱te jyaiṣṭhyā̍ya i̱mama̱muṣya̍ pu̱trama̱muṣyai̍ pu̱trama̱syai vi̱śe
108.d: इ̱मं दे̍वा असप̱त्नम्̐ सु̍वध्वं मह̱ते क्ष̱त्राय̍ मह̱ते ज्यैष्ठ्या̍य इ̱मम̱मुष्य̍ पु̱त्रम̱मुष्यै̍ पु̱त्रम̱स्यै वि̱शे
108.m: Impel this man, O gods, to be without a rival, for great princely power, for great preeminence, / this [man] N.N., son of N.N. [father], son of N.N. [mother], for this clan.

108.s: e̱ṣa va̍ḥ kuravo̱ rāje̱ṣa va̍ḥ pañcālā̱ rājā̍ | somo̱'smāka̍ṃ brāhma̱ṇānā̱m̐ rājā̍
108.d: ए̱ष व̍ः कुरवो̱ राजे̱ष व̍ः पञ्चाला̱ राजा̍ । सोमो̱ऽस्माक̍ं ब्राह्म̱णाना̱म्̐ राजा̍
108.m: This is your king, O Kurus; this is your king, O Pañcālas. Soma is the king of us Brahmins.
